Create `packages/core/src/components/plot-tools/plot-status.ts`:

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing } from 'lit';
import { property } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import { countNoun } from '@protspace/utils';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import '../kit/button';
import { icon, type IconName } from '../kit/icon';
import { plotStatusStyles } from './plot-status.styles';

/** The ways a view is narrowed, one chip each. */
export type StatusChipKind = 'filter' | 'isolation' | 'hidden';

interface Chip {
  kind: StatusChipKind;
  icon: IconName;
  text: string;
  clearLabel: string;
}

const KIND_ORDER: readonly StatusChipKind[] = ['filter', 'isolation', 'hidden'];

/**
 * The plot's bottom-left corner (design decision 13): the visible protein count, and a chip for
 * each way the view is narrowed, each with an ✕. The filter and hidden chips open the place to
 * change them; the isolation chip has nothing to open (no panel edits an isolation). It reports
 * presses; the host acts and sets the properties.
 *
 * @fires status-open - `{ kind: StatusChipKind }`
 * @fires status-clear - `{ kind: StatusChipKind }`
 */
@customElement('protspace-plot-status')
export class ProtspacePlotStatus extends LitElement {
  static styles = plotStatusStyles;

  /** The visible proteins; null hides the count. */
  @property({ attribute: false }) count: number | null = null;
  @property({ attribute: false }) zoomedIn = false;
  /** Configured conditions of the applied filter; 0 hides the chip. */
  @property({ attribute: false }) filterConditions = 0;
  /** The isolation's steps and the proteins it keeps; null hides the chip. */
  @property({ attribute: false }) isolation: { steps: number; size: number } | null = null;
  /** Category values the legend hides; 0 hides the chip. */
  @property({ attribute: false }) hiddenCategories = 0;

  /** The chip whose ✕ held focus when pressed, until the chip is gone and focus has moved on. */
  private _focusAfterClear: StatusChipKind | null = null;

  render() {
    return html`${this.count === null
        ? nothing
        : html`<span class="status-count" role="status" aria-live="polite" tabindex="-1"
            >${countNoun(this.count, 'protein', 'proteins')}${this.zoomedIn
              ? ' · Zoomed in'
              : ''}</span
          >`}
      ${this._chips().map(
        (chip) =>
          html`<div class="status-chip" data-kind=${chip.kind}>
            ${icon(chip.icon, 14)}
            ${chip.kind === 'isolation'
              ? html`<span class="status-chip-text">${chip.text}</span>`
              : html`<button
                  type="button"
                  class="status-chip-open"
                  @click=${() => this._emit('status-open', chip.kind)}
                >
                  ${chip.text}
                </button>`}
            <ps-icon-button
              size="sm"
              icon="x"
              label=${chip.clearLabel}
              @click=${() => this._clear(chip.kind)}
            ></ps-icon-button>
          </div>`,
      )}`;
  }

  protected updated(): void {
    const kind = this._focusAfterClear;
    if (!kind || this._chips().some((chip) => chip.kind === kind)) return;
    this._focusAfterClear = null;
    // Focus was on the ✕ of a chip that has gone: the next chip, else the count.
    const later = KIND_ORDER.slice(KIND_ORDER.indexOf(kind) + 1);
    const next = this._chips().find((chip) => later.includes(chip.kind));
    if (next) this._control(next.kind)?.focus();
    else this.renderRoot.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.status-count')?.focus();
  }

  /**
   * Focuses that chip's first control (its open button, else its ✕). False when the chip does not
   * show; a chip whose property was just set is focused once its update has rendered it.
   */
  focusChip(kind: StatusChipKind): boolean {
    if (!this._chips().some((chip) => chip.kind === kind)) return false;
    void this.updateComplete.then(async () => {
      const control = this._control(kind);
      // A kit button renders its inner <button> in its own update.
      if (control && 'updateComplete' in control) {
        await (control as HTMLElement & { updateComplete: Promise<unknown> }).updateComplete;
      }
      control?.focus();
    });
    return true;
  }

  private _chips(): Chip[] {
    const chips: Chip[] = [];
    if (this.filterConditions > 0) {
      chips.push({
        kind: 'filter',
        icon: 'filter',
        text: `Filtered · ${countNoun(this.filterConditions, 'condition', 'conditions')}`,
        clearLabel: 'Remove filter',
      });
    }
    if (this.isolation) {
      const { size, steps } = this.isolation;
      chips.push({
        kind: 'isolation',
        icon: 'target',
        text: `Showing only ${countNoun(size, 'protein', 'proteins')} · ${countNoun(steps, 'step', 'steps')}`,
        clearLabel: 'Show all proteins',
      });
    }
    if (this.hiddenCategories > 0) {
      chips.push({
        kind: 'hidden',
        icon: 'eye-off',
        text: `${countNoun(this.hiddenCategories, 'category', 'categories')} hidden`,
        clearLabel: 'Show hidden categories',
      });
    }
    return chips;
  }

  private _control(kind: StatusChipKind): HTMLElement | null {
    const chip = `.status-chip[data-kind="${kind}"]`;
    return this.renderRoot.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      `${chip} .status-chip-open, ${chip} ps-icon-button`,
    );
  }

  private _clear(kind: StatusChipKind): void {
    this._focusAfterClear = this.shadowRoot!.activeElement ? kind : null;
    this._emit('status-clear', kind);
  }

  private _emit(type: 'status-open' | 'status-clear', kind: StatusChipKind): void {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail: { kind }, bubbles: true, composed: true }));
  }
}

declare global {

    'protspace-plot-status': ProtspacePlotStatus;
  }
}
```

```ts
  /**
   * Tells the host what a status display shows. `view-status-change` fires when the visible count
   * or the zoomed-in flag changed since the last report: a zoom frame that crosses no boundary
   * schedules no update, so it reports nothing. `hidden-values-change` fires when the number of
   * hidden category values changed.
   */
  private _reportStatus(changedProperties: Map<string, unknown>): void {
    if (changedProperties.has('hiddenAnnotationValues')) {
      const count = this.hiddenAnnotationValues.length;
      if (count !== this._lastHiddenCount) {
        this._lastHiddenCount = count;
        this.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('hidden-values-change', {
            detail: { count },
            bubbles: true,
            composed: true,
          }),
        );
      }
    }
    if (!this.data) return;
    const count = this._getVisiblePointCount();
    const zoomedIn = this._isZoomedIn;
    const last = this._lastViewStatus;
    if (last && last.count === count && last.zoomedIn === zoomedIn) return;
    this._lastViewStatus = { count, zoomedIn };
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('view-status-change', {
        detail: { count, zoomedIn },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The status controller, `clear()` and `resetIsolation()`**

Create `apps/web/src/explore/status-controller.ts`:

```ts
import type { ProtspacePlotStatus, ProtspaceScatterplot, StatusChipKind } from '@protspace/core';
import type { WorkbenchStatus } from './workbench-status';

interface StatusControllerOptions {
  plotElement: ProtspaceScatterplot;
  plotStatus: ProtspacePlotStatus;
  getStatus(): WorkbenchStatus;
  subscribeStatus(listener: () => void): () => void;
  /** The filter chip's body: show the filter. */
  openFilter(): void;
  /** The filter chip's ✕. */
  clearFilter(): void;
  /** The hidden chip's body: show the legend. */
  openLegend(): void;
  /** The hidden chip's ✕. */
  showAllCategories(): void;
  /** The isolation chip's ✕. */
  resetIsolation(): void;
}

/**
 * The plot's status corner (design decision 13): feeds `protspace-plot-status` from the plot's
 * events and the status store, and runs its chip actions. The plot is never re-rendered for it,
 * and React never sees it.
 */
export function createStatusController({
  plotElement,
  plotStatus,
  getStatus,
  subscribeStatus,
  openFilter,
  clearFilter,
  openLegend,
  showAllCategories,
  resetIsolation,
}: StatusControllerOptions): { dispose(): void } {
  const onViewStatus = (event: Event) => {
    const { count, zoomedIn } = (event as CustomEvent<{ count: number; zoomedIn: boolean }>)
      .detail;
    plotStatus.count = count;
    plotStatus.zoomedIn = zoomedIn;
  };
  const onHiddenValues = (event: Event) => {
    plotStatus.hiddenCategories = (event as CustomEvent<{ count: number }>).detail.count;
  };
  const onIsolation = (event: Event) => {
    const { isolationHistory, dataSize } = (
      event as CustomEvent<{ isolationHistory: string[][]; dataSize: number }>
    ).detail;
    plotStatus.isolation = { steps: isolationHistory.length, size: dataSize };
  };
  const onIsolationReset = () => {
    plotStatus.isolation = null;
  };
  const syncFilter = () => {
    plotStatus.filterConditions = getStatus().appliedFilterConditions;
  };
  const onOpen = (event: Event) => {
    const { kind } = (event as CustomEvent<{ kind: StatusChipKind }>).detail;
    if (kind === 'filter') openFilter();
    else if (kind === 'hidden') openLegend();
  };
  const onClear = (event: Event) => {
    const { kind } = (event as CustomEvent<{ kind: StatusChipKind }>).detail;
    if (kind === 'filter') clearFilter();
    else if (kind === 'isolation') resetIsolation();
    else showAllCategories();
  };

  plotElement.addEventListener('view-status-change', onViewStatus);
  plotElement.addEventListener('hidden-values-change', onHiddenValues);
  plotElement.addEventListener('data-isolation', onIsolation);
  plotElement.addEventListener('data-isolation-reset', onIsolationReset);
  plotStatus.addEventListener('status-open', onOpen);
  plotStatus.addEventListener('status-clear', onClear);
  syncFilter();
  const unsubscribe = subscribeStatus(syncFilter);

  return {
    dispose() {
      plotElement.removeEventListener('view-status-change', onViewStatus);
      plotElement.removeEventListener('hidden-values-change', onHiddenValues);
      plotElement.removeEventListener('data-isolation', onIsolation);
      plotElement.removeEventListener('data-isolation-reset', onIsolationReset);
      plotStatus.removeEventListener('status-open', onOpen);
      plotStatus.removeEventListener('status-clear', onClear);
      unsubscribe();
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
type StatusChipKind = 'filter' | 'isolation' | 'hidden';

const STATUS_CLEAR_NAMES: Readonly<Record<StatusChipKind, string>> = {
  filter: 'Remove filter',
  isolation: 'Show all proteins',
  hidden: 'Show hidden categories',
};

/** The plot's bottom-left corner: the protein count and a chip per narrowing. */
export const plotStatus = (page: Page): Locator => page.locator('#myPlotStatus');

/** The status corner's chip for one narrowing (filtered, isolated, categories hidden). */
export const statusChip = (page: Page, kind: StatusChipKind): Locator =>
  plotStatus(page).locator(`.status-chip[data-kind="${kind}"]`);

/** Presses a chip's ✕ by its name and waits until the chip is gone. */
export async function clearStatusChip(page: Page, kind: StatusChipKind): Promise<void> {
  await statusChip(page, kind)
    .getByRole('button', { name: STATUS_CLEAR_NAMES[kind], exact: true })
    .click();
  await expect(statusChip(page, kind)).toHaveCount(0);
}
```

```ts
/**

 * it: the filter controller hears the builder's query-changed and query-apply.

async function applyOneConditionFilter(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.locator('#myQueryBuilder').evaluate((builder) => {
    const plot = document.querySelector('#myPlot') as Element & { selectedAnnotation: string };
    const query = [
      { id: 'e2e-filter', kind: 'categorical', annotation: plot.selectedAnnotation, values: ['e2e'] },
    ];
    builder.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('query-changed', { detail: { query } }));
    builder.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('query-apply', {
        detail: { matchedIndices: new Set(Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i)) },
      }),
    );
  });
}
```

```md
### Plot Status

`<protspace-plot-status>` sits in the bottom-left corner of its positioned parent: the visible
protein count ("7,831 proteins · Zoomed in", a polite status) and a chip for each way the view is
narrowed, in this order: "Filtered · 2 conditions", "Showing only 1,204 proteins · 2 steps" and
"4 categories hidden". Each chip has an ✕ ("Remove filter", "Show all proteins", "Show hidden
categories"); the filter and hidden chips' text opens the place to change them. It reports
presses; the host acts and sets the properties (all JavaScript only).

| Property           | Type                                        | Description                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `count`            | `number \| null`                            | Visible proteins; null hides it    |
| `zoomedIn`         | `boolean`                                   | Appends " · Zoomed in"             |
| `filterConditions` | `number`                                    | The filter chip shows above 0      |
| `isolation`        | `{ steps: number; size: number } \| null`   | The isolation chip                 |
| `hiddenCategories` | `number`                                    | The hidden chip shows above 0      |

| Event          | Detail                                          | Description            |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `status-open`  | `{ kind: 'filter' \| 'hidden' }`                | A chip's text pressed  |
| `status-clear` | `{ kind: 'filter' \| 'isolation' \| 'hidden' }` | A chip's ✕ pressed     |

`focusChip(kind)` focuses a chip's first control and returns false when that chip does not show.
When an ✕ removes its chip while focused, focus moves to the next chip, else to the count. Feed it
from the scatterplot's `view-status-change`, `hidden-values-change`, `data-isolation` and
`data-isolation-reset`, and give the plot `hide-status` so the count is not drawn twice.
```

```md
The plot's bottom-left corner is `protspace-plot-status`: the visible protein count and a chip
```

### Task 4.4: Query builder in its own folder, with the reason Apply is disabled

The query modules leave `components/control-bar/` for `components/query-builder/` in a move-only commit, with the shared annotation helpers going to `components/common/`. Then the builder takes the kit and tokens and gains what the sidebar panel needs: a `dirty` flag, a `query-cancel` event for Cancel, numbered conditions, named ✕ buttons, a count line in a status region, and visible text saying why Apply is disabled (decision 14). The app still hosts it in the Filter dialog until 4.5; the filter controller only maps the new event and flag.

**Files:**

- Move (commit 1, `git mv`, no behaviour change): `packages/core/src/components/control-bar/{query-builder.ts, query-builder.styles.ts, query-builder.test.ts, query-condition-row.ts, query-condition-row.test.ts, query-value-picker.ts, query-value-picker.test.ts, query-numeric-input.ts, query-numeric-input.test.ts, query-evaluate.ts, query-evaluate.test.ts, query-numeric-helpers.ts, query-numeric-helpers.test.ts, query-presence.ts, query-types.ts, query-annotation-conditions.ts, query-annotation-conditions.test.ts, eat-reliability.ts, eat-reliability.test.ts, types.ts}` → `packages/core/src/components/query-builder/`; `control-bar/annotation-name.ts`, `annotation-categories.ts` → `components/common/`. Update imports in `control-bar/annotation-select.ts`, `packages/core/src/index.ts`, `style-lint.test.ts` (re-key the LEGACY line), `apps/web/src/explore/filter-controller.test.ts` (mock paths), `scripts/docs-screenshots/capture-static.spec.ts` (the `query-types` path), `docs/developers/api/index.md` and `architecture.md` (paths).
- Create (commit 2): `query-builder/query-apply-state.ts`, `query-apply-state.test.ts`, `query-equal.ts`, `query-equal.test.ts`, `query-builder.browser.test.ts`
- Modify (commit 2): `query-builder.ts`, `query-builder.styles.ts` (tokens and kit; the dead `.query-builder-overlay`/`.query-builder-modal` rules go; LEGACY line removed), `query-condition-row.ts` (number label; ✕ via `ps-icon-button`), `query-numeric-input.ts` (count via `countNoun`), their tests; `apps/web/src/explore/filter-controller.ts`, `filter-controller.test.ts`; `docs/developers/api/index.md` (builder properties and events table)
- Modify (commit 2): `apps/web/tests/workbench-filter.spec.ts`, `numeric-binning.spec.ts` helpers (`applyFiltersFromMenu`, `disableFilter`, the zero-match test) and `helpers/explore.ts` for the new button names ("Apply", "Reset") and count text

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `FilterQuery`, `FilterCondition`, `FilterGroup` (`query-types.ts`), `hasConfiguredCondition`, `evaluateQuery`, `evaluateQueryExcluding`, `createCondition`; the builder's `_scheduleEvaluation`, `_matchedIndices`, `_totalCount`, `_handleApply`; `formatCount`, `countNoun` (4.2, `@protspace/utils`); `ps-button`, `ps-icon-button`, `ps-select` (kit by file); `icon('x', 14)`.
- Produces:
  - `query-equal.ts`: `export function sameQuery(a: FilterQuery, b: FilterQuery): boolean` — structural, condition ids included.
  - `query-apply-state.ts`: `export type ApplyBlock = { kind: 'empty' } | { kind: 'annotation'; n: number } | { kind: 'value'; n: number } | { kind: 'bound'; n: number } | { kind: 'none-match' } | { kind: 'all-match' } | { kind: 'unchanged' } | { kind: 'counting' }`; `export function applyBlock(input: { query: FilterQuery; matched: number | null; total: number; dirty: boolean }): ApplyBlock | null` (null = Apply enabled; order: structural problems first, synchronously — a row with an annotation and no value or bound blocks, an untouched seeded row beside a configured one is ignored, no configured row is `empty`; then `unchanged` when not dirty; then `counting` while `matched` is null; then `none-match`/`all-match`); `export function applyBlockText(block: ApplyBlock): string` (copy table; `counting` → `''`); `export function leafConditions(query: FilterQuery): FilterCondition[]` (display order, groups flattened; index + 1 is the condition's number).
  - `protspace-query-builder`: new property `dirty: boolean | null` (property only, default `null`; set by a host that keeps a draft; `null` means Apply and Cancel ignore it, so embedders that never set it keep today's behaviour); new event `query-cancel` (`{}`, bubbling, composed) from Cancel; `query-close` remains only for the non-embedded close button and Escape; `query-apply` still carries `{ matchedIndices: Set<number> }` and is dispatched only when `applyBlock(...)` is null. Footer: `p.match-count[role=status][aria-live=polite]` "{formatCount(m)} of {countNoun(t,'protein','proteins')} match", `p#apply-reason` (the reason, empty while enabled or counting), then `ps-button variant="danger" class="query-footer-reset"` "Reset", `ps-button variant="secondary" class="query-footer-cancel"` "Cancel" (disabled unless `dirty`), `ps-button variant="primary" class="query-footer-apply"` "Apply" (disabled while blocked, `describedBy` the reason element). import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
```ts
import { sameQuery } from './query-equal';
import type { FilterQuery } from './query-types';

const organism = (values: string[], id = 'a'): FilterQuery[number] => ({
  id,
  kind: 'categorical',
  annotation: 'organism',
  values,
});
const length = (min: number | null, id = 'n'): FilterQuery[number] => ({
  id,
  kind: 'numeric',
  annotation: 'length',
  operator: 'gt',
  min,
  max: null,
  presence: [],
});

describe('sameQuery', () => {
  it('is true for equal trees built separately', () => {
    const a: FilterQuery = [organism(['Human']), { id: 'g', conditions: [length(5)] }];
    const b: FilterQuery = [organism(['Human']), { id: 'g', conditions: [length(5)] }];
    expect(sameQuery(a, b)).toBe(true);
    expect(sameQuery([], [])).toBe(true);
  });

  it('sees a changed value, bound, presence or operator', () => {
    expect(sameQuery([organism(['Human'])], [organism(['Mouse'])])).toBe(false);
    expect(sameQuery([length(5)], [length(6)])).toBe(false);
    expect(
      sameQuery([length(5)], [{ ...(length(5) as object), presence: ['__NA__'] } as FilterQuery[number]]),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      sameQuery([length(5)], [{ ...(length(5) as object), operator: 'gte' } as FilterQuery[number]]),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('sees a changed id or logical operator', () => {
    expect(sameQuery([organism(['Human'], 'a')], [organism(['Human'], 'b')])).toBe(false);
    expect(
      sameQuery(

        [{ ...(organism(['Human']) as object), logicalOp: 'NOT' } as FilterQuery[number]],
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('compares group nesting', () => {
    const grouped: FilterQuery = [{ id: 'g', conditions: [organism(['Human'])] }];
    expect(sameQuery(grouped, [organism(['Human'])])).toBe(false);
    expect(sameQuery(grouped, [{ id: 'g', conditions: [organism(['Mouse'])] }])).toBe(false);
  });

  it('treats order as meaningful', () => {
    expect(
      sameQuery([organism(['Human'], 'a'), length(5)], [length(5), organism(['Human'], 'a')]),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(sameQuery([organism(['Human', 'Mouse'])], [organism(['Mouse', 'Human'])])).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

Create `packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-equal.ts`:

```ts
import type {
  CategoricalCondition,
  FilterQuery,
  FilterQueryItem,
  NumericCondition,
} from './query-types';
import { isFilterGroup } from './query-types';

const sameList = (a: readonly string[], b: readonly string[]): boolean =>
  a.length === b.length && a.every((value, index) => value === b[index]);

function sameItem(a: FilterQueryItem, b: FilterQueryItem): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (a.id !== b.id || a.logicalOp !== b.logicalOp) return false;
  const aGroup = isFilterGroup(a);
  const bGroup = isFilterGroup(b);
  if (aGroup || bGroup) return aGroup && bGroup && sameQuery(a.conditions, b.conditions);
  if (a.kind !== b.kind || a.annotation !== b.annotation) return false;
  if (a.kind === 'categorical') return sameList(a.values, (b as CategoricalCondition).values);
  const numeric = b as NumericCondition;
  return (
    a.operator === numeric.operator &&
    a.min === numeric.min &&
    a.max === numeric.max &&
    sameList(a.presence ?? [], numeric.presence ?? [])
  );
}

/**
 * Whether two queries are the same tree: the same items in the same order, condition ids included
 * (an id is a row's identity in the builder, so a re-created row is a change). The filter
 * controller compares its draft with the applied filter through this to know whether the draft is
 * dirty.
 */
export function sameQuery(a: FilterQuery, b: FilterQuery): boolean {
  if (a === b) return true;
  return a.length === b.length && a.every((item, index) => sameItem(item, b[index]));
}
```

```ts
import type { FilterCondition, FilterQuery, FilterQueryItem } from './query-types';
import { isFilterGroup } from './query-types';
import { isNumericConditionReady } from './query-numeric-helpers';

/** Why Apply is disabled (design decision 14); null from `applyBlock` means it is enabled. */
export type ApplyBlock =
  | { kind: 'empty' }
  | { kind: 'annotation'; n: number }
  | { kind: 'value'; n: number }
  | { kind: 'bound'; n: number }
  | { kind: 'none-match' }
  | { kind: 'all-match' }
  | { kind: 'unchanged' }
  | { kind: 'counting' };

/** The query's conditions in display order, groups flattened; index + 1 is a condition's number. */
export function leafConditions(query: FilterQuery): FilterCondition[] {
  const leaves: FilterCondition[] = [];
  const walk = (items: readonly FilterQueryItem[]) => {
    for (const item of items) {
      if (isFilterGroup(item)) walk(item.conditions);
      else leaves.push(item);
    }
  };
  walk(query);
  return leaves;
}

const isConfigured = (condition: FilterCondition): boolean =>
  condition.kind === 'numeric'
    ? isNumericConditionReady(condition)
    : condition.values.length > 0;

/**
 * A problem with the query's shape, found without counting. A row with an annotation and nothing
 * to match blocks, as does a negated row with no annotation; an untouched row (no annotation, not
 * negated) is a match-all no-op and is ignored. With no configured row at all there is nothing to
 * apply.
 */
function structuralBlock(query: FilterQuery): ApplyBlock | null {
  const leaves = leafConditions(query);
  for (const [index, condition] of leaves.entries()) {
    const n = index + 1;
    if (!condition.annotation) {
      if (condition.logicalOp === 'NOT') return { kind: 'annotation', n };
      continue;
    }
    if (isConfigured(condition)) continue;
    return condition.kind === 'numeric' ? { kind: 'bound', n } : { kind: 'value', n };
  }
  return leaves.some(isConfigured) ? null : { kind: 'empty' };
}

/**
 * Why Apply is disabled, or null when it is enabled. Structural reasons come first and need no
 * count, so they never wait on the 300 ms evaluation; then a draft equal to the applied filter;
 * then, while `matched` is null (the count is pending), a reasonless `counting` so the text never
 * shows a stale number; then a draft that keeps no protein or every protein.
 */
export function applyBlock({
  query,
  matched,
  total,
  dirty,
}: {
  query: FilterQuery;
  matched: number | null;
  total: number;
  /** null: the host keeps no draft, so "unchanged" never applies. */
  dirty: boolean | null;
}): ApplyBlock | null {
  const structural = structuralBlock(query);
  if (structural) return structural;
  if (dirty === false) return { kind: 'unchanged' };
  if (matched === null) return { kind: 'counting' };
  if (matched === 0) return { kind: 'none-match' };
  if (total > 0 && matched >= total) return { kind: 'all-match' };
  return null;
}

/** The visible reason under the count; empty while counting. */
export function applyBlockText(block: ApplyBlock): string {
  switch (block.kind) {
    case 'empty':
      return 'Add a condition';
    case 'annotation':
      return `Choose an annotation for condition ${block.n}`;
    case 'value':
      return `Choose a value for condition ${block.n}`;
    case 'bound':
      return `Enter a number for condition ${block.n}`;
    case 'none-match':
      return 'No proteins match';
    case 'all-match':
      return 'Every protein matches; nothing to filter';
    case 'unchanged':
      return 'No changes to apply';
    case 'counting':
      return '';
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @vitest-environment jsdom
 *
 * Apply-gating contract for the query builder.
 *
 * Unconfigured conditions evaluate as match-all no-ops (so partial queries show live counts), so
 * Apply must stay disabled until a condition is configured, and a query that keeps every protein
 * filters nothing either. Apply now also says why it is disabled (design decision 14), and it is
 * enabled only while the host marks the query `dirty`.
 */
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import './query-builder';
import { createCondition } from './query-types';
import type { FilterQuery } from './query-types';
import type { ProtspaceData } from './types';

interface QueryBuilderInternals extends HTMLElement {
  annotations: string[];
  data: ProtspaceData | undefined;
  query: FilterQuery;
  dirty: boolean | null;
  embedded: boolean;
  _handleApply(): void;
  _handleConditionRemoved(e: CustomEvent<{ id: string }>, groupId: string | null): void;
  updateComplete: Promise<unknown>;
}

type KitButton = HTMLElement & { disabled: boolean };

function makeData(): ProtspaceData {
  return {
    protein_ids: ['P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4', 'P5'],
    annotations: { organism: { values: ['Human', 'Mouse'] } },
    // P1,P3 = Human; P2,P4,P5 = Mouse
    annotation_data: { organism: [[0], [1], [0], [1], [1]] },
  };
}

/** `count` proteins, every one Human. */
function makeHumanData(count: number): ProtspaceData {
  return {
    protein_ids: Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => `P${i}`),
    annotations: { organism: { values: ['Human', 'Mouse'] } },
    annotation_data: { organism: Array.from({ length: count }, () => [0]) },
  };
}

const human = () => createCondition({ annotation: 'organism', values: ['Human'] });

describe('query-builder Apply gating', () => {
  let builder: QueryBuilderInternals;

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
    builder = document.createElement('protspace-query-builder') as QueryBuilderInternals;
    builder.annotations = ['organism'];
    builder.data = makeData();
    builder.dirty = true;
    document.body.appendChild(builder);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  /** Flush the debounced match-count evaluation, then re-render. */
  async function settle() {
    await builder.updateComplete;
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(300);
    await builder.updateComplete;
  }

  const shadow = () => builder.shadowRoot!;
  const applyButton = () => shadow().querySelector('.query-footer-apply') as KitButton;
  const cancelButton = () => shadow().querySelector('.query-footer-cancel') as KitButton;
  const reason = () => shadow().querySelector('#apply-reason')!.textContent!.trim();
  const countLine = () => shadow().querySelector('.match-count')!;

  it('keeps Apply disabled for the seeded unconfigured condition and says to add one', async () => {
    builder.query = [createCondition()];
    await settle();

    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(reason()).toBe('Add a condition');
  });

  it('enables Apply once a condition is configured, with no reason shown', async () => {
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();

    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(false);
    expect(reason()).toBe('');
  });

  it('names the condition that still needs a value', async () => {
    builder.query = [human(), createCondition({ annotation: 'organism', logicalOp: 'AND' })];
    await settle();

    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(reason()).toBe('Choose a value for condition 2');
  });

  it('keeps Apply disabled, with no reason, while the count is pending', async () => {
    builder.query = [human()];
    await builder.updateComplete;

    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(reason()).toBe('');
  });

  it('does not dispatch query-apply for an unconfigured query (defense for non-click paths)', async () => {
    builder.query = [createCondition()];
    await settle();

    const onApply = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-apply', onApply);
    builder._handleApply();

    expect(onApply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('keeps Apply disabled for a configured condition OR a match-all empty condition (result is all proteins)', async () => {
    builder.query = [human(), createCondition({ logicalOp: 'OR' })];
    await settle();

    // Human{2} OR empty{all} = all 5 → filters nothing → Apply disabled.
    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(reason()).toBe('Every protein matches; nothing to filter');
  });

  it('does not dispatch query-apply when the result matches every protein (defense for non-click paths)', async () => {
    builder.query = [human(), createCondition({ logicalOp: 'OR' })];
    await settle();

    const onApply = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-apply', onApply);
    builder._handleApply();

    expect(onApply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('dispatches query-apply for a genuine partial filter (match-all gate is not over-broad)', async () => {
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();

    // Human → 2 of 5 → a real filter.
    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(false);

    const onApply = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-apply', onApply);
    builder._handleApply();

    expect(onApply).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('query-apply is not dispatched while blocked: a clean query says there is nothing to apply', async () => {
    builder.dirty = false;
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();

    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(reason()).toBe('No changes to apply');
    const onApply = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-apply', onApply);
    builder._handleApply();
    expect(onApply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('without a host-set dirty, Apply follows the count alone', async () => {
    builder.dirty = null;
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();

    expect(applyButton().disabled).toBe(false);
    expect(cancelButton().disabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('Cancel dispatches query-cancel and is disabled when not dirty', async () => {
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();
    const onCancel = vi.fn();
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-cancel', onCancel);
    builder.addEventListener('query-close', onClose);

    expect(cancelButton().disabled).toBe(false);
    cancelButton().click();
    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    builder.dirty = false;
    await builder.updateComplete;
    expect(cancelButton().disabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it('the count line is role=status with grouped, plural-aware text', async () => {
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();
    expect(countLine().getAttribute('role')).toBe('status');
    expect(countLine().getAttribute('aria-live')).toBe('polite');
    expect(countLine().textContent!.trim()).toBe('2 of 5 proteins match');

    builder.data = makeHumanData(1234);
    await settle();
    expect(countLine().textContent!.trim()).toBe('1,234 of 1,234 proteins match');

    builder.data = makeHumanData(1);
    await settle();
    expect(countLine().textContent!.trim()).toBe('1 of 1 protein match');
  });

  it('names the footer buttons Reset, Cancel and Apply', async () => {
    builder.query = [human()];
    await settle();
    expect(
      ['.query-footer-reset', '.query-footer-cancel', '.query-footer-apply'].map((selector) =>
        shadow().querySelector(selector)!.textContent!.trim(),
      ),
    ).toEqual(['Reset', 'Cancel', 'Apply']);
  });
});

describe('query-builder removal normalizes the new first item operator', () => {
  let builder: QueryBuilderInternals;

  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
    builder = document.createElement('protspace-query-builder') as QueryBuilderInternals;
    builder.annotations = ['organism'];
    builder.data = makeData();
    document.body.appendChild(builder);
  });

  function removeAndCaptureQuery(removeId: string): FilterQuery {
    let captured: FilterQuery | undefined;
    builder.addEventListener('query-changed', (e: Event) => {
      captured = (e as CustomEvent<{ query: FilterQuery }>).detail.query;
    });
    builder._handleConditionRemoved(
      new CustomEvent('condition-removed', { detail: { id: removeId } }),
      null,
    );
    if (!captured) throw new Error('query-changed not dispatched');
    return captured;
  }

  it("clears a leftover 'OR' on the new first item after removing the original first", () => {
    const a = createCondition();
    const b = createCondition({ logicalOp: 'OR' });
    builder.query = [a, b];

    const result = removeAndCaptureQuery(a.id);

    expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result[0].id).toBe(b.id);
    expect(result[0].logicalOp).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("clears a leftover 'AND' on the new first item after removing the original first", () => {
    const a = createCondition();
    const b = createCondition({ logicalOp: 'AND' });
    builder.query = [a, b];

    const result = removeAndCaptureQuery(a.id);

    expect(result[0].id).toBe(b.id);
    expect(result[0].logicalOp).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("preserves a leftover 'NOT' on the new first item (displayable and meaningful)", () => {
    const a = createCondition();
    const b = createCondition({ logicalOp: 'NOT' });
    builder.query = [a, b];

    const result = removeAndCaptureQuery(a.id);

    expect(result[0].id).toBe(b.id);
    expect(result[0].logicalOp).toBe('NOT');
  });
});

describe('query-builder embedded in a host', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
  });

  async function mountEmbedded(): Promise<QueryBuilderInternals> {
    const builder = document.createElement('protspace-query-builder') as QueryBuilderInternals;
    builder.embedded = true;
    builder.annotations = ['organism'];
    builder.data = makeData();
    builder.query = [createCondition()];
    document.body.appendChild(builder);
    await builder.updateComplete;
    return builder;
  }

  it('embedded hides the title and close button and keeps the match count and the footer', async () => {
    const builder = await mountEmbedded();
    const root = builder.shadowRoot!;

    expect(builder.hasAttribute('embedded')).toBe(true);
    expect(root.querySelector('.query-header')).toBeNull();
    expect(root.querySelector('.btn-close')).toBeNull();
    expect(root.querySelector('.match-count')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(root.querySelector('.query-footer-reset')).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('embedded leaves Escape to the host', async () => {
    const builder = await mountEmbedded();
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-close', onClose);

    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }));

    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('standalone, the close button and Escape dispatch query-close', async () => {
    const builder = document.createElement('protspace-query-builder') as QueryBuilderInternals;
    builder.query = [createCondition()];
    document.body.appendChild(builder);
    await builder.updateComplete;
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    builder.addEventListener('query-close', onClose);

    (builder.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.btn-close') as HTMLElement).click();
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true }));

    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { adoptTheme } from '../kit/adopt-theme';
import type { PsButton, PsIconButton } from '../kit/button';
import type { ProtspaceQueryBuilder } from './query-builder';
import './query-builder';
import { createCondition, createGroup } from './query-types';
import type { FilterQuery } from './query-types';
import type { ProtspaceData } from './types';

beforeAll(() => adoptTheme());
afterEach(() => document.body.replaceChildren());

const data: ProtspaceData = {
  protein_ids: ['P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4', 'P5'],
  annotations: { organism: { kind: 'categorical', values: ['Human', 'Mouse'] } },
  annotation_data: { organism: [[0], [1], [0], [1], [1]] },
};

type Row = HTMLElement & { updateComplete: Promise<unknown> };

async function mount(query: FilterQuery, width = 360): Promise<ProtspaceQueryBuilder> {
  const builder = document.createElement('protspace-query-builder');
  builder.embedded = true;
  builder.dirty = true;
  builder.annotations = ['organism'];
  builder.data = data;
  builder.query = query;
  builder.style.cssText = `display: block; width: ${width}px; height: 600px`;
  document.body.append(builder);
  await builder.updateComplete;
  for (const row of rows(builder)) await row.updateComplete;
  return builder;
}

const rows = (builder: ProtspaceQueryBuilder): Row[] => [
  ...builder.shadowRoot!.querySelectorAll<Row>('protspace-query-condition-row'),
];
const inner = (button: PsButton | PsIconButton) => button.shadowRoot!.querySelector('button')!;

describe('protspace-query-builder in a narrow panel', () => {
  it('Apply is described by the visible reason', async () => {
    const builder = await mount([createCondition({ annotation: 'organism' })]);
    const apply = builder.shadowRoot!.querySelector<PsButton>('.query-footer-apply')!;
    await apply.updateComplete;
    const reason = builder.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#apply-reason')!;

    expect(reason.textContent!.trim()).toBe('Choose a value for condition 1');
    expect(reason.checkVisibility()).toBe(true);
    expect(inner(apply).disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(inner(apply).ariaDescribedByElements?.[0]).toBe(reason);
  });

  it('the ✕ buttons are named Remove condition / Remove group', async () => {
    const builder = await mount([createGroup()]);
    const removeGroup = builder.shadowRoot!.querySelector<PsIconButton>(
      '.group-header .condition-remove',
    )!;
    await removeGroup.updateComplete;
    expect(inner(removeGroup).getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Remove group');

    const removeRow = rows(builder)[0].shadowRoot!.querySelector<PsIconButton>('.condition-remove')!;
    await removeRow.updateComplete;
    expect(inner(removeRow).getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Remove condition');
  });

  it('at 260 px wide a row stacks and nothing overflows horizontally', async () => {
    const builder = await mount(
      [createCondition({ annotation: 'organism', values: ['Human', 'Mouse'] })],
      260,
    );
    const row = rows(builder)[0];
    const root = row.shadowRoot!;
    const trigger = root.querySelector('.annotation-select-trigger')!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const values = root.querySelector('.condition-values')!.getBoundingClientRect();
    const box = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.condition-row')!;

    expect(values.top).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(trigger.bottom - 1);
    expect(box.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(box.clientWidth);
    expect(row.getBoundingClientRect().right).toBeLessThanOrEqual(
      builder.getBoundingClientRect().right + 0.5,
    );
    const footer = builder.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.query-footer')!;
    expect(footer.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(footer.clientWidth);
  });

  it('rows show their numbers, group leaves included', async () => {
    const builder = await mount([
      createCondition({ annotation: 'organism', values: ['Human'] }),
      createGroup({
        logicalOp: 'AND',
        conditions: [createCondition(), createCondition({ logicalOp: 'OR' })],
      }),
    ]);
    const all = rows(builder);
    expect(
      all.map((row) => row.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.condition-number')!.textContent!.trim()),
    ).toEqual(['1', '2', '3']);
    expect(
      all.map((row) => row.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.condition-row')!.getAttribute('aria-label')),
    ).toEqual(['Condition 1', 'Condition 2', 'Condition 3']);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { css } from 'lit';
import { focusRing } from '../kit/kit-shared.styles';

/**
 * The query builder's sheet, shared by the builder, its condition rows, the value picker and the
 * numeric input (each has its own shadow root). Every colour and type size reads a --ps-* token.
 *
 * The rows stack: number, operator, annotation and ✕ on the first line, the values below, which is
 * what a 240–480 px sidebar panel needs. The two pickers stay `position: fixed` against a measured
 * trigger, so no ancestor of the Filter panel may get a transform, filter, contain or
 * container-type.
 */
export const queryBuilderStyles = [
  focusRing,
  css`
    :host {
      font-family: var(--ps-font-sans);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-base);
      line-height: var(--ps-leading-tight);
      color: var(--ps-text);
    }

    button,
    select,
    input {
      font: inherit;
      color: inherit;
    }

    /* ── The builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .query-builder {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--ps-space-3);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      padding: var(--ps-space-3);
    }

    .query-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    .query-title {
      font-size: var(--ps-text-md);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-semibold);
    }

    .query-conditions {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
      min-height: 0;
      overflow-y: auto;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    .query-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-3);
    }

    .btn-link {
      padding: var(--ps-space-0-5) var(--ps-space-1);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-sm);
      background: none;
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-medium);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-link:hover {
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .query-footer {
      display: flex;
      flex: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1-5);
      padding-top: var(--ps-space-2);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--ps-border);
    }

    .match-count,
    .apply-reason {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      line-height: var(--ps-leading-normal);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .match-count {
      color: var(--ps-text);
    }

    /* Room for one line even while empty, so the buttons do not jump when a reason appears. */
    .apply-reason {
      min-height: calc(var(--ps-text-sm) * var(--ps-leading-normal));
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
    }

    .query-footer-buttons {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    .query-footer-reset {
      margin-inline-end: auto;
    }

    /* ── Groups ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .group-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
      padding-left: var(--ps-space-2);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--ps-border);
    }

    .group-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    .group-label {
      flex: 1;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-semibold);
    }

    .group-conditions {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    /* ── A condition row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .condition-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-areas:
        'number op annotation remove'
        'values values values values';
      grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1-5);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      padding: var(--ps-space-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: var(--ps-surface);
    }

    .condition-number {
      grid-area: number;
      min-width: 1.25em;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      text-align: right;
    }

    .condition-row > .logical-op-select {
      grid-area: op;
    }

    .condition-row > .condition-remove {
      grid-area: remove;
    }

    .condition-values {
      grid-area: values;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    /* Native selects: keyboard, mobile and screen-reader support for free. */
    .logical-op-select,
    .numeric-operator-select {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      height: var(--ps-control-sm);
      padding: 0 var(--ps-space-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border-control);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: var(--ps-surface);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .logical-op-select {
      min-width: 4.5rem;
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-medium);
    }

    .logical-op-select.op-blank {
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
    }

    .logical-op-placeholder {
      flex: none;
      width: 4.5rem;
    }

    .annotation-select-trigger {
      grid-area: annotation;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      min-width: 0;
      height: var(--ps-control-sm);
      padding: 0 var(--ps-space-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border-control);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: var(--ps-surface);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .logical-op-select:hover,
    .numeric-operator-select:hover:not(:disabled),
    .annotation-select-trigger:hover {
      border-color: var(--ps-border-strong);
      background: var(--ps-surface-hover);
    }

    .dropdown-trigger-text,
    .dropdown-item-label {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .predicted-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      flex: none;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
      line-height: 1;
      cursor: default;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* ── Value chips ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .value-chips {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .value-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      max-width: 160px;
      height: 22px;
      padding: 0 var(--ps-space-1) 0 var(--ps-space-2);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-full);
      background: var(--ps-accent-tint);
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
    }

    .value-chip-text {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .value-chip-remove {
      display: inline-flex;
      flex: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      color: inherit;
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      line-height: 1;
      opacity: 0.7;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .value-chip-remove:hover {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .value-chip-add {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      height: 22px;
      padding: 0 var(--ps-space-2);
      border: 1px dashed var(--ps-accent);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-full);
      background: none;
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .value-chip-add:hover {
      background: var(--ps-accent-tint);
    }

    /* ── The annotation and value pickers ────────────────────────────────── */

    /* position: fixed against a measured trigger, so a scrolling panel cannot clip them. */
    .annotation-picker,
    .value-picker {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 1001;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      min-width: 200px;
      max-width: 280px;
      padding: var(--ps-space-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: var(--ps-surface-raised);
      box-shadow: var(--ps-shadow-lg);
    }

    .annotation-picker-input,
    .value-picker-input,
    .numeric-field {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      height: var(--ps-control-sm);
      padding: 0 var(--ps-space-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border-control);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: var(--ps-surface);
      color: var(--ps-text);
    }

    .annotation-picker-input,
    .value-picker-input {
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-1);
    }

    .annotation-picker-input::placeholder,
    .value-picker-input::placeholder,
    .numeric-field::placeholder {
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
    }

    /* Inside a tight box the ring sits on the border rather than 2 px outside it. */
    .annotation-picker-input:focus-visible,
    .value-picker-input:focus-visible,
    .numeric-field:focus-visible {
      outline-offset: -1px;
    }

    .value-picker-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      max-height: 15rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    /* The options carry no tabindex: focus stays in the search input and .highlighted is the
       keyboard cursor (aria-activedescendant). */
    .dropdown-item {
      padding: var(--ps-space-1-5) var(--ps-space-2);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-sm);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .dropdown-item:hover,
    .dropdown-item.highlighted {
      background: var(--ps-accent-tint);
    }

    .value-picker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    .annotation-picker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    .annotation-picker-item[aria-selected='true'] {
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-medium);
    }

    /* Locked out while the "Any value" sentinel is selected (it subsumes them). */
    .value-picker-item.is-disabled,
    .value-picker-item.is-disabled:hover,
    .value-picker-item.is-disabled.highlighted {
      background: none;
      color: var(--ps-text-faint);
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .value-picker-highlight {
      background: none;
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-semibold);
    }

    .value-picker-count {
      flex: none;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .value-picker-footer {
      margin-top: var(--ps-space-1);
      padding-top: var(--ps-space-1);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--ps-border);
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .annotation-picker-category {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      padding: var(--ps-space-2) var(--ps-space-2) var(--ps-space-1);
      background: var(--ps-surface-raised);
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-semibold);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      .dropdown-item.highlighted {
        outline: 1px solid Highlight;
      }
    }

    /* ── The numeric input ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    .numeric-input {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
    }

    .numeric-field {
      width: 84px;
    }

    .numeric-field:disabled,
    .numeric-operator-select:disabled {
      background: var(--ps-surface-muted);
      color: var(--ps-text-faint);
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .numeric-dash {
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
    }

    .numeric-match-count {
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
  `,
];

export const queryBuilderHostStyles = css`
  :host {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  /* Embedded in the app's Filter panel, whose body already pads its content. */
  :host([embedded]) .query-builder {
    padding: 0;
  }
`;
```

- [ ] **Step 10: The builder: count line, reason, Cancel, numbered rows**

Replace `packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-builder.ts` with:

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing } from 'lit';
import { property, state } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import { countNoun, formatCount } from '@protspace/utils';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import '../kit/button';
import type { PsButton } from '../kit/button';
import type { ProtspaceData } from './types';
import type { FilterCondition, FilterGroup, FilterQuery, LogicalOp } from './query-types';
import { clearLeadingOpInList, createCondition, createGroup, isFilterGroup } from './query-types';
import { evaluateQuery, evaluateQueryExcluding } from './query-evaluate';
import { applyBlock, applyBlockText, leafConditions } from './query-apply-state';
import { queryBuilderHostStyles, queryBuilderStyles } from './query-builder.styles';
import './query-condition-row';

/**
 * The filter's query builder (design decision 14): conditions and groups, a live count of the
 * proteins the query keeps, and Apply, which says why it is disabled.
 *
 * A host that keeps a draft (the app's Filter panel) owns the query and whether it differs from the
 * filter last applied (`dirty`): Cancel is enabled, and Apply can apply, only while it does. A host
 * that never sets `dirty` (null) keeps the earlier behaviour: Apply follows the count alone.
 *
 * Events:
 * - `query-changed` — the query was edited; detail `{ query: FilterQuery }`. Set `query` back.
 * - `query-apply`   — Apply; detail `{ matchedIndices: Set<number> }` (indices into `data`)
 * - `query-reset`   — Reset
 * - `query-cancel`  — Cancel: return the query to the filter last applied
 * - `query-close`   — the close button or Escape, only when not `embedded`
 */
@customElement('protspace-query-builder')
export class ProtspaceQueryBuilder extends LitElement {
  static styles = [queryBuilderStyles, queryBuilderHostStyles];

  @property({ type: Array }) annotations: string[] = [];
  @property({ type: Object }) data: ProtspaceData | undefined = undefined;
  @property({ type: Array }) query: FilterQuery = [];
  /**
   * The query differs from the filter last applied; set by a host that keeps a draft. null (unset):
   * Apply and Cancel ignore it.
   */
  @property({ attribute: false }) dirty: boolean | null = null;
  /**
   * Hosted by a panel or dialog that brings its own heading (the app's Filter panel): the builder
   * then shows neither its title nor its close button, and leaves Escape to the host.
   */
  @property({ type: Boolean, reflect: true }) embedded = false;

  @state() private _matchedIndices: Set<number> = new Set();
  @state() private _excludedMatchMap: Map<string, Set<number>> = new Map();
  @state() private _totalCount: number = 0;
  /** A count is pending (the 300 ms debounce): Apply waits, with no reason text. */
  @state() private _counting = true;

  private _debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  // ─── Lifecycle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private _onKeydown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    // Embedded, the host owns Escape; a document listener here would dispatch query-close for
    // every Escape on the page.
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !this.embedded) {
      this._handleClose();
    }
  };

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
  }

  // Set here rather than in updated(): a state change in willUpdate joins this update, so Apply is
  // disabled in the same frame the query changes instead of trusting the previous count.
  willUpdate(changedProperties: Map<string, unknown>) {
    if (changedProperties.has('data') || changedProperties.has('query')) {
      this._counting = true;
    }
  }

  updated(changedProperties: Map<string, unknown>) {
    if (changedProperties.has('data') || changedProperties.has('query')) {
      this._scheduleEvaluation(this.query);
    }
    // An id reference cannot reach into the button's shadow root: hand it the element.
    const apply = this.renderRoot.querySelector<PsButton>('.query-footer-apply');
    const reason = this.renderRoot.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#apply-reason');
    if (apply && reason && apply.describedBy[0] !== reason) apply.describedBy = [reason];
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    super.disconnectedCallback();
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
    if (this._debounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this._debounceTimer);
      this._debounceTimer = null;
    }
  }

  // ─── Match Count (debounced) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  private _scheduleEvaluation(query: FilterQuery) {
    if (this._debounceTimer) clearTimeout(this._debounceTimer);
    this._debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this._debounceTimer = null;
      if (!this.data) return;
      this._matchedIndices = evaluateQuery(query, this.data);
      this._totalCount = this.data.protein_ids?.length ?? 0;

      // Build per-condition "excluded" matched sets for dynamic value counts
      const map = new Map<string, Set<number>>();
      for (const item of query) {
        if (isFilterGroup(item)) {
          for (const cond of item.conditions) {
            map.set(cond.id, evaluateQueryExcluding(query, this.data, cond.id));
          }
        } else {
          map.set(item.id, evaluateQueryExcluding(query, this.data, item.id));
        }
      }
      this._excludedMatchMap = map;
      this._counting = false;
    }, 300);
  }

  // ─── Dispatch helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private _dispatch(type: string, detail: unknown = {}) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail, bubbles: true, composed: true }));
  }

  private _dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery: FilterQuery) {
    // The host sets `query` back, and updated() recounts.
    this._dispatch('query-changed', { query: newQuery });
  }

  // ─── Query mutations ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private _addCondition() {
    const newQuery = [
      ...this.query,
      createCondition({ logicalOp: this.query.length > 0 ? 'AND' : undefined }),
    ];
    this._dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery);
  }

  private _addGroup() {
    const group = createGroup({ logicalOp: this.query.length > 0 ? 'AND' : undefined });
    this._dispatchQueryChanged([...this.query, group]);
  }

  private _addConditionToGroup(groupId: string) {
    const newQuery = this.query.map((item) => {
      if (isFilterGroup(item) && item.id === groupId) {
        return {
          ...item,
          conditions: [
            ...item.conditions,
            createCondition({
              logicalOp: item.conditions.length > 0 ? 'AND' : undefined,
            }),
          ],
        };
      }
      return item;
    });
    this._dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery);
  }

  private _handleConditionChanged(
    e: CustomEvent<{ condition: FilterCondition }>,
    groupId: string | null,
  ) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const updated = e.detail.condition;
    if (groupId === null) {
      const newQuery = this.query.map((item) =>
        !isFilterGroup(item) && item.id === updated.id ? updated : item,
      );
      this._dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery);
    } else {
      const newQuery = this.query.map((item) => {
        if (isFilterGroup(item) && item.id === groupId) {
          return {
            ...item,
            conditions: item.conditions.map((c) =>
              !isFilterGroup(c) && c.id === updated.id ? updated : c,
            ),
          };
        }
        return item;
      });
      this._dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery);
    }
  }

  private _handleConditionRemoved(e: CustomEvent<{ id: string }>, groupId: string | null) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const removedId = e.detail.id;
    if (groupId === null) {
      const filtered = this.query.filter((item) => item.id !== removedId);
      this._dispatchQueryChanged(clearLeadingOpInList(filtered));
    } else {
      const newQuery = this.query.map((item) => {
        if (isFilterGroup(item) && item.id === groupId) {
          const conditions = item.conditions.filter((c) => c.id !== removedId);
          return { ...item, conditions: clearLeadingOpInList(conditions) };
        }
        return item;
      });
      this._dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery);
    }
  }

  private _removeGroup(groupId: string) {
    this._dispatchQueryChanged(this.query.filter((item) => item.id !== groupId));
  }

  private _handleGroupLogicalOpChange(groupId: string, e: Event) {
    const value = (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as LogicalOp;
    const newQuery = this.query.map((item) =>
      isFilterGroup(item) && item.id === groupId ? { ...item, logicalOp: value } : item,
    );
    this._dispatchQueryChanged(newQuery);
  }

  // ─── Apply, Reset, Cancel, Close ──────────────────────────────────────────

  private _handleApply() {
    if (!this.data) return;
    // Evaluated afresh, so a click inside the debounce window applies what the rows say. The same
    // gate as the button, for callers that bypass the click: an unconfigured or unchanged query,
    // or one that keeps no protein or every protein, applies nothing.
    const result = evaluateQuery(this.query, this.data);
    const total = this.data.protein_ids?.length ?? 0;
    if (applyBlock({ query: this.query, matched: result.size, total, dirty: this.dirty })) return;
    this._dispatch('query-apply', { matchedIndices: result });
  }

  private _handleReset() {
    this._dispatch('query-reset');
  }

  private _handleCancel() {
    if (this.dirty === false) return;
    this._dispatch('query-cancel');
  }

  private _handleClose() {
    this._dispatch('query-close');
  }

  // ─── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private _renderRow(
    condition: FilterCondition,
    isFirst: boolean,
    numbers: ReadonlyMap<string, number>,
    groupId: string | null,
  ) {
    return html`
      <protspace-query-condition-row
        .condition=${condition}
        .annotations=${this.annotations}
        .data=${this.data}
        .matchedIndices=${this._excludedMatchMap.get(condition.id) ?? this._matchedIndices}
        .isFirst=${isFirst}
        .number=${numbers.get(condition.id) ?? 0}
        @condition-changed=${(e: CustomEvent) => this._handleConditionChanged(e, groupId)}
        @condition-removed=${(e: CustomEvent) => this._handleConditionRemoved(e, groupId)}
      ></protspace-query-condition-row>
    `;
  }

  private _renderGroup(
    group: FilterGroup,
    groupIndex: number,
    numbers: ReadonlyMap<string, number>,
  ) {
    return html`
      <div class="group-container">
        <div class="group-header">
          ${groupIndex > 0
            ? html`<select
                class="logical-op-select"
                aria-label="Operator for the group"
                .value=${group.logicalOp ?? 'AND'}
                @change=${(e: Event) => this._handleGroupLogicalOpChange(group.id, e)}
              >
                <option value="AND">AND</option>
                <option value="OR">OR</option>
                <option value="NOT">NOT</option>
              </select>`
            : html`<div class="logical-op-placeholder"></div>`}
          <span class="group-label">Group</span>
          <ps-icon-button
            class="condition-remove"
            icon="x"
            size="sm"
            label="Remove group"
            @click=${() => this._removeGroup(group.id)}
          ></ps-icon-button>
        </div>
        <div class="group-conditions">
          ${group.conditions.map((item, index) =>
            this._renderRow(item as FilterCondition, index === 0, numbers, group.id),
          )}
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn-link" @click=${() => this._addConditionToGroup(group.id)}>
          + Add group condition
        </button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  render() {
    const total = this._totalCount;
    const block = applyBlock({
      query: this.query,
      matched: this._counting ? null : this._matchedIndices.size,
      total,
      dirty: this.dirty,
    });
    // The number each condition is called by in the reason text, group leaves included.
    const numbers = new Map(leafConditions(this.query).map((leaf, index) => [leaf.id, index + 1]));
    return html`
      <div class="query-builder">
        ${this.embedded
          ? nothing
          : html`<div class="query-header">
              <span class="query-title">Filter Query</span>
              <ps-icon-button
                class="btn-close"
                icon="x"
                label="Close filter query builder"
                @click=${this._handleClose}
              ></ps-icon-button>
            </div>`}

        <div class="query-conditions">
          ${this.query.map((item, index) =>
            isFilterGroup(item)
              ? this._renderGroup(item, index, numbers)
              : this._renderRow(item, index === 0, numbers, null),
          )}
          <div class="query-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn-link" @click=${this._addCondition}>
              + Add condition
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-link" @click=${this._addGroup}>+ Add group</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="query-footer">
          <p class="match-count" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            ${total > 0
              ? `${formatCount(this._matchedIndices.size)} of ${countNoun(total, 'protein', 'proteins')} match`
              : ''}
          </p>
          <p id="apply-reason" class="apply-reason">${block ? applyBlockText(block) : ''}</p>
          <div class="query-footer-buttons">
            <ps-button class="query-footer-reset" variant="danger" @click=${this._handleReset}
              >Reset</ps-button
            >
            <ps-button
              class="query-footer-cancel"
              variant="secondary"
              .disabled=${this.dirty === false}
              @click=${this._handleCancel}
              >Cancel</ps-button
            >
            <ps-button
              class="query-footer-apply"
              variant="primary"
              .disabled=${block !== null}
              @click=${this._handleApply}
              >Apply</ps-button
            >
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

  }
}
```

### Task 4.5: Filter panel in the sidebar with a draft

The query builder becomes the sidebar's Filter panel, opened from the rail's new Filter item, the view bar's Filter button or the filter chip; the legend hides while it shows and the structure stays docked below (decisions 2, 14). Edits are a draft: Apply writes the filter and keeps the panel open, Cancel returns the draft to the applied filter, Reset and the chip's ✕ remove the filter. The EAT slider stays an immediate control that writes the applied filter and mirrors into the draft. The Filter dialog goes.
