/**
 * The filter as the sidebar's Filter panel builds it (design decision 14), driven by fakes.
 *
 * A query is applied through the plot's dedicated, idempotent filter channel
 * (`filteredProteinIds` / `filtersActive`): a filter is neither a selection nor an isolation.
 * Matched indices are positions in the materialized snapshot the builder evaluated; translating
 * them through the isolated subset shrank the result on every re-apply (#257).
 *
 * Edits are a draft until Apply. The legend's EAT reliability control writes the applied filter at
 * once and mirrors into the draft; the applied query moves the control back (#6b, #380). The
 * column is found by its runtime role, not its `__eat_confidence` suffix, so the collision-renamed
 * `__runtime_N` variant works too.
 */
import type { ProtspaceLegend, ProtspaceQueryBuilder, ProtspaceScatterplot } from '@protspace/core';
import { NA_VALUE, NEUTRAL_BOUND, type VisualizationData } from '@protspace/utils';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { findConditionsForAnnotation } from '../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-annotation-conditions';
import {
  createCondition,
  type FilterQuery,
  type NumericCondition,
} from '../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-types';
import {
  createFilterController,
  type FilterCommit,
  type FilterController,
  type FilterSnapshot,
} from './filter-controller';
import { getWorkbenchStatus, resetWorkbenchStatusForTests } from './workbench-status';

// Lit cannot load in node: stand in for @protspace/core with its pure query helpers, read from
// core's source.
vi.mock('@protspace/core', async () => {
  const types = await import('../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-types');
  const evaluate =
    await import('../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-evaluate');
  const conditions =
    await import('../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-annotation-conditions');
  const reliability =
    await import('../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/eat-reliability');
  const equal = await import('../../../../packages/core/src/components/query-builder/query-equal');
  return {
    createCondition: types.createCondition,
    evaluateQuery: evaluate.evaluateQuery,
    hasConfiguredCondition: evaluate.hasConfiguredCondition,
    findConditionsForAnnotation: conditions.findConditionsForAnnotation,
    replaceConditionsForAnnotation: conditions.replaceConditionsForAnnotation,
    conditionsForReliability: reliability.conditionsForReliability,
    reliabilityFromConditions: reliability.reliabilityFromConditions,
    sameConditions: reliability.sameConditions,
    sameQuery: equal.sameQuery,
  };
});

/** Fixtures carry only what the filter reads, so they go through `unknown`. */
const asData = (data: unknown) => data as VisualizationData;
const range = (count: number) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i);
const ids = (count: number) => range(count).map((i) => `p${i}`);

/** A full dataset of `count` proteins: p0, p1, … p{count-1}. */
const makeFullData = (count: number) => asData({ protein_ids: ids(count), annotations: {} });

const EAT_KEY = 'family__eat_confidence__runtime_2';

/**
 * 20 proteins: p0–p4 curated (null confidence), p5–p19 predicted with confidence i/20
 * (0.25 … 0.95). The eat-confidence column carries an explicit runtime role and base.
 */
function makeEatData(): VisualizationData {
  return asData({
    protein_ids: ids(20),
    annotations: {
      family: { kind: 'categorical', values: ['A'], colors: ['#000'], shapes: ['circle'] },
      gene_name: { kind: 'categorical', values: ['g'], colors: ['#000'], shapes: ['circle'] },
      [EAT_KEY]: {
        kind: 'numeric',
        values: [],
        runtime: { role: 'eat-confidence', baseAnnotation: 'family' },
      },
    },
    numeric_annotation_data: {
      [EAT_KEY]: Float64Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => (i < 5 ? NaN : i / 20)),
    },
  });
}

const EC_KEY = 'ec__eat_confidence__runtime_1';
const GO_KEY = 'go__eat_confidence__runtime_2';

/** Two EAT bases, each with its own eat-confidence column. */
function makeMultiEatData(): VisualizationData {
  const confidence = () => Float64Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => (i < 5 ? NaN : i / 20));
  return asData({
    protein_ids: ids(20),
    annotations: {
      ec: { kind: 'categorical', values: ['A'], colors: ['#000'], shapes: ['circle'] },
      go: { kind: 'categorical', values: ['A'], colors: ['#000'], shapes: ['circle'] },
      [EC_KEY]: {
        kind: 'numeric',
        values: [],
        runtime: { role: 'eat-confidence', baseAnnotation: 'ec' },
      },
      [GO_KEY]: {
        kind: 'numeric',
        values: [],
        runtime: { role: 'eat-confidence', baseAnnotation: 'go' },
      },
    },
    numeric_annotation_data: { [EC_KEY]: confidence(), [GO_KEY]: confidence() },
  });
}

/**
 * The controller with fakes for everything it touches. `getCurrentData` returns an isolated
 * subset on purpose: matched indices must never be translated through it (#257). `panel.show()`
 * and `panel.hide()` stand in for the layout store.
 */
function mount(
  makeData: () => VisualizationData,
  { selectedAnnotation, shown = true }: { selectedAnnotation?: string; shown?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const plot = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), {
    filteredProteinIds: [] as string[],
    filtersActive: false,
    // A sentinel selection: a filter must leave it untouched.
    selectedProteinIds: ['sentinel'],
    isolateSelection: vi.fn(),
    getCurrentData: vi.fn(() => asData({ protein_ids: ['p0', 'p1'], annotations: {} })),
    getMaterializedData: vi.fn((): VisualizationData | null => makeData()),
  });
  const legend = { setReliabilityState: vi.fn() };
  const queryBuilder = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), {
    annotations: [] as string[],
    data: undefined as VisualizationData | undefined,
    query: [] as FilterQuery,
    dirty: false,
    closePopups: vi.fn(),
  });
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  const panel = {
    shown,
    show() {
      panel.shown = true;
      for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
    },
    hide() {
      panel.shown = false;
      for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
    },
    listenerCount: () => listeners.size,
  };
  const commits: FilterCommit[] = [];
  const root = new EventTarget();
  const controller = createFilterController({
    plotElement: plot as unknown as ProtspaceScatterplot,
    legendElement: legend as unknown as ProtspaceLegend,
    queryBuilder: queryBuilder as unknown as ProtspaceQueryBuilder,
    root: root as unknown as Document,
    isPanelShown: () => panel.shown,
    subscribePanel(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    },
    onFilterCommitted: (commit) => commits.push(commit),
  });
  // The plot's data-change hands the controller its first snapshot, as the runtime's load does.
  fire(plot, 'data-change', { data: makeData() });
  if (selectedAnnotation !== undefined) controller.setSelectedAnnotation(selectedAnnotation);
  // Mounting with an annotation mirrors once; the tests count only what they cause.
  legend.setReliabilityState.mockClear();
  return { controller, plot, legend, queryBuilder, panel, root, commits };
}

const fire = (target: EventTarget, type: string, detail?: unknown) =>
  target.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type, { detail }));
const apply = (queryBuilder: EventTarget, indices: Iterable<number>) =>
  fire(queryBuilder, 'query-apply', { matchedIndices: new Set(indices) });
const editQuery = (queryBuilder: EventTarget, query: FilterQuery) =>
  fire(queryBuilder, 'query-changed', { query });
/** The legend slider's scalar form: "hide below `x`". */
const threshold = (controller: FilterController, base: string, x: number) =>
  controller.setEatReliability(base, { mode: 'atLeast', min: x, max: NEUTRAL_BOUND.max });
/** A categorical condition with a value picked, so it constrains the query. */
const configured = (id: string): FilterQuery[number] => ({
  id,
  kind: 'categorical',
  annotation: 'family',
  values: ['A'],
});
const numericCount = (query: FilterQuery) =>
  query.filter((item) => 'kind' in item && item.kind === 'numeric').length;
/** The column's live reliability condition, which is always the first (and only) one. */
const eatCondition = (query: FilterQuery, key: string = EAT_KEY): NumericCondition | undefined =>
  findConditionsForAnnotation(query, key)[0];
const applied = (controller: FilterController): FilterQuery => controller.getApplied().query;

beforeEach(() => {
  resetWorkbenchStatusForTests();
});

describe('filter controller: the Filter panel and its draft', () => {
  let m: ReturnType<typeof mount>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    m = mount(() => makeFullData(100));
  });

  it('a shown panel gets one empty condition, the materialized snapshot and a clean state', () => {
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query[0]).toMatchObject({ annotation: '', values: [] });
    expect(m.queryBuilder.data?.protein_ids).toHaveLength(100);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.getMaterializedData).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('the builder lists every annotation except the tooltip-only ones', () => {
    const eat = mount(makeEatData);
    expect(eat.queryBuilder.annotations).toEqual(['family', EAT_KEY]);
  });

  it('a draft edit does not touch the plot until Apply', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);

    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toEqual([configured('a')]);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(true);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual([]);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
    expect(m.commits).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('applies a query via the filter channel without selecting or isolating', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));

    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual(ids(30));
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);
    expect(m.plot.isolateSelection).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(m.plot.selectedProteinIds).toEqual(['sentinel']);
  });

  it('Apply applies, keeps the draft clean and fires apply with before and after snapshots', () => {
    const draft = [configured('a')];
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, draft);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));

    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(1);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(draft);
    expect(m.commits).toHaveLength(1);
    const [commit] = m.commits;
    expect(commit.cause).toBe('apply');
    expect(commit.before).toEqual({ query: [], matchedIds: null });
    expect(commit.after.query).toBe(draft);
    expect(commit.after.matchedIds).toEqual(ids(30));
    // The plot holds the very array the snapshot records: undo writes it back, never a copy.
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toBe(commit.after.matchedIds);
    expect(m.controller.getApplied()).toBe(commit.after);
  });

  it('the count is the applied filter’s: a row added after Apply does not change it', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));

    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a'), createCondition()]);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(1);

    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a'), configured('b')]);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(1);
  });

  it('counts configured leaf conditions: empty rows and groups add nothing, a group adds its conditions', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [
      configured('a'),
      createCondition(),
      { id: 'g1', conditions: [configured('b'), configured('c'), createCondition()] },
      { id: 'g2', conditions: [createCondition()] },
    ]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));

    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(3);
  });

  it('is idempotent: re-applying the same query yields the same matches', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));

    // Was 30 → 19 → a fade before #257.
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual(ids(30));
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);
    expect(m.plot.isolateSelection).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('replaces (does not stack) when a narrower query is applied next', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('b')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(12));

    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual(ids(12));
  });

  it('does not blank the plot when the query matches nothing', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, [5, 6, 7]);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);

    // An active-but-empty channel reads as "hide everything", with no way back (#380).
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('b')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, []);

    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
    expect(m.controller.getApplied()).toEqual({ query: [configured('b')], matchedIds: null });
  });

  it('Cancel restores the applied query, or the seed when nothing is applied', () => {
    const seed = m.queryBuilder.query;
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    fire(m.queryBuilder, 'query-cancel');
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(seed);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(false);

    const draft = [configured('a')];
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, draft);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a'), configured('b')]);
    fire(m.queryBuilder, 'query-cancel');

    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(draft);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual(ids(30));
  });

  it('Reset empties both and fires reset; a Reset with nothing applied records nothing', () => {
    fire(m.queryBuilder, 'query-reset');
    expect(m.commits).toEqual([]);

    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, [0, 1, 2]);
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a'), configured('b')]);

    fire(m.queryBuilder, 'query-reset');

    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual([]);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.isolateSelection).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query[0]).toMatchObject({ annotation: '' });
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(false);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
    expect(m.commits.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      cause: 'reset',
      before: { query: [configured('a')], matchedIds: ids(3) },
      after: { query: [], matchedIds: null },
    });
  });

  it('clear() removes the filter and rebases a clean draft to the seed', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));

    m.controller.clear();

    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query[0]).toMatchObject({ annotation: '' });
    expect(m.commits.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ cause: 'clear', after: { query: [] } });
  });

  it('clear() with a dirty draft keeps the draft', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));
    const dirty = [configured('a'), configured('b')];
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, dirty);

    m.controller.clear();

    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(dirty);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(true);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
  });

  it('clear() with nothing applied does nothing', () => {
    m.controller.clear();
    expect(m.commits).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('restore() writes the stored ids without evaluating and publishes the count', () => {
    const snapshot: FilterSnapshot = { query: [configured('a'), configured('b')], matchedIds: ['p7', 'p9'] };

    m.controller.restore(snapshot);

    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toBe(snapshot.matchedIds);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(2);
    expect(m.controller.getApplied()).toBe(snapshot);
    // A clean draft follows the restored filter; restore records nothing.
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(snapshot.query);
    expect(m.commits).toEqual([]);

    m.controller.restore({ query: [], matchedIds: null });
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual([]);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
  });

  it('restore() keeps a dirty draft', () => {
    const dirty = [configured('x')];
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, dirty);
    m.controller.restore({ query: [configured('a')], matchedIds: ['p1'] });
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(dirty);
  });

  it('the builder gets data only while the panel shows, and the latest when it shows', () => {
    m.panel.hide();
    const before = m.queryBuilder.data;
    m.plot.getMaterializedData.mockImplementation(() => makeFullData(50));

    fire(m.plot, 'data-change', { data: makeFullData(50) });
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.data).toBe(before);

    m.panel.show();
    expect(m.queryBuilder.data?.protein_ids).toHaveLength(50);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toEqual([configured('a')]);
  });

  it('a dataset reset clears the filter and the draft', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [{ id: 'a', kind: 'categorical', annotation: 'x', values: ['y'] }]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(3));
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(1);

    m.controller.resetForNewDataset();

    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
    expect(m.controller.getApplied()).toEqual({ query: [], matchedIds: null });
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query[0]).not.toMatchObject({ annotation: 'x' });
  });

  it('hiding the panel closes an open picker', () => {
    expect(m.queryBuilder.closePopups).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    m.panel.hide();
    expect(m.queryBuilder.closePopups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    m.panel.show();
    expect(m.queryBuilder.closePopups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('a dataset reset lets a hidden panel’s builder drop the previous dataset', () => {
    m.panel.hide();
    expect(m.queryBuilder.data).toBeDefined();

    m.controller.resetForNewDataset();

    expect(m.queryBuilder.data).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('dispose stops listening and clears the applied count', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(30));
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(1);

    m.controller.dispose();

    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
    expect(m.panel.listenerCount()).toBe(0);
    m.plot.filtersActive = false;
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(3));
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('filter controller: EAT reliability slider <-> query mirror', () => {
  let m: ReturnType<typeof mount>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    m = mount(makeEatData, { selectedAnnotation: 'family' });
  });

  it('forward: upserts a single "EAT_confidence >= x or N/A" condition and applies it', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);

    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'numeric',
      annotation: EAT_KEY,
      operator: 'gte',
      min: 0.5,
      presence: [NA_VALUE],
    });
    // Un-negated: the N/A chip is what retains curated points now, not NOT.
    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller))?.logicalOp).not.toBe('NOT');
    expect(applied(m.controller)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(1);

    // Kept = curated (p0–p4) + predictions >= 0.5 (p10–p19); hidden = p5–p9.
    const kept = m.plot.filteredProteinIds;
    expect(kept).toContain('p0');
    expect(kept).toContain('p4');
    expect(kept).not.toContain('p5');
    expect(kept).not.toContain('p9');
    expect(kept).toContain('p10');
    expect(kept).toContain('p19');
    expect(kept).toHaveLength(15);
    expect(m.plot.selectedProteinIds).toEqual(['sentinel']);
    // The slider is not an undo step.
    expect(m.commits).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('slider with a clean draft → the draft equals the new applied query', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(applied(m.controller));
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(false);
  });

  it('slider with a dirty draft → only the reliability condition changes in the draft, the draft’s condition id is kept', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);
    const draftCondition = { ...eatCondition(applied(m.controller))!, id: 'draft-eat' };
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a'), { ...draftCondition, logicalOp: 'AND' }]);

    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.8);

    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller))).toMatchObject({ min: 0.8 });
    const draft = m.queryBuilder.query;
    expect(draft).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(draft[0]).toEqual(configured('a'));
    expect(eatCondition(draft)).toMatchObject({ id: 'draft-eat', min: 0.8, logicalOp: 'AND' });
    expect(m.queryBuilder.dirty).toBe(true);
  });

  it('slider with a dirty draft that has no reliability row → the row joins the draft', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [configured('a')]);
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query[0]).toEqual(configured('a'));
    expect(eatCondition(m.queryBuilder.query)).toMatchObject({ min: 0.5 });
  });

  it('forward: re-applying with a new threshold replaces (does not stack) the condition', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.8);

    expect(numericCount(applied(m.controller))).toBe(1);
    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller))).toMatchObject({ min: 0.8 });
    // Kept = curated (5) + predictions >= 0.8 (p16–p19 = 4) = 9.
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toHaveLength(9);
  });

  it('forward: seeds against the current dataset, not a stale snapshot (dataset switch)', () => {
    // The snapshot from the last data-change is the PREVIOUS dataset (all curated), while the
    // plot already materializes the new one: the seed must read the plot.
    const staleData = asData({
      protein_ids: range(20).map((i) => `old${i}`),
      annotations: {
        family: { kind: 'categorical', values: ['A'], colors: ['#000'], shapes: ['circle'] },
        [EAT_KEY]: {
          kind: 'numeric',
          values: [],
          runtime: { role: 'eat-confidence', baseAnnotation: 'family' },
        },
      },
      numeric_annotation_data: { [EAT_KEY]: new Float64Array(20).fill(NaN) },
    });
    let current = staleData;
    m.plot.getMaterializedData.mockImplementation(() => current);
    fire(m.plot, 'data-change', { data: staleData });
    current = makeEatData();

    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);

    const kept = m.plot.filteredProteinIds;
    expect(kept.every((id) => id.startsWith('p'))).toBe(true);
    expect(kept).toHaveLength(15);
  });

  it('forward: dragging to 0 removes the eat condition, clears the filter channel and rebases a clean draft', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);

    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0);

    expect(applied(m.controller)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(eatCondition(m.queryBuilder.query)).toBeUndefined();
    // The clean draft returns to the seeded empty row.
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(m.plot.filtersActive).toBe(false);
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toEqual([]);
    expect(getWorkbenchStatus().appliedFilterConditions).toBe(0);
  });

  it('a draft edit of the reliability condition moves the slider only on Apply', () => {
    const edited: FilterQuery = [
      {
        id: 'x',
        kind: 'numeric',
        annotation: EAT_KEY,
        operator: 'gte',
        min: 0.6,
        max: null,
        presence: [NA_VALUE],
      },
    ];
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, edited);
    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(15));
    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ min: 0.6 }),
    );

    fire(m.queryBuilder, 'query-reset');
    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ min: 0 }),
    );
  });

  it('guards the loop: an Apply echoing the forward value does not move the legend again', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);
    m.legend.setReliabilityState.mockClear();

    // The draft is the applied query; applying it again changes nothing on the legend.
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(15));

    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('keeps a mode that constrains nothing, across an unrelated Apply', () => {
    // A freshly loaded dataset: the reset empties the per-column record, and the colour-by
    // annotation is unchanged, so nothing repopulates it.
    m.controller.resetForNewDataset();

    // "Hide above" picked before its bound moves constrains nothing, so the forward mirror
    // emits no condition and returns early. It must still record the position, or the next
    // unrelated Apply pushes the `atLeast` default back onto the legend's mode select.
    m.controller.setEatReliability('family', { mode: 'atMost', min: 0, max: 1 });
    m.legend.setReliabilityState.mockClear();

    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [
      { id: 'other', kind: 'numeric', annotation: 'length', operator: 'gt', min: 10 },
    ] as FilterQuery);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(4));

    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('guards the loop for a condition that is not first in the draft', () => {
    // Every row after the first carries an `AND`, and the reliability condition is emitted
    // bare, so comparing the raw logicalOp made the guard miss.
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [
      { id: 'a', kind: 'categorical', annotation: 'family', values: ['A'] },
      {
        id: 'x',
        kind: 'numeric',
        annotation: EAT_KEY,
        operator: 'gte',
        min: 0.5,
        max: null,
        presence: [NA_VALUE],
        logicalOp: 'AND',
      },
    ]);

    const before = m.queryBuilder.query;
    m.controller.setEatReliability('family', { mode: 'atLeast', min: 0.5, max: 1 });

    // Identity, not equality: the draft already says this, so it is not rewritten.
    expect(m.queryBuilder.query).toBe(before);
  });
});

describe('filter controller: per-base EAT reliability (multi-EAT)', () => {
  let m: ReturnType<typeof mount>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    m = mount(makeMultiEatData);
  });

  it('scopes the condition to the base: setting GO does not clobber EC', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'ec', 0.5);
    threshold(m.controller, 'go', 0.8);

    expect(numericCount(applied(m.controller))).toBe(2);
    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller), EC_KEY)).toMatchObject({
      operator: 'gte',
      presence: [NA_VALUE],
      min: 0.5,
    });
    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller), GO_KEY)).toMatchObject({
      operator: 'gte',
      presence: [NA_VALUE],
      min: 0.8,
    });
  });

  it('retuning one base rewrites only its own condition, preserving the other', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'ec', 0.5);
    threshold(m.controller, 'go', 0.8);
    threshold(m.controller, 'ec', 0.3);

    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller), EC_KEY)).toMatchObject({ min: 0.3 });
    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller), GO_KEY)).toMatchObject({ min: 0.8 });
    expect(numericCount(applied(m.controller))).toBe(2);
  });

  it('dragging one base to 0 removes only its condition, leaving the other', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'ec', 0.5);
    threshold(m.controller, 'go', 0.8);
    threshold(m.controller, 'ec', 0);

    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller), EC_KEY)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(eatCondition(applied(m.controller), GO_KEY)).toMatchObject({ min: 0.8 });
  });

  it('an annotation change forces the mirror to the newly selected base', () => {
    threshold(m.controller, 'ec', 0.5);
    threshold(m.controller, 'go', 0.8);

    m.controller.setSelectedAnnotation('ec');
    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ min: 0.5 }),
    );

    // The pickers' annotation-change, heard on the root (the document in the app).
    fire(m.root, 'annotation-change', { annotation: 'go' });
    expect(m.legend.setReliabilityState).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ min: 0.8 }),
    );
  });
});

describe('filter controller: every reliability mode (#380)', () => {
  let m: ReturnType<typeof mount>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    m = mount(makeEatData, { selectedAnnotation: 'family' });
  });

  // A hand-built condition on the eat-confidence column IS the reliability filter, whatever its
  // operator, so the slider must replace it rather than AND a contradictory one beside it.
  it.each([
    ['greater than', { operator: 'gt' as const, min: 0.5, max: null }],
    ['between', { operator: 'between' as const, min: 0.4, max: 0.9 }],
    ['non-negated less than', { operator: 'lt' as const, min: null, max: 0.5 }],
  ])('replaces an applied hand-built "%s" rather than appending beside it', (_name, seed) => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [{ id: 'x', kind: 'numeric', annotation: EAT_KEY, ...seed }]);
    apply(m.queryBuilder, range(10));

    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.5);

    expect(findConditionsForAnnotation(applied(m.controller), EAT_KEY)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(findConditionsForAnnotation(m.queryBuilder.query, EAT_KEY)).toHaveLength(1);
    // One coherent condition, not an unsatisfiable pair: the plot keeps points.
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('never hides the curated points, in any mode', () => {
    const curated = ['p0', 'p1', 'p2', 'p3', 'p4'];
    for (const state of [
      { mode: 'atLeast' as const, min: 0.5, max: 1 },
      { mode: 'atMost' as const, min: 0, max: 0.5 },
      { mode: 'between' as const, min: 0.4, max: 0.8 },

      for (const id of curated) expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toContain(id);
    }
  });

  it('applies an upper bound that actually removes the high-confidence points', () => {
    m.controller.setEatReliability('family', { mode: 'atMost', min: 0, max: 0.5 });
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).not.toContain('p19'); // 0.95
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toContain('p5'); // 0.25
  });

  it('applies a band from both sides', () => {
    m.controller.setEatReliability('family', { mode: 'between', min: 0.4, max: 0.6 });
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).not.toContain('p5'); // 0.25, below the band
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).not.toContain('p19'); // 0.95, above the band
    expect(m.plot.filteredProteinIds).toContain('p10'); // 0.50, inside
  });

  it('finds and replaces a reliability condition nested in a group of the draft', () => {
    editQuery(m.queryBuilder, [

        id: 'g',
        conditions: [
          {
            id: 'x',
            kind: 'numeric',
            annotation: EAT_KEY,
            operator: 'lt',
            min: null,
            max: 0.2,
            logicalOp: 'NOT',
          },
        ],
      },
    ] as FilterQuery);

    threshold(m.controller, 'family', 0.7);

    const conditions = findConditionsForAnnotation(m.queryBuilder.query, EAT_KEY);
    expect(conditions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(conditions[0]).toMatchObject({ id: 'x', operator: 'gte', min: 0.7 });
  });
});

Replace `apps/web/src/explore/filter-controller.ts` with:

```ts
import {
  conditionsForReliability,
  createCondition,
  evaluateQuery,
  findConditionsForAnnotation,
  hasConfiguredCondition,
  reliabilityFromConditions,
  replaceConditionsForAnnotation,
  sameConditions,
  sameQuery,
  type FilterQuery,
  type ProtspaceLegend,
  type ProtspaceQueryBuilder,
  type ProtspaceScatterplot,
} from '@protspace/core';
import {
  DEFAULT_EAT_RELIABILITY,
  isEatConfidenceAnnotation,
  isSameReliability,
  type EatReliabilityState,
  type VisualizationData,
} from '@protspace/utils';
import { TOOLTIP_ONLY_ANNOTATIONS } from './view-bar-controller';
import { setWorkbenchStatus } from './workbench-status';

/**
 * A filter as the plot holds it: the query that produced it and the protein ids it keeps, by
 * reference. `matchedIds` null: nothing is filtered (no query, or one that matches nothing, #380).
 */
export interface FilterSnapshot {
  query: FilterQuery;
  matchedIds: readonly string[] | null;
}

/** An applied filter changed through the panel or the chip: what undo records (Task 4.6). */
export interface FilterCommit {
  before: FilterSnapshot;
  after: FilterSnapshot;
  cause: 'apply' | 'reset' | 'clear';
}

interface FilterControllerOptions {
  plotElement: ProtspaceScatterplot;
  legendElement: ProtspaceLegend;
  queryBuilder: ProtspaceQueryBuilder;
  /** Where `annotation-change` is heard; the document in the app. */
  root: Pick<Document, 'addEventListener' | 'removeEventListener'>;
  /** Whether the Filter panel is on screen: the builder counts only then. */
  isPanelShown(): boolean;
  /** Calls `listener` whenever `isPanelShown()` may have changed. */
  subscribePanel(listener: () => void): () => void;
  /** An Apply, a Reset or a removal changed the applied filter. */
  onFilterCommitted?(commit: FilterCommit): void;
}

export interface FilterController {
  /** The colouring annotation changed: move the reliability control to its column's state. */
  setSelectedAnnotation(annotation: string): void;
  /** The legend's reliability control: replaces its base's condition and applies the filter. */
  setEatReliability(baseKey: string, state: EatReliabilityState): void;
  /** The filter chip's ✕: removes the applied filter; a dirty draft keeps its edits. */
  clear(): void;
  /** Undo and redo: makes `snapshot` the applied filter as it was, without evaluating. */
  restore(snapshot: FilterSnapshot): void;
  getApplied(): FilterSnapshot;
  /** A new dataset has other proteins, so the filter, the draft and the mirror record go. */
  resetForNewDataset(): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

const NO_FILTER: FilterSnapshot = { query: [], matchedIds: null };

/** Leaf conditions that constrain something: a group counts its own, an empty row counts 0. */
function countConfigured(items: FilterQuery): number {
  let count = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    if ('conditions' in item) count += countConfigured(item.conditions);
    else if (hasConfiguredCondition([item])) count += 1;
  }
  return count;
}

/**
 * The filter the sidebar's Filter panel builds (design decision 14).
 *
 * The panel edits a draft; Apply makes it the applied filter, Cancel returns the draft to it, and
 * Reset or the chip's ✕ removes it. A filter applies through the plot's filter channel
 * (`filteredProteinIds`, `filtersActive`), which is idempotent: a filter is neither a selection
 * nor an isolation (#257). Matched indices are positions in the materialized snapshot the builder
 * evaluated, never in the isolated subset `getCurrentData()` returns.
 *
 * The legend's EAT reliability control writes the applied filter at once and also updates the
 * draft: a clean draft follows the applied filter, a dirty one gets only that column's condition.
 * The applied filter moves the control back, per eat-confidence column (#6b, #380); both
 * directions compare against the last state recorded for that column, so they cannot ping-pong.
 */
export function createFilterController({
  plotElement,
  legendElement,
  queryBuilder,
  root,
  isPanelShown,
  subscribePanel,
  onFilterCommitted,
}: FilterControllerOptions): FilterController {
  let applied: FilterSnapshot = NO_FILTER;
  /** The empty row a fresh panel shows; the draft is clean while it equals it and nothing applies. */
  let seed: FilterQuery = [createCondition()];
  let draft: FilterQuery = seed;
  let selectedAnnotation = '';
  /** The materialized snapshot the builder evaluates; refreshed on every plot data-change. */
  let snapshot: VisualizationData | undefined;
  let shown = isPanelShown();
  const lastMirrored = new Map<string, EatReliabilityState>();

  const readSnapshot = (): VisualizationData | undefined =>
    plotElement.getMaterializedData() ?? plotElement.getCurrentData() ?? snapshot;

  const filterableAnnotations = (data: VisualizationData | undefined): string[] =>
    Object.keys(data?.annotations ?? {}).filter((key) => !TOOLTIP_ONLY_ANNOTATIONS.has(key));

  /** What a clean draft equals: the applied query, or the seed while none is applied. */
  const baseline = (): FilterQuery => (applied.query.length > 0 ? applied.query : seed);
  const isDirty = () => !sameQuery(draft, baseline());

  const publish = () =>
    setWorkbenchStatus({
      appliedFilterConditions: applied.matchedIds ? countConfigured(applied.query) : 0,
    });

  /**
   * The builder re-counts the whole dataset whenever its data or query changes, so it gets them
   * only while the panel shows it; becoming shown hands it the latest.
   */
  const syncBuilder = () => {
    if (!isPanelShown()) return;
    if (queryBuilder.data !== snapshot) {
      queryBuilder.annotations = filterableAnnotations(snapshot);
      queryBuilder.data = snapshot;
    }
    queryBuilder.query = draft;
    queryBuilder.dirty = isDirty();
  };

  /**
   * Writes `ids` to the plot's filter channel, or releases it. Releases only when something is
   * set: a fresh `[]` over an empty one still rebuilds the plot's geometry.
   */
  const writeChannel = (ids: readonly string[] | null) => {
    if (ids) {
      // The snapshot's own array: undo writes back the ids it recorded, never a copy.
      plotElement.filteredProteinIds = ids as string[];
      plotElement.filtersActive = true;
    } else if (plotElement.filtersActive || (plotElement.filteredProteinIds?.length ?? 0) > 0) {
      plotElement.filteredProteinIds = [];
      plotElement.filtersActive = false;
    }
  };

  const setApplied = (next: FilterSnapshot) => {
    applied = next;
    writeChannel(next.matchedIds);
    publish();
  };

  /** The ids at `indices` in the snapshot; null for none (#380: the plot stays unfiltered). */
  const idsAt = (indices: Iterable<number>, proteinIds: readonly string[]): string[] | null => {
    // One pass, no intermediates: this runs on every slider commit at Swiss-Prot scale.
    const matched: string[] = [];
    for (const index of indices) {
      const id = proteinIds[index];
      if (id !== undefined) matched.push(id);
    }
    return matched.length > 0 ? matched : null;
  };

  /** Evaluates `query` on the snapshot and makes it the applied filter. */
  const applyQuery = (query: FilterQuery) => {
    const proteinIds = snapshot?.protein_ids;
    if (!snapshot || !proteinIds || !hasConfiguredCondition(query)) {
      setApplied({ query, matchedIds: null });
      return;
    }
    setApplied({ query, matchedIds: idsAt(evaluateQuery(query, snapshot), proteinIds) });
  };

  /** The eat-confidence column whose runtime base is `baseKey`, if any. */
  const findEatKey = (baseKey: string): string | undefined => {
    for (const [key, annotation] of Object.entries(snapshot?.annotations ?? {})) {
      if (isEatConfidenceAnnotation(annotation) && annotation.runtime?.baseAnnotation === baseKey) {
        return key;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  };

  /**
   * Reverse mirror: tells the legend what the applied filter says for the selected base. `force`
   * repositions the control after an annotation change even when this base's state is unchanged.
   */
  const mirrorToLegend = (force = false) => {
    const key = findEatKey(selectedAnnotation);
    if (!key) return;
    const derived = reliabilityFromConditions(findConditionsForAnnotation(applied.query, key));
    // No record yet: nothing moved this column off its resting position, which the legend shows.
    const last = lastMirrored.get(key) ?? DEFAULT_EAT_RELIABILITY;
    if (!force && isSameReliability(last, derived)) return;
    lastMirrored.set(key, derived);
    legendElement.setReliabilityState(derived);
  };

  const setSelectedAnnotation = (annotation: string) => {
    if (annotation === selectedAnnotation) return;
    selectedAnnotation = annotation;
    snapshot = readSnapshot();
    mirrorToLegend(true);
  };

  /** The draft edits nothing on screen: no plot, no legend, until Apply. */
  const onQueryChanged = (event: Event) => {
    draft = (event as CustomEvent<{ query: FilterQuery }>).detail.query;
    syncBuilder();
  };

  const onQueryApply = (event: Event) => {
    const proteinIds = snapshot?.protein_ids;
    if (!proteinIds) return;
    const before = applied;
    const { matchedIndices } = (event as CustomEvent<{ matchedIndices: Set<number> }>).detail;
    setApplied({ query: draft, matchedIds: idsAt(matchedIndices, proteinIds) });
    mirrorToLegend();
    // The panel stays: the draft is now clean and Apply says there is nothing new.
    syncBuilder();
    onFilterCommitted?.({ before, after: applied, cause: 'apply' });
  };

  const onQueryCancel = () => {
    draft = baseline();
    syncBuilder();
  };

  const onQueryReset = () => {
    const before = applied;
    setApplied(NO_FILTER);
    draft = seed;
    // A full reset drops any reliability condition too: pull the legend control back.
    mirrorToLegend();
    syncBuilder();
    if (before.query.length > 0) onFilterCommitted?.({ before, after: applied, cause: 'reset' });
  };

  const onAnnotationChange = (event: Event) => {
    const annotation = (event as CustomEvent<{ annotation?: unknown }>).detail?.annotation;
    if (typeof annotation === 'string') setSelectedAnnotation(annotation);
  };

  const onDataChange = (event: Event) => {
    const data = (event as CustomEvent<{ data?: VisualizationData | null }>).detail?.data;
    if (!data) return;
    snapshot = plotElement.getMaterializedData() ?? plotElement.getCurrentData() ?? undefined;
    syncBuilder();
  };

  /** The layout changed: a panel that just came on screen gets the latest data and draft. */
  const onPanelChange = () => {
    const next = isPanelShown();
    if (next === shown) return;
    shown = next;
    if (!shown) {
      // A picker left open under `display: none` would keep its layer, and the next Escape would
      // be spent closing something the user cannot see.
      queryBuilder.closePopups();
      return;
    }
    snapshot = readSnapshot();
    syncBuilder();
  };

  queryBuilder.addEventListener('query-changed', onQueryChanged);
  queryBuilder.addEventListener('query-apply', onQueryApply);
  queryBuilder.addEventListener('query-reset', onQueryReset);
  queryBuilder.addEventListener('query-cancel', onQueryCancel);
  root.addEventListener('annotation-change', onAnnotationChange);
  plotElement.addEventListener('data-change', onDataChange);
  const unsubscribePanel = subscribePanel(onPanelChange);

  return {
    setSelectedAnnotation,
    setEatReliability(baseKey, state) {
      // Resync first: on a dataset switch the slider can fire before data-change refreshes the
      // snapshot, and stale indices would map onto the previous dataset.
      snapshot = readSnapshot();
      const key = findEatKey(baseKey);
      if (!key) return;
      const existing = findConditionsForAnnotation(applied.query, key);
      // A reliability state is one un-negated condition, or none at all.
      const nextConditions = conditionsForReliability(key, state, existing[0]?.id);
      const [replacement = null] = nextConditions;
      // Record what the filter will READ BACK as, before the guard below: state -> conditions is
      // not injective, and a mode that constrains nothing still has a position to keep.
      lastMirrored.set(key, reliabilityFromConditions(nextConditions));
      const draftWasClean = !isDirty();
      if (!sameConditions(existing, nextConditions)) {
        applyQuery(replaceConditionsForAnnotation(applied.query, key, replacement));
      }
      if (draftWasClean) {
        draft = baseline();
      } else {
        // Only this column's condition changes in a dirty draft, under the draft's own id, so
        // the row keeps its live count and any half-typed bound (decision 14).
        const inDraft = findConditionsForAnnotation(draft, key);
        const forDraft = conditionsForReliability(key, state, inDraft[0]?.id);
        if (!sameConditions(inDraft, forDraft)) {
          draft = replaceConditionsForAnnotation(draft, key, forDraft[0] ?? null);
        }
      }
      syncBuilder();
    },
    clear() {
      if (applied.query.length === 0) return;
      const before = applied;
      const draftWasClean = !isDirty();
      setApplied(NO_FILTER);
      if (draftWasClean) draft = seed;
      mirrorToLegend();
      syncBuilder();
      onFilterCommitted?.({ before, after: applied, cause: 'clear' });
    },
    restore(next) {
      const draftWasClean = !isDirty();
      setApplied(next);
      if (draftWasClean) draft = baseline();
      mirrorToLegend();
      syncBuilder();
    },
    getApplied: () => applied,
    resetForNewDataset() {
      // The plot's own filter channel is reset with its data (data-renderer applyPlotState).
      applied = NO_FILTER;
      seed = [createCondition()];
      draft = seed;
      lastMirrored.clear();
      // A hidden panel's builder still holds the dataset it last showed; let it go.
      if (!isPanelShown()) queryBuilder.data = undefined;
      syncBuilder();
      publish();
    },
    dispose() {
      queryBuilder.removeEventListener('query-changed', onQueryChanged);
      queryBuilder.removeEventListener('query-apply', onQueryApply);
      queryBuilder.removeEventListener('query-reset', onQueryReset);
      queryBuilder.removeEventListener('query-cancel', onQueryCancel);
      root.removeEventListener('annotation-change', onAnnotationChange);
      plotElement.removeEventListener('data-change', onDataChange);
      unsubscribePanel();
      // The status store outlives this page: no stale count after leaving /explore.
      setWorkbenchStatus({ appliedFilterConditions: 0 });
    },
  };
}
```

Create `apps/web/src/workbench/FilterPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { updateLayout } from '../explore/layout-state';
import { useLayoutMode } from './use-layout-mode';

/** The view bar's Filter button, or More once the bar has moved Filter into it (stage 3). */
function narrowReturnTarget(): HTMLElement | null {
  const button = document.getElementById('myFilterButton');
  if (button?.checkVisibility()) return button;
  return document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-workbench="view-bar"] .wb-more');
}

/**
 * The sidebar's Filter panel (design decision 14): in place of the legend, above the structure.
 * It hosts the query builder, a runtime element the filter controller wires by id, so the section
 * renders once and only CSS (`data-panel` on the workbench) shows or hides it. Close returns to
 * the legend and hands focus to the control that opened the panel's kind: the rail's Filter item
 * on desktop, the view bar's Filter (or More) below 951 px.
 */
export function FilterPanel() {
  const close = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const desktop = useLayoutMode() === 'desktop';

  useEffect(() => {
    const button = close.current;
    if (!button) return;
    const onClick = () => {
      updateLayout({ panel: 'legend' });
      const target = desktop ? document.getElementById('wb-rail-filter') : narrowReturnTarget();
      target?.focus();
    };
    button.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    return () => button.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
  }, [desktop]);

  return (
    <section
      id="wb-filter-panel"
      data-workbench="filter-panel"
      role="region"
      aria-labelledby="wb-filter-title"
    >
      <header className="wb-panel-header">
        <h2 id="wb-filter-title" className="wb-panel-title" tabIndex={-1}>
          Filter
        </h2>
        <ps-icon-button ref={close} icon="x" label="Close filter"></ps-icon-button>
      </header>
      <div className="wb-filter-body">
        <protspace-query-builder id="myQueryBuilder" embedded></protspace-query-builder>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Ref, RefObject } from 'react';
import type { SidebarPanel } from '../explore/layout-defaults';
import { openPanel, updateLayout } from '../explore/layout-state';

interface RailProps {
  sidebarOpen: boolean;
  /** The sidebar's panel: Legend or Filter. */
  panel: SidebarPanel;
  /** The protein the structure viewer shows or waits to show; null for none. */
  structureProteinId: string | null;
  /** Whether the structure sits in the sidebar column rather than floating over the plot. */
  structureDocked: boolean;
  /** A filter is applied: the Filter item gets a dot. */
  filterApplied: boolean;
  /** The collapse toggle, for a caller that moves focus to it. */
  toggleRef?: Ref<HTMLElement>;
  /** The structure section, which Structure focuses while it is on screen. */
  structureRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
}

/**
 * The 44 px icon rail at the sidebar's right edge (design decision 2): Legend, Structure and
 * Filter. It stays when the sidebar collapses, so every panel stays one click away. A panel's item
 * opens the sidebar on that panel; the item of the panel on screen collapses the sidebar. Hidden
 * below 951 px.
 */
export function Rail({
  sidebarOpen,
  panel,
  structureProteinId,
  structureDocked,
  filterApplied,
  toggleRef,
  structureRef,
}: RailProps) {
  const toggleSidebar = () => updateLayout({ sidebarOpen: !sidebarOpen });
  const togglePanel = (target: SidebarPanel) => {
    if (sidebarOpen && panel === target) updateLayout({ sidebarOpen: false });
    else openPanel(target);
  };
  // A docked structure in a collapsed sidebar waits; opening the sidebar loads it. Docked in an
  // open sidebar, or floating over the plot, it is already on screen: Structure takes focus there.
  const showStructure = () => {
    if (structureDocked && !sidebarOpen) updateLayout({ sidebarOpen: true });
    else structureRef?.current?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <nav className="wb-rail" data-workbench="rail" aria-label="Panels">
      <ps-icon-button
        icon="list"
        label="Legend"
        tooltipPlacement="left"
        pressed={sidebarOpen && panel === 'legend'}
        onClick={() => togglePanel('legend')}
      ></ps-icon-button>
      <span className="wb-rail-item">
        <ps-icon-button
          icon="box"
          label={
            structureProteinId === null
              ? 'Structure: click a protein to view it'
              : `Structure: ${structureProteinId}`
          }
          tooltipPlacement="left"
          disabled={structureProteinId === null}
          onClick={showStructure}
        ></ps-icon-button>
        {structureProteinId !== null && (
          <span className="wb-rail-dot" data-workbench="structure-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        )}
      </span>
      <span className="wb-rail-item">
        <ps-icon-button
          id="wb-rail-filter"
          icon="filter"
          label="Filter"
          tooltipPlacement="left"
          pressed={sidebarOpen && panel === 'filter'}
          onClick={() => togglePanel('filter')}
        ></ps-icon-button>
        {filterApplied && (
          <span className="wb-rail-dot" data-workbench="filter-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        )}
      </span>
      <span className="wb-rail-spacer" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <ps-icon-button
        ref={toggleRef}
        icon={sidebarOpen ? 'panel-right-close' : 'panel-right-open'}
        label={sidebarOpen ? 'Collapse sidebar' : 'Expand sidebar'}
        tooltipPlacement="left"
        expanded={sidebarOpen ? 'true' : 'false'}
        onClick={toggleSidebar}
      ></ps-icon-button>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Filter } from 'lucide-react';
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { openPanel } from '../explore/layout-state';
import { useLayout } from './use-layout';
import { useLayoutMode } from './use-layout-mode';
import { useWorkbenchStatus } from './use-workbench-status';

const focusFilterTitle = () =>
  document.getElementById('wb-filter-title')?.focus({ preventScroll: true });

/**
 * The view bar's Filter button (design decision 14): it opens the sidebar's Filter panel, never
 * closes it, and moves focus to the panel's heading. The view bar hides it at stage 3, where More
 * clicks it.
 */
export function FilterControl() {
  const { appliedFilterConditions: count } = useWorkbenchStatus();
  const layout = useLayout();
  const desktop = useLayoutMode() === 'desktop';
  const shown = layout.panel === 'filter' && (layout.sidebarOpen || !desktop);
  const button = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const element = button.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const onClick = () => {
      // Commit the layout now, so the heading is on screen when focus moves to it; a sidebar
      // that is still sliding in shows it a frame later.
      flushSync(() => openPanel('filter'));
      focusFilterTitle();
      if (document.activeElement?.id !== 'wb-filter-title') requestAnimationFrame(focusFilterTitle);
    };
    element.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    return () => element.removeEventListener('click', onClick);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ps-button
      ref={button}
      id="myFilterButton"
      variant="ghost"
      data-view-item=""
      expanded={shown ? 'true' : 'false'}
    >
      <span slot="start" className="wb-icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <Filter size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} />
      </span>
      {count > 0 ? (
        <>
          {/* One name for the whole button: a screen-reader-only span is a block, so names
              pieced together around it gain a stray space ("Filter , 1 …"). */}
          <span aria-hidden="true">Filter</span>
          <span className="wb-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">
            {count}
          </span>
          <span className="sr-only">
            Filter, {count} {count === 1 ? 'condition' : 'conditions'} applied
          </span>
        </>
      ) : (
        'Filter'
      )}
    </ps-button>
  );
}
```

(`ps-button`'s `expanded` is already in `custom-elements.d.ts`'s `ButtonKeys`; no typing change is needed. `ps-dialog` stays typed there for other users.)

2. Replace the whole `openFilter` function with:

```ts
/** Opens the Filter panel, from the view bar or from More, unless it shows already. */
export async function openFilter(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await waitForExploreInteractionReady(page);
  const panel = filterPanel(page);
  if (await panel.isVisible().catch(() => false)) return;
  if (await filterButton(page).isVisible()) {
    await filterButton(page).click();
  } else {
    await moreButton(page).click();
    await page
      .locator('#wb-more-menu')
      .getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Filter', exact: true })
      .click();
  }
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible();
}

/** Closes the Filter panel with its ✕, back to the legend, if it shows. */
export async function closeFilterPanel(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const panel = filterPanel(page);
  if (!(await panel.isVisible().catch(() => false))) return;
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close filter', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(panel).toBeHidden();
}

const quoted = (value: string) => value.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/"/g, '\\"');

/**
 * Opens the Filter panel and applies one condition: the colouring annotation equals the legend's
 * first category. The panel stays open.
 */
export async function applyFirstCategoryFilter(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const { annotation } = await getViewState(page);
  const value = await getFirstLegendItemValue(page);
  await openFilter(page);
  const row = queryBuilder(page).locator('protspace-query-condition-row').first();
  await row.locator('.annotation-select-trigger').click();
  await queryBuilder(page)
    .locator(`.annotation-picker-item[data-annotation="${quoted(annotation ?? '')}"]`)
    .first()
    .click();
  await row.locator('.value-chip-add').click();
  await queryBuilder(page)
    .locator(`.value-picker-item[data-value="${quoted(value)}"]`)
    .first()
    .click();
  // A click elsewhere in the builder closes the value picker.
  await queryBuilder(page).locator('.match-count').click();
  await filterApplyButton(page).click();
  await expect(filterApplyButton(page)).toBeDisabled();
}
```

`getFirstLegendItemValue` is re-exported at the top of the file from `./legend`; import it for local use too by adding `import { getFirstLegendItemValue } from './legend';` under the existing `export { … } from './legend';` line (a re-export does not bind a local name).

```ts
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  applyFirstCategoryFilter,
  clearStatusChip,
  filterApplyButton,
  filterButton,
  filterPanel,
  getProteinCount,
  getViewState,
  openExplore,
  openFilter,
  queryBuilder,
  statusChip,
} from './helpers/explore';
import { rail, structurePanel, watchPlotResizes } from './helpers/workbench';

/** The plot's filter channel: whether it is on, and how many proteins it keeps. */
function readPlotFilter(page: Page): Promise<{ filtersActive: boolean; kept: number }> {
  return page.locator('#myPlot').evaluate((plot) => {
    const host = plot as Element & { filtersActive?: boolean; filteredProteinIds?: string[] };
    return {
      filtersActive: host.filtersActive === true,
      kept: host.filteredProteinIds?.length ?? 0,
    };
  });
}

const railItem = (page: Page, name: 'Legend' | 'Filter') =>
  rail(page).getByRole('button', { name, exact: true });
const conditionRows = (page: Page) => queryBuilder(page).locator('protspace-query-condition-row');
const countLine = (page: Page) => queryBuilder(page).locator('.match-count');
const reason = (page: Page) => queryBuilder(page).locator('#apply-reason');

test.describe('the Filter panel', () => {
  test("the view bar's Filter opens the panel in place of the legend, the structure footer stays, and #myPlot does not resize", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const resizes = await watchPlotResizes(page);

    await filterButton(page).click();

    await expect(filterPanel(page)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#myLegend')).toBeHidden();
    await expect(structurePanel(page)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#wb-filter-title')).toBeFocused();
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    // The builder sits under the panel's own heading: no title or close button of its own.
    await expect(queryBuilder(page).getByText('Filter Query', { exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await resizes()).toBe(0);
  });

  test("the rail's Filter is pressed; Close returns to the legend and focus to the rail item", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await railItem(page, 'Filter').click();

    await expect(filterPanel(page)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(railItem(page, 'Filter')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect(railItem(page, 'Legend')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');

    await filterPanel(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Close filter', exact: true }).click();

    await expect(filterPanel(page)).toBeHidden();
    await expect(page.locator('#myLegend')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(railItem(page, 'Legend')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect(railItem(page, 'Filter')).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect(railItem(page, 'Filter')).toBeFocused();
  });

  test('the live count updates after an edit', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const total = await getProteinCount(page);
    await openFilter(page);
    // The seeded empty row keeps every protein.
    await expect(countLine(page)).toHaveText(new RegExp(`^${total.toLocaleString('en-US')} of `));

    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);

    await expect(countLine(page)).not.toHaveText(
      new RegExp(`^${total.toLocaleString('en-US')} of `),
    );
    await expect(countLine(page)).toHaveText(/ proteins? match$/);
  });

  test("an incomplete row says 'Choose a value for condition 1' and Apply is disabled", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    // The colouring annotation is categorical in the default dataset (the legend lists its
    // categories), so a row on it asks for a value.
    const { annotation } = await getViewState(page);
    await openFilter(page);
    await conditionRows(page).first().locator('.annotation-select-trigger').click();
    await queryBuilder(page)
      .locator(`.annotation-picker-item[data-annotation="${annotation}"]`)
      .first()
      .click();

    await expect(reason(page)).toHaveText('Choose a value for condition 1');
    await expect(filterApplyButton(page)).toBeDisabled();
  });

  test('Apply filters and the panel stays', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const total = await getProteinCount(page);
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAccessibleName('Filter');

    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);

    await expect(filterPanel(page)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(reason(page)).toHaveText('No changes to apply');
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAccessibleName('Filter, 1 condition applied');
    await expect(rail(page).locator('[data-workbench="filter-dot"]')).toBeVisible();
    const plot = await readPlotFilter(page);
    expect(plot.filtersActive).toBe(true);
    expect(plot.kept).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(plot.kept).toBeLessThan(total);
  });

  test('Cancel restores the applied filter', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);
    const cancel = queryBuilder(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel', exact: true });
    await expect(cancel).toBeDisabled();

    await queryBuilder(page).getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add condition' }).click();
    await expect(conditionRows(page)).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(cancel).toBeEnabled();

    await cancel.click();

    await expect(conditionRows(page)).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(cancel).toBeDisabled();
    expect((await readPlotFilter(page)).filtersActive).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the filter chip's ✕ removes the filter", async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toBeVisible();

    await clearStatusChip(page, 'filter');

    await expect.poll(async () => (await readPlotFilter(page)).filtersActive).toBe(false);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAccessibleName('Filter');
    // The clean draft returned to one empty row.
    await expect(conditionRows(page)).toHaveCount(1);
  });

  test('after a reload the panel is still Filter, with no filter applied', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);

    // A fresh visit: the layout is stored, the filter is not.
    await openExplore(page);

    await expect(filterPanel(page)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#myLegend')).toBeHidden();
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAccessibleName('Filter');
    expect((await readPlotFilter(page)).filtersActive).toBe(false);
    await expect(conditionRows(page)).toHaveCount(1);
  });

  test('the open panel has no axe violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);
    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .include('#wb-filter-panel')
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
      .analyze();
    expect(results.violations).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

## Filter panel

The app's filter controller (`apps/web/src/explore/filter-controller.ts`) keeps two queries: the
applied filter, written to the scatterplot's `filteredProteinIds` and `filtersActive`, and the
draft the Filter panel's query builder edits. Apply makes the draft the applied filter and keeps

filter at once and changes only its own column's condition in a dirty draft. Each Apply, Reset and
removal is reported as a `FilterCommit` holding the applied query and its matched ids by
reference, which the undo history records.

### Task 4.6: Undo and redo

⌘Z / Ctrl+Z undoes and ⇧⌘Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes selection changes, "show only" steps and filter apply, reset and removal, when focus is not in a text field (decision 13). A pure history holds the entries by reference under step and id caps; the interaction controller owns it; the selection and filter controllers record and apply their own entries; a small undo controller owns the keys. The scatterplot learns to pop one isolation step.

**Files:**

- Modify: `packages/utils/src/platform.ts`, a new `packages/utils/src/platform.test.ts`; `src/index.ts` already re-exports `./platform`, so it does not change

Append to `packages/utils/src/platform.ts`:

```ts

/**
 * Whether a key event's composed path runs through a text field (an `INPUT`, `TEXTAREA`, `SELECT`
 * or a contentEditable element), where the key edits text. The whole path, so a field inside a
 * shadow root counts; duck-typed, so it reads plain objects too.
 */
export function isEditableEventPath(path: readonly unknown[]): boolean {
  for (const node of path) {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') continue;
    const { tagName, isContentEditable } = node as {
      tagName?: unknown;
      isContentEditable?: unknown;
    };
    if (tagName === 'INPUT' || tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || tagName === 'SELECT') return true;
    if (isContentEditable === true) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { createUndoHistory } from './undo-history';

/** An entry that says how many ids it holds, without holding them. */
interface Step {
  id: string;
  n: number;
}
const step = (id: string, n = 1): Step => ({ id, n });
const make = (options: { limit?: number; maxIds?: number } = {}) =>
  createUndoHistory<Step>({ size: (entry) => entry.n, ...options });

describe('undo history', () => {
  it('undo and redo order', () => {
    const history = make();
    const [a, b] = [step('a'), step('b')];
    history.record(a);
    history.record(b);
    expect(history.undo()).toBe(b);
    expect(history.undo()).toBe(a);
    expect(history.undo()).toBeNull();
    expect(history.redo()).toBe(a);
    expect(history.redo()).toBe(b);
    expect(history.redo()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('record clears redo', () => {
    const history = make();
    history.record(step('a'));
    history.record(step('b'));
    history.undo();
    expect(history.canRedo()).toBe(true);
    history.record(step('c'));
    expect(history.canRedo()).toBe(false);
    expect(history.undo()?.id).toBe('c');
    expect(history.undo()?.id).toBe('a');
  });

  it('the 101st entry drops the oldest', () => {
    const history = make();
    for (let i = 0; i <= 100; i++) history.record(step(`s${i}`));
    const undone: string[] = [];
    for (let entry = history.undo(); entry; entry = history.undo()) undone.push(entry.id);
    expect(undone).toHaveLength(100);
    expect(undone[0]).toBe('s100');
    expect(undone.at(-1)).toBe('s1');
  });

  it('entries past 2M ids drop the oldest', () => {
    const history = make();
    history.record(step('a', 1_000_000));
    history.record(step('b', 1_000_000));
    history.record(step('c', 1));
    expect(history.undo()?.id).toBe('c');
    expect(history.undo()?.id).toBe('b');
    expect(history.undo()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('the newest step is kept even when it alone passes the id cap', () => {
    const history = make({ maxIds: 10 });
    history.record(step('a', 4));
    history.record(step('huge', 50));
    expect(history.undo()?.id).toBe('huge');
    expect(history.canUndo()).toBe(false);
  });

  it('entries are stored by reference', () => {
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 1000 }, (_, i) => `P${i}`);
    const history = createUndoHistory<{ ids: string[] }>({ size: (entry) => entry.ids.length });
    const entry = { ids };
    history.record(entry);
    const undone = history.undo()!;
    expect(undone).toBe(entry);
    expect(undone.ids).toBe(ids);
    expect(history.redo()).toBe(entry);
  });

  it('clear empties both stacks', () => {
    const history = make();
    history.record(step('a'));
    history.record(step('b'));
    history.undo();
    history.clear();
    expect(history.canUndo()).toBe(false);
    expect(history.canRedo()).toBe(false);
    expect(history.peekUndo()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('subscribe fires on record, undo, redo, clear', () => {
    const history = make();
    const listener = vi.fn();
    const unsubscribe = history.subscribe(listener);
    history.record(step('a'));
    history.undo();
    history.redo();
    history.clear();
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
    // Nothing to undo: nothing changed, nothing heard.
    history.undo();
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
    unsubscribe();
    history.record(step('b'));
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
  });

  it('peekUndo returns the top', () => {
    const history = make();
    expect(history.peekUndo()).toBeNull();
    const [a, b] = [step('a'), step('b')];
    history.record(a);
    history.record(b);
    expect(history.peekUndo()).toBe(b);
    history.undo();
    expect(history.peekUndo()).toBe(a);
  });
});
```

Expected: FAIL: `./undo-history` does not exist.

Create `apps/web/src/explore/undo-history.ts`:

```ts
/** A linear undo history (design decision 13). */
export interface UndoHistory<E> {
  /** Adds a step on top and drops every step undone before it. */
  record(entry: E): void;
  /** Takes the top step off, to undo; null when there is none. */
  undo(): E | null;
  /** Puts the last undone step back, to redo; null when there is none. */
  redo(): E | null;
  /** The step `undo()` would return, left in place. */
  peekUndo(): E | null;
  canUndo(): boolean;
  canRedo(): boolean;
  clear(): void;
  /** Heard on every change; returns the unsubscribe. */
  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
}

interface Sized<E> {
  entry: E;
  size: number;
}

/**
 * Entries are kept by reference, never copied: a lasso of 573K ids costs one pointer. Past `limit`
 * steps or `maxIds` ids in all (each entry's `size`), the oldest steps drop. The newest step is
 * always kept, so a single huge step can still be undone.
 */
export function createUndoHistory<E>({
  size,
  limit = 100,
  maxIds = 2_000_000,
}: {
  size(entry: E): number;
  limit?: number;
  maxIds?: number;
}): UndoHistory<E> {
  const past: Sized<E>[] = [];
  let future: Sized<E>[] = [];
  /** Ids held by both stacks. */
  let total = 0;
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  const changed = () => {
    for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
  };

  return {
    record(entry) {
      for (const undone of future) total -= undone.size;
      future = [];
      const sized = { entry, size: size(entry) };
      past.push(sized);
      total += sized.size;
      while (past.length > 1 && (past.length > limit || total > maxIds)) {
        total -= past.shift()!.size;
      }
      changed();
    },
    undo() {
      const top = past.pop();
      if (!top) return null;
      future.push(top);
      changed();
      return top.entry;
    },
    redo() {
      const next = future.pop();
      if (!next) return null;
      past.push(next);
      changed();
      return next.entry;
    },
    peekUndo() {
      return past.length > 0 ? past[past.length - 1].entry : null;
    },
    canUndo() {
      return past.length > 0;
    },
    canRedo() {
      return future.length > 0;
    },
    clear() {
      past.length = 0;
      future = [];
      total = 0;
      changed();
    },
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
      };
    },
  };
}
```

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { createUndoController, undoEntrySize, type UndoEntry } from './undo-controller';
import { createUndoHistory } from './undo-history';

interface KeyInit {
  key?: string;
  meta?: boolean;
  ctrl?: boolean;
  shift?: boolean;
  alt?: boolean;
  composing?: boolean;
  path?: unknown[];
}

/** A keydown as the document hears it in the bubble phase, with its composed path. */
function keydown(init: KeyInit): Event {
  return Object.assign(new Event('keydown', { cancelable: true }), {
    key: init.key ?? 'z',
    metaKey: init.meta ?? false,
    ctrlKey: init.ctrl ?? false,
    shiftKey: init.shift ?? false,
    altKey: init.alt ?? false,
    isComposing: init.composing ?? false,
    composedPath: () => init.path ?? [],
  });
}

const step = (id: string): UndoEntry => ({ kind: 'selection', before: [], after: [id] });

function setup({ mac = false, modal = false } = {}) {
  const history = createUndoHistory<UndoEntry>({ size: undoEntrySize });
  const root = new EventTarget();
  const apply = vi.fn();
  const controller = createUndoController({
    history,
    root: root as unknown as Document,
    isMac: () => mac,
    isModalOpen: () => modal,
    apply,
  });
  const press = (init: KeyInit) => {
    const event = keydown(init);
    root.dispatchEvent(event);
    return event;
  };
  return { history, apply, controller, press };
}

describe('undo controller', () => {
  it('Mod is ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere', () => {
    const mac = setup({ mac: true });
    const a = step('a');
    mac.history.record(a);
    expect(mac.press({ ctrl: true }).defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    expect(mac.apply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mac.press({ meta: true }).defaultPrevented).toBe(true);
    expect(mac.apply).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(a, 'undo');

    const other = setup();
    other.history.record(a);
    expect(other.press({ meta: true }).defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    expect(other.press({ ctrl: true }).defaultPrevented).toBe(true);
    expect(other.apply).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(a, 'undo');
  });

  it('Shift redoes', () => {
    const m = setup();
    const a = step('a');
    m.history.record(a);
    m.press({ ctrl: true });
    expect(m.press({ ctrl: true, shift: true, key: 'Z' }).defaultPrevented).toBe(true);
    expect(m.apply).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(a, 'redo');
  });

  it('Alt and composing are ignored', () => {
    const m = setup();
    m.history.record(step('a'));
    expect(m.press({ ctrl: true, alt: true }).defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    expect(m.press({ ctrl: true, composing: true }).defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    expect(m.apply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('an input inside a shadow-root path is ignored', () => {
    const m = setup();
    m.history.record(step('a'));
    // A filter value field: an input in a kit field in the query builder, two shadow roots deep.
    const path = [
      { tagName: 'INPUT' },
      { host: {} },
      { tagName: 'PS-INPUT' },
      { host: {} },
      { tagName: 'PROTSPACE-QUERY-BUILDER' },
      { tagName: 'BODY' },
    ];
    expect(m.press({ ctrl: true, path }).defaultPrevented).toBe(false);
    expect(m.apply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(m.history.canUndo()).toBe(true);
  });

  it('an open dialog blocks it', () => {
    const inPath = setup();
    inPath.history.record(step('a'));
    expect(
