Create `apps/web/src/explore/undo-controller.ts`:

```ts
import { isEditableEventPath } from '@protspace/utils';
import type { FilterCommit } from './filter-controller';
import type { UndoHistory } from './undo-history';

/**
 * One undoable step (design decision 13). Every array is the one its controller already owns,
 * held by reference.
 */
export type UndoEntry =
  | { kind: 'selection'; before: readonly string[]; after: readonly string[] }
  | { kind: 'isolate'; layer: readonly string[]; selectionBefore: readonly string[] }
  | {
      kind: 'reset-isolation';
      layers: ReadonlyArray<readonly string[]>;
      selectionBefore: readonly string[];
    }
  | ({ kind: 'filter' } & FilterCommit);

/** The protein ids an entry holds, for the history's id cap. */
export function undoEntrySize(entry: UndoEntry): number {
  switch (entry.kind) {
    case 'selection':
      return entry.before.length + entry.after.length;
    case 'isolate':
      return entry.layer.length + entry.selectionBefore.length;
    case 'reset-isolation':
      return (
        entry.layers.reduce((sum, layer) => sum + layer.length, 0) + entry.selectionBefore.length
      );
    case 'filter':
      return (entry.before.matchedIds?.length ?? 0) + (entry.after.matchedIds?.length ?? 0);
  }
}

interface UndoControllerOptions {
  history: UndoHistory<UndoEntry>;
  /** Where the keys are heard, in the bubble phase: the document in the app. */
  root: Pick<Document, 'addEventListener' | 'removeEventListener'>;
  /** ⌘ on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere (`isMacOrIos`). */
  isMac(): boolean;
  /** A modal is open on the page; it owns its keys. */
  isModalOpen(): boolean;
  /** Undoes or redoes one step; the controller that recorded it applies it. */
  apply(entry: UndoEntry, direction: 'undo' | 'redo'): void;
}

/** An open `<dialog>` or an `aria-modal="true"` element in the key's path. */
function modalInPath(path: readonly unknown[]): boolean {
  return path.some((node) => {
    const element = node as {
      tagName?: unknown;
      open?: unknown;
      getAttribute?: (name: string) => string | null;
    } | null;
    if (!element) return false;
    if (element.tagName === 'DIALOG' && element.open === true) return true;
    return (
      typeof element.getAttribute === 'function' && element.getAttribute('aria-modal') === 'true'
    );
  });
}

/**
 * ⌘Z / Ctrl+Z undoes and ⇧⌘Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes (design decision 13). Only the keys and the
 * routing live here: the history belongs to the interaction controller, and each step is applied
 * by the controller that recorded it. A press in a text field edits the text, and a modal owns its
 * own keys, so neither reaches the history.
 */
export function createUndoController({
  history,
  root,
  isMac,
  isModalOpen,
  apply,
}: UndoControllerOptions) {
  const undo = (): boolean => {
    const entry = history.undo();
    if (!entry) return false;
    apply(entry, 'undo');
    return true;
  };

  const redo = (): boolean => {
    const entry = history.redo();
    if (!entry) return false;
    apply(entry, 'redo');
    return true;
  };

  const onKeydown = (event: Event) => {
    const key = event as KeyboardEvent;
    if (key.defaultPrevented || key.altKey || key.isComposing) return;
    if (key.key.toLowerCase() !== 'z' || !(isMac() ? key.metaKey : key.ctrlKey)) return;
    const path = key.composedPath();
    if (isEditableEventPath(path) || modalInPath(path) || isModalOpen()) return;
    if (key.shiftKey ? redo() : undo()) key.preventDefault();
  };

  root.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);

  return {
    undo,
    redo,
    /** Undoes `entry` only while it is still the latest step: an Undo button never undoes a newer one. */
    undoEntry(entry: UndoEntry): boolean {
      return history.peekUndo() === entry ? undo() : false;
    },
    dispose() {
      root.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  /**
   * Undoes one Show only step (the app's undo history). With more than one step it drops the last
   * and shows the step before it; with one it leaves isolation as `resetIsolation()` does.
   */
  popIsolation(): void {
    if (this._isolationHistory.length === 0) return;
    if (this._isolationHistory.length === 1) {
      this.resetIsolation();
      return;
    }
    // A new array: the isolated subset is memoised on the history, so the shorter one recomputes it.
    this._isolationHistory = this._isolationHistory.slice(0, -1);
    this.selectedProteinIds = [];
    // Forget the build, as resetIsolation does: the fast coordinate path would keep the narrower
    // subset.
    this._plotDataBuild = null;
    this._reprocessAndRefresh();
    this.resetZoom();

    const currentData = this.getCurrentData();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('data-isolation', {
        detail: {
          isolationHistory: this._isolationHistory,
          isolationMode: this._isolationMode,
          dataSize: currentData?.protein_ids.length ?? 0,
        },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('data-change', {
        detail: { data: currentData, isSplitData: true, isolationMode: true },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  }
```

```ts
/** What the undo controller does for a selection or isolation step: pop it, then apply it. */
function undo(m: ReturnType<typeof setup>): void {
  const entry = m.history.undo();
  if (!entry || entry.kind === 'filter') throw new Error('no selection step to undo');
  m.controller.applyHistory(entry, 'undo');
}
function redo(m: ReturnType<typeof setup>): void {
  const entry = m.history.redo();
  if (!entry || entry.kind === 'filter') throw new Error('no selection step to redo');
  m.controller.applyHistory(entry, 'redo');
}

/** The plot's isolation, faked: layers the fake's isolate, pop and reset keep, as the plot does. */
function isolating(m: ReturnType<typeof setup>) {
  const layers: string[][] = [];
  const report = () =>
    fire(m.plot, layers.length > 0 ? 'data-isolation' : 'data-isolation-reset', {
      isolationHistory: layers,
      isolationMode: layers.length > 0,
      dataSize: layers.at(-1)?.length ?? 10,
    });
  m.plot.isolateSelection.mockImplementation(() => {
    if (m.plot.selectedProteinIds.length === 0) return;
    layers.push([...m.plot.selectedProteinIds]);
    m.plot.selectedProteinIds = [];
    report();
  });
  m.plot.popIsolation.mockImplementation(() => {
    layers.pop();
    report();
  });
  m.plot.resetIsolation.mockImplementation(() => {
    layers.length = 0;
    report();
  });
  m.plot.getIsolationHistory.mockImplementation(() => [...layers]);
  return { layers };
}

describe('selection controller: undo history', () => {
  it('a commit records before and after; undo restores the previous selection; redo re-applies', () => {
    const m = setup();
    fire(m.plot, 'protein-click', click('P1', {}));
    fire(m.plot, 'brush-selection', { proteinIds: ['P2', 'P3'] });
    const brush = m.history.peekUndo();
    expect(brush).toMatchObject({ kind: 'selection', before: ['P1'], after: ['P2', 'P3'] });

    undo(m);
    expect(m.plot.selectedProteinIds).toEqual(['P1']);
    expect(m.bar.selectedCount).toBe(1);
    // Applying a step records none: the click is still the step below.
    expect(m.history.peekUndo()).toMatchObject({ before: [], after: ['P1'] });

    redo(m);
    expect(m.plot.selectedProteinIds).toEqual(['P2', 'P3']);
    expect(m.history.peekUndo()).toBe(brush);
    expect(m.history.canRedo()).toBe(false);
  });

  it('an identical commit records nothing', () => {
    const m = setup();
    // Clear with nothing selected: an empty selection over an empty one.
    fire(m.bar, 'clear-selections');

  });

  });
});
```

```ts
  const commitSelection = (
    ids: string[],
    { afterPaint = false, record = true }: { afterPaint?: boolean; record?: boolean } = {},
  ) => {
    // One undo step per change, recorded at commit time with the arrays as they are: every
    // caller hands over a fresh array, and nothing mutates one afterwards.
    if (record && ids !== selected && (ids.length > 0 || selected.length > 0)) {
      history.record({ kind: 'selection', before: selected, after: ids });
    }
    const land = () => {
      show(ids);
      plotElement.selectedProteinIds = [...ids];
      interactionController.handleSelectionChange(ids);
    };
    if (afterPaint) {
      show(ids);
      commit.schedule(land);
    } else {
      commit.cancel();
      land();
    }
  };
```

```ts
  const onIsolate = () => {
    // Isolation reads the plot's selection: land a search pick still waiting first.
    commit.flush();
    const selectionBefore = selected;
    const steps = plotElement.getIsolationHistory().length;
    plotElement.isolateSelection();
    const layers = plotElement.getIsolationHistory();
    if (layers.length > steps) {
      history.record({ kind: 'isolate', layer: layers[layers.length - 1], selectionBefore });
    }

  /** Isolates one recorded layer again, as Show only these did. */
  const isolateLayer = (layer: readonly string[]) => {
    plotElement.selectedProteinIds = [...layer];
    plotElement.isolateSelection();
  };

  const resetIsolation = ({ record = true } = {}) => {
    const layers = plotElement.getIsolationHistory();
    const selectionBefore = selected;
    plotElement.resetIsolation();
    if (record && layers.length > 0) {
      history.record({ kind: 'reset-isolation', layers, selectionBefore });
    }
  };

  const applyHistory = (
    entry: Exclude<UndoEntry, { kind: 'filter' }>,
    direction: 'undo' | 'redo',
  ) => {
    // A search pick still waiting lands first, so the step applies to what the user sees.
    commit.flush();
    // History entries hold arrays nothing mutates; the commit only reads them.
    const restore = (ids: readonly string[]) => commitSelection(ids as string[], { record: false });
    if (entry.kind === 'selection') {
      restore(direction === 'undo' ? entry.before : entry.after);
    } else if (entry.kind === 'isolate') {
      if (direction === 'undo') {
        plotElement.popIsolation();
        restore(entry.selectionBefore);
      } else {
        isolateLayer(entry.layer);
      }
    } else if (direction === 'undo') {
      for (const layer of entry.layers) isolateLayer(layer);
      restore(entry.selectionBefore);
    } else {
      resetIsolation({ record: false });
    }
  };
```

```ts
    if (((event as CustomEvent<{ dataSize?: number }>).detail?.dataSize ?? 0) > 1) {
      plotTools.selectionDisabled = false;
      selectionBar.canIsolate = true;

  };
```

```ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  chooseTool,
  getSelectedProteinIds,
  importUserFile,
  openExplore,
  searchInput,
  selectionBarAction,
  statusChip,
  waitForProteinCount,
} from './helpers/explore';
import { TOXPROT_5181_FIXTURE } from './helpers/fixtures';
import { stubStructureRequests } from './helpers/workbench';

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
  await stubStructureRequests(page);
});

/** The modifier the app reads as Mod, decided as its isMacOrIos() decides it. */
function modKey(page: Page): Promise<'Meta' | 'Control'> {
  return page.evaluate(() => {
    const platform = (navigator as Navigator & { userAgentData?: { platform?: string } })
      .userAgentData?.platform;
    const mac = platform
      ? platform === 'macOS' || platform === 'iOS'
      : /Macintosh;.*Mac OS X/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
        /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent);
    return mac ? 'Meta' : 'Control';
  });
}
const undo = async (page: Page) => page.keyboard.press(`${await modKey(page)}+KeyZ`);
const redo = async (page: Page) => page.keyboard.press(`${await modKey(page)}+Shift+KeyZ`);

const twoFrames = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(
    () => new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(resolve))),
  );

const sorted = async (page: Page) => (await getSelectedProteinIds(page)).sort();

function isIsolated(page: Page): Promise<boolean> {
  return page
    .locator('#myPlot')
    .evaluate((plot) => (plot as Element & { isIsolationMode(): boolean }).isIsolationMode());
}

/** Selects the dataset's first `count` proteins through the search box, then leaves the box. */
async function selectFirstBySearch(page: Page, count: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const ids = await page
    .locator('#myPlot')
    .evaluate(
      (plot, n) =>
        (plot as Element & { data: { protein_ids: string[] } }).data.protein_ids.slice(0, n),
      count,
    );
  for (const id of ids) {
    await searchInput(page).fill(id);
    await searchInput(page).press('Enter');
  }
  await expect.poll(() => sorted(page)).toEqual([...ids].sort());
  await searchInput(page).blur();
  return ids;
}

/**
 * A one-condition filter keeping the first ten proteins, reported as the Filter's Apply reports
 * it: the filter controller hears the builder's query-changed and query-apply.
 */
async function applyOneConditionFilter(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.locator('#myQueryBuilder').evaluate((builder) => {
    const plot = document.querySelector('#myPlot') as Element & { selectedAnnotation: string };
    const query = [
      { id: 'e2e-filter', kind: 'categorical', annotation: plot.selectedAnnotation, values: ['e2e'] },
    ];
    builder.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('query-changed', { detail: { query } }));
    builder.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('query-apply', {
        detail: { matchedIndices: new Set(Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i)) },
      }),
    );
  });
}

const filtersActive = (page: Page) =>
  page
    .locator('#myPlot')
    .evaluate((plot) => (plot as Element & { filtersActive: boolean }).filtersActive);

test.describe('undo and redo', () => {
  test('box select → Ctrl+Z empties → Ctrl+Shift+Z restores', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await chooseTool(page, 'Box select');
    const plot = (await page.locator('#myPlot').boundingBox())!;
    await page.mouse.move(plot.x + plot.width * 0.25, plot.y + plot.height * 0.25);
    await page.mouse.down();
    await page.mouse.move(plot.x + plot.width * 0.75, plot.y + plot.height * 0.75, {
      steps: 10,
    });
    await page.mouse.up();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await getSelectedProteinIds(page)).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const ids = await sorted(page);

    await undo(page);
    await expect.poll(() => getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([]);

    await redo(page);
    await expect.poll(() => sorted(page)).toEqual(ids);
  });

  test('Show only these → Ctrl+Z returns the full view and the selection', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const ids = await selectFirstBySearch(page, 2);
    await selectionBarAction(page, 'Show only these').click();
    await expect.poll(() => isIsolated(page)).toBe(true);

    await undo(page);
    await expect.poll(() => isIsolated(page)).toBe(false);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'isolation')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => sorted(page)).toEqual([...ids].sort());
  });

  test('filter Apply → Ctrl+Z removes it and the chip goes; redo brings it back', async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyOneConditionFilter(page);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toContainText('Filtered · 1 condition');
    expect(await filtersActive(page)).toBe(true);

    await undo(page);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await filtersActive(page)).toBe(false);

    await redo(page);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toContainText('Filtered · 1 condition');
    expect(await filtersActive(page)).toBe(true);
  });

  test('Ctrl+Z in the search box edits the text and leaves the selection', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const [id] = await selectFirstBySearch(page, 1);
    await searchInput(page).click();
    await page.keyboard.type('abc');
    await expect(searchInput(page)).toHaveValue('abc');

    await undo(page);

    // The browser's own undo took the key.
    await expect(searchInput(page)).not.toHaveValue('abc');
    await twoFrames(page);
    expect(await getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([id]);
  });

  test('a new dataset clears the history', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    // Two steps: undoing the second would bring back the first protein, so a history that
    // survived the new dataset would show.
    await selectFirstBySearch(page, 2);

    await importUserFile(page, TOXPROT_5181_FIXTURE);
    await waitForProteinCount(page, 5181);
    await expect.poll(() => getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([]);
    await page.locator('#myPlot').focus();

    await undo(page);
    await twoFrames(page);
    expect(await getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```md
## Undo

⌘Z / Ctrl+Z undoes and ⇧⌘Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes (design decision 13) selection changes, Show only
these steps and leaving isolation, and filter Apply, Reset and the filter chip's ✕. The history
(`apps/web/src/explore/undo-history.ts`) is linear and holds each step's protein-id arrays by
reference, never copies; it keeps at most 100 steps and 2,000,000 ids, dropping the oldest. The
interaction controller owns it (`interactionController.history`). The selection controller records
and applies selection and isolation steps (`applyHistory`); the filter controller reports applied
filters (`onFilterCommitted`) and restores a snapshot's id set without evaluating the query again
(`restore`). `undo-controller.ts` owns only the keys: a press in a text field (an `INPUT`,
`TEXTAREA`, `SELECT` or contentEditable anywhere in the composed path), in an open modal or with Alt
is left alone. A new dataset clears the history. The EAT reliability slider, legend hiding and zoom
are not recorded.
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  REPORT_MISSING_LIMIT,
  lowerCaseIndex,
  parsePastedIds,
  resolveProteinIds,
} from './resolve-ids';

describe('parsePastedIds', () => {
  it('splits on whitespace, commas, semicolons and newlines, and drops empties', () => {
    expect(parsePastedIds(' P1, P2;P3\nP4\tP5\r\n ;; ,')).toEqual(['P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4', 'P5']);
    expect(parsePastedIds('   ')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('dedupes in order, by exact spelling', () => {
    expect(parsePastedIds('P2 P1 P2 p1')).toEqual(['P2', 'P1', 'p1']);
  });
});

describe('resolveProteinIds', () => {
  const available = ['P00595', 'Q12345', 'A0JMF6'];

  it('splits tokens into found, already selected and missing', () => {
    expect(resolveProteinIds(['P00595', 'Q12345', 'NOPE'], available, ['Q12345'])).toEqual({
      found: ['P00595'],
      alreadySelected: ['Q12345'],
      missing: ['NOPE'],
    });
  });

  it('resolves case-insensitively to the dataset’s spelling, once per protein', () => {
    expect(resolveProteinIds(['p00595', 'P00595', 'a0jmf6'], available, [])).toEqual({
      found: ['P00595', 'A0JMF6'],
      alreadySelected: [],
      missing: [],
    });
  });

  it('the index is reused for the same array and rebuilt for a new one', () => {
    const ids = ['P1', 'P2', 'P3'];
    expect(lowerCaseIndex(ids)).toBe(lowerCaseIndex(ids));
    expect(lowerCaseIndex([...ids])).not.toBe(lowerCaseIndex(ids));
    expect(lowerCaseIndex(ids).get('p2')).toBe('P2');
  });

  it('resolves 10,000 tokens against 50,000 ids in well under a second (a coarse guard against a quadratic resolve)', () => {
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 50_000 }, (_, i) => `P${String(i).padStart(6, '0')}`);
    const tokens = Array.from({ length: 10_000 }, (_, i) =>
      i % 3 === 0 ? `MISSING${i}` : i % 3 === 1 ? ids[i * 4] : ids[i * 4].toLowerCase(),
```

Create `packages/core/src/components/protein-search/resolve-ids.ts`:

```ts
/** The most missing IDs a search report lists; "and N more" says how many it leaves out. */
export const REPORT_MISSING_LIMIT = 50;

/** A pasted list as IDs: split on whitespace, commas and semicolons, empties dropped, deduped. */
export function parsePastedIds(text: string): string[] {
  return [...new Set(text.split(/[\s,;]+/).filter(Boolean))];
}

// Keyed by the array the search was handed, so a paste at 573K proteins builds each index once
// per dataset, not once per paste; a new dataset is a new array and the old index is collected.
const exactIndexes = new WeakMap<readonly string[], ReadonlySet<string>>();
const lowerIndexes = new WeakMap<readonly string[], ReadonlyMap<string, string>>();

function exactIndex(available: readonly string[]): ReadonlySet<string> {
  let index = exactIndexes.get(available);
  if (!index) {
    index = new Set(available);
    exactIndexes.set(available, index);
  }
  return index;
}

/**
 * Lower-case spelling → the dataset's own spelling, built once per `available` array; the first
 * protein wins a collision.
 */
export function lowerCaseIndex(available: readonly string[]): ReadonlyMap<string, string> {
  let index = lowerIndexes.get(available);
  if (!index) {
    const built = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const id of available) {
      const key = id.toLowerCase();
      if (!built.has(key)) built.set(key, id);
    }
    index = built;
    lowerIndexes.set(available, index);
  }
  return index;
}

/**
 * Which of `tokens` name a protein in `available`: exact spelling first, then case-insensitively,
 * always reported in the dataset's spelling and once per protein. `found` are not selected yet,
 * `alreadySelected` are, `missing` are the tokens as pasted. The lower-case index is built only
 * when a token does not match exactly.
 */
export function resolveProteinIds(
  tokens: readonly string[],
  available: readonly string[],
  selected: readonly string[],
): { found: string[]; alreadySelected: string[]; missing: string[] } {
  const exact = exactIndex(available);
  let lower: ReadonlyMap<string, string> | undefined;
  const chosen = new Set(selected);
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const found: string[] = [];
  const alreadySelected: string[] = [];
  const missing: string[] = [];
  for (const token of tokens) {
    let id: string | undefined = exact.has(token) ? token : undefined;
    if (id === undefined) {
      lower ??= lowerCaseIndex(available);
      id = lower.get(token.toLowerCase());
    }
    if (id === undefined) {
      missing.push(token);
      continue;
    }
    if (seen.has(id)) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    (chosen.has(id) ? alreadySelected : found).push(id);
  }
  return { found, alreadySelected, missing };
}
```

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { formatCount } from '@protspace/utils';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';
import { REPORT_MISSING_LIMIT } from './resolve-ids';

/** What the search says under its field after an Enter, a paste or a hidden hit (decision 15). */
export type SearchReport =
  | { kind: 'missing-one'; id: string }
  | { kind: 'already-selected'; id: string }
  | { kind: 'not-in-view'; id: string }
  | { kind: 'bulk'; found: number; total: number; missing: readonly string[] };

function line(text: string): TemplateResult {
  return html`<div class="search-report" role="status">
    <p class="search-report-line">${text}</p>
  </div>`;
}

/**
 * The report in the search's popup. A pasted list's missing IDs are listed up to
 * `REPORT_MISSING_LIMIT`, so 10,000 unknown IDs draw 50 rows; Copy takes all of them.
 */
export function renderSearchReport(report: SearchReport, onCopy: () => void): TemplateResult {
  switch (report.kind) {
    case 'missing-one':
      return line(`No protein ${report.id} in this dataset`);
    case 'already-selected':
      return line(`${report.id} is already selected`);
    case 'not-in-view':
      return line(`${report.id} is selected but hidden in this view`);
    case 'bulk': {
      const shown = report.missing.slice(0, REPORT_MISSING_LIMIT);
      const more = report.missing.length - shown.length;
      return html`<div class="search-report" role="status">
        <p class="search-report-line">
          ${formatCount(report.found)} of ${formatCount(report.total)} found
        </p>
        ${report.missing.length > 0
          ? html`<p class="search-report-heading" id="search-report-missing">Not found</p>
              <ul class="search-report-missing" aria-labelledby="search-report-missing">
                ${shown.map((id) => html`<li>${id}</li>`)}
              </ul>
              ${more > 0
                ? html`<p class="search-report-more">and ${formatCount(more)} more</p>`
                : nothing}
              <ps-button class="search-report-copy" size="sm" variant="ghost" @click=${onCopy}
                ><span slot="start">${icon('copy', 14)}</span>Copy missing IDs</ps-button
              >`
          : nothing}
      </div>`;
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
const reportOf = (element: ProteinSearchElement): HTMLElement | null =>
  element.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.search-report');

/** A paste of `text` into the input, as a browser fires it. */
function paste(element: ProteinSearchElement, text: string): Event {
  const event = new Event('paste', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true });
  Object.defineProperty(event, 'clipboardData', { value: { getData: () => text } });
  inputOf(element).dispatchEvent(event);
  return event;
}

/** Record the detail of every `type` event the element emits, in order. */
const captureDetails = <T>(element: ProteinSearchElement, type: string): T[] => {
  const seen: T[] = [];
  element.addEventListener(type, (event) => seen.push((event as CustomEvent<T>).detail));
  return seen;
};
```

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing, type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { property, state } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import { isMacOrIos } from '@protspace/utils';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import { handleDropdownEscape, scrollHighlightedIntoView } from '../../utils/dropdown-helpers';
import '../kit/button';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';
import { pushLayer } from '../kit/layers';
import { searchStyles } from './protein-search.styles';
import { parsePastedIds, resolveProteinIds } from './resolve-ids';
import { renderSearchReport, type SearchReport } from './search-report';
import { computeSearchSuggestions, type SearchSuggestion } from './search-suggestions';

const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 120;

/**
 * `aria-activedescendant` needs a stable id per row so assistive tech can announce the
 * keyboard cursor. `aria-selected` is left to mean what it means in a multi-selectable
 * listbox — "this protein is in the selection" — rather than doubling as the cursor.
 */
const SUGGESTIONS_LIST_ID = 'protein-search-suggestions';
const REPORT_ID = 'protein-search-report';
const suggestionRowId = (index: number) => `${SUGGESTIONS_LIST_ID}-${index}`;

type AddSource = 'typed' | 'suggestion';

/**
 * Protein search (design decision 15): suggestions while typing, a pasted list of IDs, and a
 * report of what happened — an unknown ID, an ID already selected, a pasted list with missing IDs,
 * or a pick hidden in the current view. It writes nothing to the plot: the host listens for its
 * events.
 */
@customElement('protspace-protein-search')
export class ProtspaceProteinSearch extends LitElement {
  static styles = searchStyles;

  @property({ type: Array }) availableProteinIds: string[] = [];
  @property({ type: Array }) selectedProteinIds: string[] = [];

  @state() private searchQuery: string = '';
  @state() private searchSuggestions: SearchSuggestion[] = [];
  @state() private highlightedSuggestionIndex: number = -1;
  @state() private isInputFocused: boolean = false;
  @state() private isSuggestionDropdownOpen: boolean = false;
  /** What the last Enter, paste or hidden pick came to; shown in the popup in place of the list. */
  @state() private _report: SearchReport | null = null;

  private _suggestionDebounceId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private _blurTimeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  /** Releases the popup's layer; set while the list or the report is on screen. */
  private _releaseLayer?: () => void;
  private _layerFor: 'suggestions' | 'report' | null = null;

  /** True exactly when `render()` emits the listbox that the combobox ARIA refers to. */
  private get _isListboxRendered(): boolean {
    return !this._report && this.isSuggestionDropdownOpen && this.searchSuggestions.length > 0;
  }

  /**
   * True whenever `render()` emits a popup at all — the listbox, the no-match message or the
   * report. `aria-expanded` tracks this: a combobox whose popup is on screen must report itself
   * expanded.
   */
  private get _isPopupRendered(): boolean {
    return (
      this._report !== null ||
      this._isListboxRendered ||
      (this.isSuggestionDropdownOpen && this.searchQuery.trim().length > 0)
    );
  }

  render() {
    const popupId = this._report ? REPORT_ID : SUGGESTIONS_LIST_ID;
    return html`
      <div class="search-container">
        <div class="search-chips" @click=${this._focusSearchInput}>
          <span class="search-icon" aria-hidden="true">${icon('search', 14)}</span>
          <input
            id="protein-search-input"
            class="search-input"
            type="text"
            .value=${this.searchQuery}
            placeholder="Search proteins or paste IDs"
            aria-label="Search proteins"
            aria-keyshortcuts="Control+K Meta+K"
            role="combobox"
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-expanded=${this._isPopupRendered}
            aria-controls=${this._isPopupRendered ? popupId : nothing}
            aria-activedescendant=${!this._report && this.highlightedSuggestionIndex >= 0
              ? suggestionRowId(this.highlightedSuggestionIndex)
              : nothing}
            @input=${this._onSearchInput}
            @keydown=${this._onSearchKeydown}
            @blur=${this._onInputBlur}
            @focus=${this._onInputFocus}
            @paste=${this._onPaste}
          />

          <div class="search-keyboard-shortcut-hint" aria-hidden="true">
            <kbd>${isMacOrIos() ? html`⌘K` : html`^K`}</kbd>
          </div>
        </div>

        ${this._renderPopup()}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  /**
   * The report, the listbox, the no-match message, or nothing. The list is a scroll container,
   * which Chrome makes a Tab stop; `tabindex="-1"` keeps focus in the input (the combobox
   * pattern: `aria-activedescendant` moves instead).
   */
  private _renderPopup() {
    if (this._report) {
      return html`<div class="search-popup" id=${REPORT_ID} @focusout=${this._onReportFocusOut}>
        ${renderSearchReport(this._report, () => this._copyMissing())}
      </div>`;
    }
    if (this._isListboxRendered) {
      return html`
        <div
          class="search-suggestions"
          id=${SUGGESTIONS_LIST_ID}
          role="listbox"
          aria-multiselectable="true"
          tabindex="-1"
        >
          ${this.searchSuggestions.map((suggestion, i) => this._renderSuggestion(suggestion, i))}
        </div>
      `;
    }
    if (this._isPopupRendered) {
      // Same id and role as the listbox branch: `aria-controls` has to name whichever popup
      // is on screen, and a combobox's controlled popup has to *be* one — an empty listbox
      // is valid, a bare div is not. Only one of the two branches ever renders.
      return html`
        <div class="search-suggestions" id=${SUGGESTIONS_LIST_ID} role="listbox" tabindex="-1">
          <div class="no-results" role="status">No matching protein IDs found</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }
    return nothing;
  }

  private _renderSuggestion(suggestion: SearchSuggestion, index: number) {
    return html`
      <div
        class="search-suggestion ${index === this.highlightedSuggestionIndex
          ? 'active'
          : ''} ${suggestion.isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}"
        id=${suggestionRowId(index)}
        role="option"
        aria-selected=${suggestion.isSelected}
        aria-label=${suggestion.isSelected
          ? `${suggestion.id}, remove from selection`
          : suggestion.id}
        @mousedown=${(e: Event) => {
          // Use mousedown to avoid blur before click
          e.preventDefault();
          this._activateSuggestion(suggestion);
        }}
      >
        ${suggestion.id}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  connectedCallback(): void {
    super.connectedCallback();
    window.addEventListener('keydown', this._handleBodyKeydown);
  }

  disconnectedCallback(): void {
    super.disconnectedCallback();
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._handleBodyKeydown);
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
    this._clearBlurTimeout();
    this._releaseLayer?.();
    this._releaseLayer = undefined;
    this._layerFor = null;
  }

  protected willUpdate(changed: PropertyValues<this>): void {
    // `searchSuggestions` is computed on a debounce, so a selection change made elsewhere
    // (including this component's own remove, which keeps the query) would otherwise leave
    // the open dropdown stale. Recomputing here cannot loop: it only writes
    // `searchSuggestions`, never `selectedProteinIds`.
    if (!changed.has('selectedProteinIds') && !changed.has('availableProteinIds')) return;
    if (!this.searchQuery.trim() && !this.isInputFocused) return;
    // Result count cannot identify whether the dropdown is closed: an open no-match
    // state also has zero suggestions. Track open state explicitly so dataset changes
    // refresh empty results without reopening after add, Escape, or blur.
    if (!this.isSuggestionDropdownOpen) return;
    this._updateSuggestions(true);
  }

  // `PropertyValues<this>` (as used by `willUpdate` above) types `.has()` against
  // `keyof this`, which TypeScript excludes private members from — so a private @state
  // field like `highlightedSuggestionIndex` needs the untyped `Map<string, unknown>` form.
  protected updated(changed: Map<string, unknown>): void {
    this._syncLayer();
    // `.search-suggestions` is a fixed-height (max-height: 20rem) scroll container fitting
    // ~8 rows, so past that arrow-key navigation would run off screen (issue #413).
    if (!changed.has('highlightedSuggestionIndex')) return;
    if (this.highlightedSuggestionIndex < 0) return;
    scrollHighlightedIntoView(this.shadowRoot, '.search-suggestion.active');
  }

  /**
   * While a popup shows it is a layer, so Escape closes it before the page clears the selection
   * (one step per press). The suggestion list closes and resets the search, and leaves outside
   * presses to the input's blur, as before; the report closes on its own, keeps the typed text,
   * and closes on a press outside too.
   */
  private _syncLayer(): void {
    const want = this._report
      ? 'report'
      : this._isPopupRendered
        ? 'suggestions'
        : null;
    if (want === this._layerFor) return;
    this._releaseLayer?.();
    this._releaseLayer = undefined;
    this._layerFor = want;
    if (want === 'report') {
      this._releaseLayer = pushLayer({
        close: () => this._dismissReport(),
        elements: [this],
      });
    } else if (want === 'suggestions') {
      this._releaseLayer = pushLayer({
        close: () => this._resetSearch(),
        elements: [this],
        dismissOnOutsidePress: false,
      });
    }
  }

  private _handleBodyKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if ((event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) && event.key === 'k') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this._focusSearchInput();
    }
  };

  /**
   * Bound to `.search-chips` — the input's own row — and deliberately not to
   * `.search-container`. The popup is absolutely positioned but is still a child of the
   * container, so a container-level handler would refocus the input on every suggestion click.
   * In the 200ms blur grace window the input is not focused, so that refocus fires
   * `_onInputFocus` and reopens the dropdown against the query a click-add just cleared.
   */
  private _focusSearchInput() {
    const input = this.shadowRoot?.querySelector(
      '#protein-search-input',
    ) as HTMLInputElement | null;
    input?.focus();
  }

  private _onPaste(e: ClipboardEvent) {
    const pastedText = e.clipboardData?.getData('text/plain') ?? '';
    const tokens = parsePastedIds(pastedText);

    if (tokens.length > 1 || pastedText.includes('\n')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (tokens.length > 0) this._addMultipleSelections(tokens);
    }
  }

  private _onSearchInput(event: Event) {
    const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.searchQuery = target.value;
    this._report = null;
    // Opening is deliberately left to `_updateSuggestions` on the debounce. Opening here
    // would render the previous close's empty `searchSuggestions` against a non-empty
    // query, i.e. flash `No matching protein IDs found` for SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS on the
    // first keystroke after every add, Escape, or blur. While the dropdown is already
    // open it stays open, so continuous typing is unaffected.
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
    this._suggestionDebounceId = setTimeout(() => {
      this._suggestionDebounceId = null;
      this._updateSuggestions();
    }, SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  }

  private _onSearchKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      this._flushSuggestions();
    }
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (
        this.highlightedSuggestionIndex >= 0 &&
        this.highlightedSuggestionIndex < this.searchSuggestions.length
      ) {
        this._activateSuggestion(this.searchSuggestions[this.highlightedSuggestionIndex]);
      } else if (this.searchQuery.trim()) {
        this._addSelection(this.searchQuery.trim(), 'typed');
      }
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (this.searchSuggestions.length > 0) {
        const next = Math.min(
          this.highlightedSuggestionIndex + 1,
          this.searchSuggestions.length - 1,
        );
        this.highlightedSuggestionIndex = next;
      }
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (this.searchSuggestions.length > 0) {
        const prev = Math.max(this.highlightedSuggestionIndex - 1, 0);
        this.highlightedSuggestionIndex = prev;
      }
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape' && (this.searchQuery || this._isPopupRendered)) {
      // The layer normally takes Escape first; this covers a typed query whose list has not
      // opened yet. With nothing to close, Escape passes on to clear the selection.
      handleDropdownEscape(event, () => this._resetSearch());
    }
  }

  private _onInputFocus() {
    this.isInputFocused = true;
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
    this._clearBlurTimeout();
    this._updateSuggestions();
  }

  private _onInputBlur() {
    this.isInputFocused = false;
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
    // Delay clearing suggestions to allow mousedown to fire on suggestions; a report keeps
    // showing while focus is on its Copy button.
    this._blurTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      this._blurTimeoutId = null;
      this._closeDropdown();
      if (!this._reportHasFocus()) this._report = null;
    }, 200);
  }

  /** Focus left the report for somewhere other than this search: the report goes. */
  private _onReportFocusOut = (event: FocusEvent) => {
    const next = event.relatedTarget as Node | null;
    if (next && (this.shadowRoot?.contains(next) || this.contains(next))) return;
    this._report = null;
  };

  private _reportHasFocus(): boolean {
    const active = this.shadowRoot?.activeElement;
    return !!active?.closest('.search-popup');
  }

  private _dismissReport() {
    this._report = null;
  }

  private _copyMissing() {
    const report = this._report;
    if (report?.kind !== 'bulk') return;
    void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(report.missing.join('\n')).catch(() => {
      // The browser refused the clipboard: the list stays on screen to copy by hand.
    });
  }

  private _clearSuggestionDebounce() {
    if (this._suggestionDebounceId !== null) {
      clearTimeout(this._suggestionDebounceId);
      this._suggestionDebounceId = null;
    }
  }

  /** Collapse the dropdown, leaving the query intact. */
  private _closeDropdown() {
    this.searchSuggestions = [];
    this.highlightedSuggestionIndex = -1;
    this.isSuggestionDropdownOpen = false;
  }

  /** Close the dropdown and clear the query — the reset every activation path shares. */
  private _resetSearch() {
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
    this.searchQuery = '';
    this._closeDropdown();
  }

  private _clearBlurTimeout() {
    if (this._blurTimeoutId !== null) {
      clearTimeout(this._blurTimeoutId);
      this._blurTimeoutId = null;
    }
  }

  private _flushSuggestions() {
    // Only settle a pending debounce. Recomputing when the list is already current
    // resets the highlight to 0, which would make arrow navigation impossible and
    // send Enter to the wrong row.
    if (this._suggestionDebounceId === null) return;
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
    this._updateSuggestions();
  }

  private _updateSuggestions(preserveHighlight = false) {
    const previousIndex = this.highlightedSuggestionIndex;
    this.searchSuggestions = computeSearchSuggestions(
      this.availableProteinIds,
      this.selectedProteinIds,
      this.searchQuery,
      this.isInputFocused,
    );
    // Every caller (focus, debounce, flush, and the open-guarded `willUpdate`) is a
    // reason for the list to be showing, and settling the open state here rather than
    // at the keystroke keeps the dropdown and its contents in the same commit.
    this.isSuggestionDropdownOpen = true;

    if (this.searchSuggestions.length === 0) {
      this.highlightedSuggestionIndex = -1;
      return;
    }

    // `Math.min` alone, so a preserved -1 stays -1: an input-driven refresh must not
    // invent a keyboard cursor the user never moved, or Enter would activate a row
    // they never highlighted.
    if (preserveHighlight) {
      this.highlightedSuggestionIndex = Math.min(previousIndex, this.searchSuggestions.length - 1);
      return;
    }
    // Seed row 0 only for a typed query, where Enter plainly means "take this match".
    // On a bare focus the list is the *current selection* plus arbitrary head-of-dataset
    // entries, and row 0 is usually a marked row — seeding it there would make a reflexive
    // Enter (or a screen reader following `aria-activedescendant`) silently REMOVE a
    // protein the user never pointed at. Arrow keys still start at row 0 from -1.
    this.highlightedSuggestionIndex = this.searchQuery.trim() ? 0 : -1;
  }

  private _activateSuggestion(suggestion: SearchSuggestion) {
    if (suggestion.isSelected) {
      this._removeSelection(suggestion.id);
    } else {
      this._addSelection(suggestion.id, 'suggestion');
    }
  }

  private _removeSelection(id: string) {
    if (!this.selectedProteinIds.includes(id)) return;

    // Deliberately keeps `searchQuery` and the open dropdown so several proteins can be
    // pruned from one result set without retyping. `willUpdate` refreshes the list when
    // the parent echoes the new selection back down.
    this._clearSuggestionDebounce();

    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('remove-selection', {
        detail: { proteinId: id },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  }

  /**
   * The dataset's own spelling of `id`, or `undefined` when it names no protein.
   *
   * Exact hit first — that is the path every suggestion activation takes, and `includes`
   * stops at the match. Only a miss (a hand-typed ID in the wrong case, or one that is not
   * in the dataset at all) pays for the case-insensitive sweep, and `id.toLowerCase()` is
   * hoisted out of the predicate: inside it, a value that never changes was recomputed once
   * per available protein — 573K throwaway strings per keystroke-committing Enter.
   */
  private _canonicalProteinId(id: string): string | undefined {
    if (this.availableProteinIds.includes(id)) return id;
    const lowerId = id.toLowerCase();
    return this.availableProteinIds.find((p) => p.toLowerCase() === lowerId);
  }

  private _addSelection(id: string, source: AddSource) {
    if (!id) return;

    const validId = this._canonicalProteinId(id);
    // Nothing to add: say why, and keep the text so it can be corrected.
    if (!validId || this.selectedProteinIds.includes(validId)) {
      this._clearSuggestionDebounce();
      this._closeDropdown();
      this._report = validId
        ? { kind: 'already-selected', id: validId }
        : { kind: 'missing-one', id };
      return;
    }

    this._resetSearch();
    this._report = null;

    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('add-selection', {
        detail: { proteinId: validId, source },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  }

  private _addMultipleSelections(tokens: string[]) {
    const { found, alreadySelected, missing } = resolveProteinIds(
      tokens,
      this.availableProteinIds,
      this.selectedProteinIds,
    );

    this._resetSearch();

    if (found.length > 0) {
      this.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('add-selection-multiple', {
          detail: { proteinIds: found, missing },
          bubbles: true,
          composed: true,
        }),
      );
    }

    // All found and new: the selection bar carries the result, so no report.
    this._report =
      missing.length > 0 || alreadySelected.length > 0
        ? {
            kind: 'bulk',
            found: found.length + alreadySelected.length,
            total: tokens.length,
            missing,
          }
        : null;
  }

  /**
   * Public API: the host could not show `proteinId` after selecting it (the filter, an
   * isolation or a hidden category keeps it out of view), so the search says so.
   */
  public reportNotInView(proteinId: string): void {
    this._closeDropdown();
    this._report = { kind: 'not-in-view', id: proteinId };
  }

  /**
   * Public API: Clear all selections
   */
  public clearSelections() {
    if (this.selectedProteinIds.length > 0) {
      this.selectedProteinIds = [];

      this.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('selection-change', {
          detail: { proteinIds: [] },
          bubbles: true,
          composed: true,
        }),
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Public API: Set selections programmatically
   */
  public setSelections(proteinIds: string[]) {
    const validIds = proteinIds.filter((id) => this.availableProteinIds.includes(id));
    if (JSON.stringify(validIds) !== JSON.stringify(this.selectedProteinIds)) {
      this.selectedProteinIds = validIds;

      this.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('selection-change', {
          detail: { proteinIds: validIds },
          bubbles: true,
          composed: true,
        }),
      );
    }
  }
}

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    'protspace-protein-search': ProtspaceProteinSearch;
  }
}
```

```ts
    .evaluate(

/** Pastes `text` into the search box, as a browser does on ⌘V / Ctrl+V. */
async function paste(page: Page, text: string): Promise<void> {

  await searchInput(page).evaluate((input, value) => {
    const data = new DataTransfer();
    data.setData('text/plain', value);
    input.dispatchEvent(
      new ClipboardEvent('paste', {
        clipboardData: data,
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  }, text);
}

    return { k, x, y };
  });
}

    await expect(searchInput(page)).toHaveValue('NOT_A_PROTEIN_ZZZ');
    expect(await getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([]);

    // One Escape closes the report and keeps the text; the next empties the box.
    await searchInput(page).press('Escape');
    await expect(search(page).getByRole('status')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(searchInput(page)).toHaveValue('NOT_A_PROTEIN_ZZZ');
    await searchInput(page).press('Escape');
    await expect(searchInput(page)).toHaveValue('');
  });

  test('pasting a list reports found and missing, and Copy missing IDs copies them', async ({
    page,
    context,
  }) => {
    await context.grantPermissions(['clipboard-read', 'clipboard-write']);
    await openExplore(page);
    const [a, b] = await proteinIds(page, 2);

    await paste(page, `${a}, ${b.toLowerCase()}; MISSING_ONE\nMISSING_TWO`);

    const report = search(page).getByRole('status');
    await expect(report).toContainText('2 of 4 found');
    await expect(report.getByRole('listitem')).toHaveText(['MISSING_ONE', 'MISSING_TWO']);
    await expect.poll(() => getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([a, b]);

    await report.getByRole('button', { name: 'Copy missing IDs' }).click();
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText())).toBe(
      'MISSING_ONE\nMISSING_TWO',
    );
    // Copying keeps the report on screen.
    await expect(report).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('a single hit moves the protein to the plot centre ±2 px', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const [id] = await proteinIds(page, 1);

    await searchInput(page).fill(id);
    await searchInput(page).press('Enter');

    await expect.poll(() => getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual([id]);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await readTransform(page)).k).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8);
    const plot = (await page.locator('#myPlot').boundingBox())!;
    const at = await page.locator('#myPlot').evaluate(
      (element, proteinId) =>
        (
          element as Element & {
            getProteinClientPosition(id: string): { x: number; y: number } | null;
          }
        ).getProteinClientPosition(proteinId),
      id,
    );
    expect(at).not.toBeNull();
    expect(Math.abs(at!.x - (plot.x + plot.width / 2))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(Math.abs(at!.y - (plot.y + plot.height / 2))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
  });

  test('a pasted list selects without zooming and the selection bar offers Zoom to them', async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    const ids = await proteinIds(page, 3);
    const before = await readTransform(page);

    await paste(page, ids.join('\n'));

    await expect.poll(() => getSelectedProteinIds(page)).toEqual(ids);
    expect(await readTransform(page)).toEqual(before);
    // Everything was found: the selection bar carries the result, the search reports nothing.
    await expect(search(page).getByRole('status')).toHaveCount(0);

    await selectionBarAction(page, 'Zoom to them').click();
    await expect.poll(() => readTransform(page)).not.toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: notify — implement**

Replace `apps/web/src/lib/notify.ts` with:

```ts
import { toast } from '../components/ui/sonner';

/** A toast button: it opens a link, or runs a callback. Either way it dismisses the toast. */
type NotifyAction =
  | {
      /** Button label shown on the toast. */
      label: string;
      /** Link the action opens — a `mailto:` or an `http(s)` URL. */
      href: string;
    }
  | {
      /** Button label shown on the toast. */
      label: string;
      onClick: () => void;
    };

export interface NotifyOptions {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
  dedupeKey?: string;
  /** Optional primary action button (e.g. "Retry", or a "Report this" bug-report link). */
  action?: NotifyAction;
  /** Optional second, muted button beside the primary one (sonner's `cancel`). */
  secondaryAction?: NotifyAction;
}

type NotifyLevel = 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'error';
/** A shown toast; undefined when a repeat inside the dedupe window was skipped. */
type ToastId = string | number;

const DEFAULT_DURATIONS_MS: Record<NotifyLevel, number> = {
  success: 4_000,
  info: 5_000,
  warning: 8_000,
  error: 10_000,
};

/** How long an Undo stays offered (design decision 15). */
const UNDO_DURATION_MS = 8_000;

const DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS = 5_000;
const recentNotifications = new Map<string, number>();

/** The toaster every toast goes to while set: the workbench's own, on /explore. */
let notifyTarget: string | null = null;

/**
 * Routes every toast to the `<Toaster id={toasterId}>` (the workbench's, at the plot's bottom
 * edge); null returns them to the app's toaster. The workbench sets it while it is mounted.
 */
export function setNotifyTarget(toasterId: string | null): void {
  notifyTarget = toasterId;
}

function pruneExpiredDedupes(now: number): void {
  for (const [key, timestamp] of recentNotifications.entries()) {
    if (now - timestamp >= DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS) {
      recentNotifications.delete(key);
    }
  }
}

function shouldSkipNotification(dedupeKey?: string): boolean {
  if (!dedupeKey) {
    return false;
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  pruneExpiredDedupes(now);

  const previousTimestamp = recentNotifications.get(dedupeKey);
  if (previousTimestamp && now - previousTimestamp < DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS) {
    return true;
  }

  recentNotifications.set(dedupeKey, now);
  return false;
}

function openHref(href: string): void {
  // A `mailto:` should hand off to the mail client in place; web links open
  // in a new tab so the user keeps their ProtSpace session.
  if (href.startsWith('mailto:')) {
    window.location.href = href;
  } else {
    window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }
}

function emitNotification(
  level: NotifyLevel,
  options: NotifyOptions,
  /** Runs when the toast goes: dismissed (its ✕ or code) or timed out. */
  onClose?: () => void,
): ToastId | undefined {
  if (shouldSkipNotification(options.dedupeKey)) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const description = options.description?.trim();
  const duration = options.durationMs ?? DEFAULT_DURATIONS_MS[level];
  const { action, secondaryAction, dedupeKey } = options;

  const toSonnerAction = (notifyAction: NotifyAction) => ({
    label: notifyAction.label,
    onClick: () => {
      // Acting on a toast dismisses it, so the same message may show again
      // right away: a Retry that fails again must be able to say so.
      if (dedupeKey) {
        recentNotifications.delete(dedupeKey);
      }
      if ('href' in notifyAction) {
        openHref(notifyAction.href);
      } else {
        notifyAction.onClick();
      }
    },
  });

  return toast[level](options.title, {
    description,
    duration,
    ...(notifyTarget ? { toasterId: notifyTarget } : {}),
    ...(action && { action: toSonnerAction(action) }),
    ...(secondaryAction && { cancel: toSonnerAction(secondaryAction) }),
    ...(onClose && { onDismiss: onClose, onAutoClose: onClose }),
  });
}

export const notify = {
  success(options: NotifyOptions): ToastId | undefined {
    return emitNotification('success', options);
  },
  info(options: NotifyOptions): ToastId | undefined {
    return emitNotification('info', options);
  },
  warning(options: NotifyOptions): ToastId | undefined {
    return emitNotification('warning', options);
  },
  error(options: NotifyOptions): ToastId | undefined {
    return emitNotification('error', options);
  },
  dismiss(id: ToastId): void {
    toast.dismiss(id);
  },
  /**
   * An info toast with an Undo button, offered for 8 s (design decision 13). `onUndo` runs at
   * most once; the handle dismisses the toast early, when the step it would undo is gone.
   */
  undoable({
    title,
    description,
    onUndo,
    onClose,
    durationMs = UNDO_DURATION_MS,
  }: {
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    onUndo(): void;
    /** The toast went (dismissed or timed out): the caller drops what it kept for it. */
    onClose?(): void;
    durationMs?: number;
  }): { dismiss(): void } {
    let used = false;
    const id = emitNotification(
      'info',
      {
        title,
        description,
        durationMs,
        action: {
          label: 'Undo',
          onClick: () => {
            if (used) return;
            used = true;
            onUndo();
          },
        },
      },
      onClose,
    );
    return {
      dismiss() {
        if (id !== undefined) toast.dismiss(id);
      },
    };
  },
};

export function resetNotifyStateForTests(): void {
  recentNotifications.clear();
  notifyTarget = null;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: The confirmation dialog**

Create `apps/web/src/explore/confirm-dialog.ts`:

```ts
import type { PsDialog } from '@protspace/core';

interface ConfirmOptions {
  heading: string;
  body: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** The confirm button reads as destructive. */
  danger?: boolean;
  /** Where focus goes after the dialog closes, when the control that opened it is gone. */
  returnFocusTo?: HTMLElement | null;
}

/**
 * Asks a yes-or-no question in a small kit dialog (design decision 15: clearing stored data asks
 * first, because nothing can restore it). Resolves true only on the confirm button; Cancel,
 * Escape, the backdrop and the dialog's own close resolve false. The dialog removes itself. Cancel
 * takes focus first, so a reflexive Enter does not destroy anything.
 */
export function confirmAction(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean> {
  const dialog = document.createElement('ps-dialog') as PsDialog;
  dialog.heading = options.heading;
  dialog.size = 'sm';

  const body = document.createElement('p');
  body.className = 'wb-confirm-body';
  body.textContent = options.body;

  const cancel = document.createElement('ps-button');
  cancel.slot = 'footer';
  cancel.setAttribute('variant', 'secondary');
  cancel.setAttribute('autofocus', '');
  cancel.textContent = options.cancelLabel ?? 'Cancel';

  const confirm = document.createElement('ps-button');
  confirm.slot = 'footer';
  confirm.setAttribute('variant', options.danger ? 'danger' : 'primary');
  confirm.textContent = options.confirmLabel;

  dialog.append(body, cancel, confirm);

  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (confirmed: boolean) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      dialog.removeEventListener('ps-close', onClose);
      // Closes it (a no-op when Escape or the backdrop already did) and returns focus.
      dialog.dismiss();
      dialog.remove();
      if (options.returnFocusTo?.isConnected) options.returnFocusTo.focus();
      resolve(confirmed);
    };
    const onClose = () => finish(false);
    dialog.addEventListener('ps-close', onClose);
    cancel.addEventListener('click', () => finish(false));
    confirm.addEventListener('click', () => finish(true));
    document.body.append(dialog);
    dialog.open = true;
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The recovery banner on the kit, in the plot area**

Replace `apps/web/src/explore/recovery-banner.ts` with:

```ts
import { type RecoveryBannerCopy, getLoadRecoveryCopy } from './notifications';

interface RecoveryBannerHandlers {
  onRetry(): Promise<void> | void;
  onLoadDefault(): Promise<void> | void;
  onClear(): Promise<void> | void;
}

interface ShowRecoveryBannerParams {
  fileName: string;
  failedAttempts: number;
  lastError?: string;
  handlers: RecoveryBannerHandlers;
  /** Mount target — defaults to the workbench's plot area, else document.body. */
  parent?: HTMLElement;
}

const BANNER_ID = 'protspace-recovery-banner';
const TITLE_ID = 'protspace-recovery-banner-title';

export function dismissRecoveryBanner(): void {
  document.getElementById(BANNER_ID)?.remove();
}

function kitButton(
  label: string,
  variant: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger',
  onClick: () => void,
): HTMLElement {
  const button = document.createElement('ps-button');
  button.setAttribute('variant', variant);
  button.textContent = label;
  button.addEventListener('click', onClick);
  return button;
}

/**
 * The banner shown when the stored import did not finish loading last time (design decision 15).
 * It sits in the plot area, under the tool strip's row, built from kit buttons with the DOM API
 * (no markup strings). It is an alert, announced once, and never takes focus: the page stays
 * usable through Import, so it is not a dialog. Try again is off after three failed attempts.
 */
export function showRecoveryBanner(params: ShowRecoveryBannerParams): void {
  dismissRecoveryBanner();

  const copy: RecoveryBannerCopy = getLoadRecoveryCopy(
    params.fileName,
    params.failedAttempts,
    params.lastError,
  );
  const blocking = params.failedAttempts >= 3;

  const root = document.createElement('div');
  root.id = BANNER_ID;
  root.className = 'wb-recovery';
  root.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
  root.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', TITLE_ID);

  const header = document.createElement('div');
  header.className = 'wb-recovery-header';
  const title = document.createElement('p');
  title.id = TITLE_ID;
  title.className = 'wb-recovery-title';
  title.textContent = copy.title;
  const dismiss = document.createElement('ps-icon-button');
  dismiss.setAttribute('icon', 'x');
  dismiss.setAttribute('label', 'Dismiss');
  dismiss.setAttribute('size', 'sm');
  dismiss.addEventListener('click', () => dismissRecoveryBanner());
  header.append(title, dismiss);

  const body = document.createElement('p');
  body.className = 'wb-recovery-body';
  body.textContent = copy.body;

  const actions = document.createElement('div');
  actions.className = 'wb-recovery-actions';
  const retry = kitButton(copy.retryLabel, 'primary', () => void params.handlers.onRetry());
  retry.toggleAttribute('disabled', blocking);
  actions.append(
    retry,
    kitButton(copy.loadDefaultLabel, 'secondary', () => void params.handlers.onLoadDefault()),
    kitButton(copy.clearLabel, 'danger', () => void params.handlers.onClear()),
  );

  root.append(header, body, actions);

  const parent =
    params.parent ??
    document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-workbench="plot"]') ??
    document.body;
  parent.appendChild(root);
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, type CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { Toaster as Sonner } from 'sonner';
import { setNotifyTarget } from '../lib/notify';

const TOASTER_ID = 'workbench';

/** Sonner reads its toast width from --width; the style prop overrides its inline default. */
const TOASTER_STYLE = { '--width': '360px' } as CSSProperties;

/**
 * The workbench's own toaster (design decision 15): centred at the plot's bottom edge, so a
 * notification never covers the legend, at most three at a time, each with a close button. While
 * it is mounted every `notify` toast comes here; the app's toaster keeps the other routes'. Light
 * theme: the colours come from the --ps-* tokens in workbench.css, which follow the theme.
 */
export function WorkbenchToaster() {
  useEffect(() => {
    setNotifyTarget(TOASTER_ID);
    return () => setNotifyTarget(null);
  }, []);
  return (
    <Sonner
      id={TOASTER_ID}
      position="bottom-center"
      closeButton
      visibleToasts={3}
      theme="light"
      offset={{ bottom: 12 }}
      style={TOASTER_STYLE}
      toastOptions={{ closeButtonAriaLabel: 'Dismiss notification', className: 'wb-toast' }}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
  // "Filter removed" with Undo (decisions 13 and 15): the toast is a shortcut to the history step
  // it names, and goes as soon as a newer step would make its Undo take back something else.
  let stopWatchingFilterUndo: (() => void) | null = null;
  const offerFilterUndo = (entry: UndoEntry) => {
    stopWatchingFilterUndo?.();
    const { history } = interactionController;
    let unsubscribe: () => void = () => {};
    // Ends this toast's watch only: an older toast that closes late must not end a newer one's.
    const stop = () => {
      unsubscribe();
      if (stopWatchingFilterUndo === stop) stopWatchingFilterUndo = null;
    };
    const toast = notify.undoable({
      ...getFilterRemovedNotification(),
      onUndo: () => {
        stop();
        undoController.undoEntry(entry);
      },
      // Dismissed or timed out: the watcher goes with the toast.
      onClose: stop,
    });
    unsubscribe = history.subscribe(() => {
      if (history.peekUndo() === entry) return;
      stop();
      toast.dismiss();
    });
    stopWatchingFilterUndo = stop;
  };
  lifecycle.addCleanup(() => stopWatchingFilterUndo?.());
```

```ts
import { expect, test, type Locator, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  applyFirstCategoryFilter,
  clearStatusChip,
  closeFilterPanel,
  dismissTourIfPresent,
  filterButton,
  filterResetButton,
  openExplore,
  plotArea,
  searchInput,
  selectionBar,
  statusChip,
  waitForExploreDataLoad,
} from './helpers/explore';
import { clearOpfs, seedOpfsState } from './helpers/opfs';

const toast = (page: Page, text: string): Locator =>
  page.locator('[data-sonner-toast]').filter({ hasText: text });

/** The first protein id of the loaded dataset. */
function firstProteinId(page: Page): Promise<string> {
  return page
    .locator('#myPlot')
    .evaluate(
      (plot) => (plot as Element & { data?: { protein_ids?: string[] } }).data!.protein_ids![0],
    );
}

async function selectBySearch(page: Page, id: string): Promise<void> {
  await searchInput(page).fill(id);
  await searchInput(page).press('Enter');
  await expect(selectionBar(page)).toBeVisible();
}

test.describe('notifications', () => {
  test("a toast sits inside the plot's horizontal span, does not intersect #myLegend and has a close button named Dismiss notification", async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);
    await closeFilterPanel(page);

    await clearStatusChip(page, 'filter');

    const removed = toast(page, 'Filter removed');
    await expect(removed).toBeVisible();
    await expect(removed.getByRole('button', { name: 'Dismiss notification' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(removed.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' })).toBeVisible();
    const box = (await removed.boundingBox())!;
    const plot = (await plotArea(page).boundingBox())!;
    const legend = (await page.locator('#myLegend').boundingBox())!;
    expect(box.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(360);
    expect(box.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(plot.x);
    expect(box.x + box.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(plot.x + plot.width);
    expect(box.x + box.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(legend.x);
  });

  test('with a selection the toast sits above the selection bar', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await selectBySearch(page, await firstProteinId(page));
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);

    await filterResetButton(page).click();

    const removed = toast(page, 'Filter removed');
    await expect(removed).toBeVisible();
    const bar = (await selectionBar(page).boundingBox())!;
    // Sonner slides the toast in; read its box once it has settled.
    await expect
      .poll(async () => {
        const box = (await removed.boundingBox())!;
        return box.y + box.height;
      })
      .toBeLessThanOrEqual(bar.y);
  });

  test('Reset in the Filter panel shows Filter removed; Undo restores the chip and its count', async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);
    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toContainText('Filtered · 1 condition');

    await filterResetButton(page).click();

    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAccessibleName('Filter');
    const removed = toast(page, 'Filter removed');
    await removed.getByRole('button', { name: 'Undo' }).click();

    await expect(statusChip(page, 'filter')).toContainText('Filtered · 1 condition');
    await expect(filterButton(page)).toHaveAccessibleName('Filter, 1 condition applied');
    await expect(removed).toHaveCount(0);
  });

  test('a newer step dismisses the stale Undo toast', async ({ page }) => {
    await openExplore(page);
    await applyFirstCategoryFilter(page);
    await filterResetButton(page).click();
    const removed = toast(page, 'Filter removed');
    await expect(removed).toBeVisible();

    // A selection is a newer history step: Undo would no longer take back the removal.
    await selectBySearch(page, await firstProteinId(page));

    await expect(removed).toHaveCount(0);
  });
});

test.describe('clearing stored data', () => {

    await expect(confirm).toBeVisible();
```
