### Task 4.9: Info popover on the kit's popover

`protspace-info-popover` keeps its tag, properties and hover, pin and keyboard behaviour, but its bubble becomes a `ps-popover` in the top layer, so no panel, `translate` or `overflow` clips it and Escape and outside presses go through the layer stack (decisions 8, 11). One rebuild serves all six users: the annotation picker, the legend header, the EAT block, the score strips, the import menu and the projection details. Its stylesheet reads tokens and leaves the allowlist.

**Files:**

- Modify: `packages/core/src/components/common/info-popover.ts`, `info-popover.styles.ts` (LEGACY line removed), `info-popover.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/components/kit/icon.ts` (`external-link`: "Learn more ↗" loses its text glyph, design 8; first use, so the key lands here, not in 4.15)
- Create: `packages/core/src/components/common/info-popover.browser.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/styles/style-lint.test.ts`
- Modify where a user positioned or styled the old bubble: `scatter-plot/projection-metadata/projection-metadata.ts` (the `data-info-popover-boundary` attribute goes) and `projection-metadata.styles.ts` (its comment about the fixed bubble). `legend/styles/header.ts`, `control-bar/annotation-select.ts` and `import-menu/import-menu.ts` only size or place the host element and need no change (Step 6 checks this).
- Docs: `docs/developers/api/index.md` has no info-popover row (the element is internal, not exported from `@protspace/core`) and `docs/developers/style-architecture.md` does not name its styles; neither changes (Step 6 checks this).

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `ps-popover` (`.anchor`, `open`, `placement`, `panel-role`, `panel-label`, `ps-open`, `ps-close`, `dismiss()`; `packages/core/src/components/kit/popover.ts`), `focusRing` (`kit/kit-shared.styles.ts`), `icon('info', 14)` (`kit/icon.ts`), `Placement` (`kit/position.ts`); `adoptTheme` (`kit/adopt-theme.ts`), `onEscapeFallback`, `ESCAPE_ORDER` (`kit/layers.ts`) in the tests; the element's current properties and timers (`hovering`, `pinned`, `kbFocused`, `closeTimer`, `pointerInitiatedFocus`, `_row`, `_scheduleClose`, `_onRowPointerLeave`).
- Produces: `protspace-info-popover` with unchanged public properties `description`, `detail`, `docs-url`, `label`, `align` (`'left' | 'right'`), `placement` (`'bottom' | 'side'`) and the `.info-button` trigger (`aria-expanded`, named "Information about {label}", its current name). The bubble is `<ps-popover id=… .anchor=${infoButton} placement=${placement === 'side' ? 'right-start' : align === 'right' ? 'bottom-end' : 'bottom-start'} panel-role="dialog" panel-label="{label} information">` holding `div.popover` (`.popover-description`, `.popover-detail`, `a.popover-link`, classes kept for the e2e), open while hovered (same 140 ms grace), focused by keyboard or pinned by a click; Escape and an outside press close it through the layer (its own `_onKeydown` Escape branch, the document click listener, the scroll/resize listener and the side-placement coordinate code — `SideCoords`, `_computeSidePosition`, `_nearestClipRect`, `sideCoords`, `flipLeft`, `bottomShiftX`, `_computeBottomShift`, the `measuring` class, `POPOVER_BOUNDARY_ATTRIBUTE` — go). The trigger's `aria-controls` names the `ps-popover` host. Its `ps-close` is stopped at the element, so it never reaches a host's own `ps-close` listener. The side placement's keep-open region (the row) still keeps it open while the pointer moves from the icon to the bubble. Docs links open in a new tab as today.

**Tests:**

- `info-popover.test.ts` (jsdom): the non-opening cases stay: "renders nothing without a description or docs URL", "has no native title tooltip to collide with its own popover", "a closed trigger is collapsed and points at nothing", "renders a trigger for a detail-only popover". Every opening case moves to the browser test (jsdom has no `showPopover`).
- `info-popover.browser.test.ts`: "hover opens it, and leaving closes it after a short grace"; "a click pins it until a second click, Escape or a press outside, and Escape reaches no fallback"; "keyboard focus opens it and focus leaving closes it"; "relates the expanded trigger to a named, described dialog"; "renders the docs link in a new tab"; "side placement sits beside the row and stays open while the pointer crosses to it"; "inside a translated, overflow-hidden ps-popover panel the bubble is fully on screen and topmost at its centre" (the import-menu case); "Escape inside an open ps-popover closes the bubble first, then the panel".
- The users' tests pass: `control-bar/annotation-select.component.test.ts`, `legend/legend.header.test.ts`, `legend/legend.eat-controls.test.ts`, `legend/category-score-strip.component.test.ts`, `scatter-plot/projection-metadata/projection-metadata.component.test.ts`, `import-menu/import-menu.test.ts`.
- `style-lint.test.ts`: LEGACY one shorter.
- E2E: `workbench-import-export.spec.ts`'s example ⓘ check and `example-datasets.spec.ts` (`[data-example-info]`) pass.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing browser test**

Create `packages/core/src/components/common/info-popover.browser.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { page, userEvent } from 'vitest/browser';
import { adoptTheme } from '../kit/adopt-theme';
import { ESCAPE_ORDER, onEscapeFallback } from '../kit/layers';
import '../kit/popover';
import type { PsPopover } from '../kit/popover';
import './info-popover';

type InfoPopoverElement = HTMLElement & {
  description: string;
  detail: string;
  docsUrl: string;
  label: string;
  align: 'left' | 'right';
  placement: 'bottom' | 'side';
  updateComplete: Promise<boolean>;
};

beforeAll(async () => {
  adoptTheme();
  await page.viewport(1280, 720);
});
const cleanups: Array<() => void> = [];
beforeEach(() => {
  document.body.innerHTML = `
    <div id="stage" style="padding: 40px"></div>
    <button id="outside" style="margin: 200px 0 0 600px">Outside</button>`;
});
afterEach(() => {
  while (cleanups.length) cleanups.pop()!();
  document.body.replaceChildren();
});

const frame = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
const pause = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const outside = () => document.getElementById('outside') as HTMLButtonElement;
const trigger = (el: InfoPopoverElement) =>
  el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.info-button') as HTMLButtonElement;
const bubbleHost = (el: InfoPopoverElement) => el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-popover') as PsPopover;
const bubble = (el: InfoPopoverElement) =>
  el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.popover') as HTMLElement | null;
const isOpen = (el: InfoPopoverElement) =>
  bubbleHost(el).shadowRoot!.querySelector('.panel')!.matches(':popover-open');

async function settle(el: InfoPopoverElement): Promise<void> {
  await el.updateComplete;
  await bubbleHost(el).updateComplete;
  await frame();
  await frame();
}

function escape(): void {
  (document.activeElement ?? document.body).dispatchEvent(
    new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, composed: true, cancelable: true }),
  );
}

async function mount(
  props: Partial<Pick<InfoPopoverElement, 'description' | 'detail' | 'docsUrl' | 'label' | 'align' | 'placement'>> = {},
  parent: HTMLElement = document.getElementById('stage')!,
): Promise<InfoPopoverElement> {
  const el = document.createElement('protspace-info-popover') as InfoPopoverElement;
  el.description = props.description ?? 'A brief summary.';
  if (props.detail !== undefined) el.detail = props.detail;
  if (props.docsUrl !== undefined) el.docsUrl = props.docsUrl;
  el.label = props.label ?? 'Test annotation';
  if (props.align) el.align = props.align;
  if (props.placement) el.placement = props.placement;
  parent.append(el);
  await el.updateComplete;
  return el;
}

/** The deepest element at a point, looking through every shadow root on the way. */
function deepestAt(x: number, y: number): Element | null {
  let hit: Element | null = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
  while (hit?.shadowRoot) {
    const inner = hit.shadowRoot.elementFromPoint(x, y);
    if (!inner || inner === hit) break;
    hit = inner;
  }
  return hit;
}

/** An open ps-popover whose panel is translated and clips its overflow, as the Import panel does. */
async function openOuterPanel(): Promise<{ outer: PsPopover; row: HTMLElement }> {
  document.getElementById('stage')!.innerHTML = `
    <button id="anchor">Open</button>
    <ps-popover id="outer">
      <div id="row" style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 220px; overflow: hidden">
        <span style="flex: 1">An example</span>
      </div>
    </ps-popover>`;
  const outer = document.getElementById('outer') as PsPopover;
  outer.anchor = document.getElementById('anchor');
  outer.open = true;
  await outer.updateComplete;
  await frame();
  await frame();
  return { outer, row: document.getElementById('row')! };
}

describe('protspace-info-popover on ps-popover', () => {
  it('hover opens it, and leaving closes it after a short grace', async () => {
    const el = await mount();
    await userEvent.hover(trigger(el));
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(true);
    expect(bubble(el)!.textContent).toContain('A brief summary.');

    await userEvent.hover(outside());
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(false));
    expect(bubble(el)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a click pins it until a second click, Escape or a press outside, and Escape reaches no fallback', async () => {
    const fallback = vi.fn(() => true);
    cleanups.push(onEscapeFallback(ESCAPE_ORDER.connectors, fallback));
    const el = await mount();

    await userEvent.click(trigger(el));
    await userEvent.hover(outside());
    await pause(300);
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el), 'a pinned bubble survives the pointer leaving').toBe(true);

    await userEvent.click(trigger(el));
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el), 'a second click unpins it').toBe(false);

    trigger(el).click();
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(true);
    escape();
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el), 'Escape closes it').toBe(false);
    expect(fallback).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    trigger(el).click();
    await settle(el);
    await userEvent.click(outside());
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el), 'a press outside closes it').toBe(false);
  });

  it('keyboard focus opens it and focus leaving closes it', async () => {
    const el = await mount();
    await userEvent.tab();
    expect(el.shadowRoot!.activeElement).toBe(trigger(el));
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(true);
    expect(trigger(el).getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');

    await userEvent.tab();
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(outside());
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(false);
    expect(trigger(el).getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
  });

  it('relates the expanded trigger to a named, described dialog', async () => {
    const el = await mount({ label: 'No annotation', detail: 'Look at the three-finger toxins.' });
    trigger(el).click();
    await settle(el);

    const host = bubbleHost(el);
    const panel = host.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.panel')!;
    expect(trigger(el).getAttribute('aria-controls')).toBe(host.id);
    expect(panel.getAttribute('role')).toBe('dialog');
    expect(panel.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('No annotation information');
    // The description targets are the paragraphs, never the dialog: describing the dialog would
    // announce its label instead of its text.
    const description = bubble(el)!.querySelector('.popover-description')!;
    const detail = bubble(el)!.querySelector('.popover-detail')!;
    expect(trigger(el).getAttribute('aria-describedby')).toBe(`${description.id} ${detail.id}`);
    expect(detail.textContent!.trim()).toBe('Look at the three-finger toxins.');
  });

  it('renders the docs link in a new tab', async () => {
    const el = await mount({ docsUrl: '/docs/guide/annotations#ec' });
    trigger(el).click();
    await settle(el);
    const link = bubble(el)!.querySelector('.popover-link') as HTMLAnchorElement;
    expect(link.getAttribute('href')).toBe('/docs/guide/annotations#ec');
    expect(link.target).toBe('_blank');
    expect(link.rel).toBe('noopener noreferrer');
    // A Lucide icon, not a text glyph (design 8), and the new tab said in words.
    expect(link.textContent!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()).toBe('Learn more (opens in a new tab)');
    expect(link.querySelector('svg')).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('side placement sits beside the row and stays open while the pointer crosses to it', async () => {
    const stage = document.getElementById('stage')!;
    stage.innerHTML = `<div id="row" style="display: flex; align-items: center; width: 240px">
      <span style="flex: 1">Pfam</span></div>`;
    const el = await mount({ placement: 'side' }, document.getElementById('row')!);

    await userEvent.hover(trigger(el));
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(true);
    const icon = trigger(el).getBoundingClientRect();
    const box = bubble(el)!.getBoundingClientRect();
    expect(box.left).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(icon.right);

    await userEvent.hover(bubble(el)!.querySelector('.popover-description')!);
    await pause(300);
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el), 'crossing to the bubble keeps it open').toBe(true);

    await userEvent.hover(outside());
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(false));
  });

  it('inside a translated, overflow-hidden ps-popover panel the bubble is fully on screen and topmost at its centre', async () => {
    const { row } = await openOuterPanel();
    const el = await mount({ placement: 'side', detail: 'A second paragraph.' }, row);
    trigger(el).click();
    await settle(el);

    const box = bubble(el)!.getBoundingClientRect();
    expect(box.width).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(box.left).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(box.top).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(box.right).toBeLessThanOrEqual(window.innerWidth);
    expect(box.bottom).toBeLessThanOrEqual(window.innerHeight);
    const hit = deepestAt(box.left + box.width / 2, box.top + box.height / 2);
    expect(hit !== null && bubble(el)!.contains(hit)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('Escape inside an open ps-popover closes the bubble first, then the panel', async () => {
    const { outer, row } = await openOuterPanel();
    const el = await mount({ placement: 'side' }, row);
    const outerClosed = vi.fn();
    outer.addEventListener('ps-close', outerClosed);
    trigger(el).click();
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(true);

    escape();
    await settle(el);
    expect(isOpen(el)).toBe(false);
    expect(outer.open).toBe(true);
    expect(outerClosed).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    escape();
    await outer.updateComplete;
    expect(outer.open).toBe(false);
    expect(outerClosed).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing } from 'lit';
import { property, query, state } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';
import '../kit/popover';
import type { Placement } from '../kit/position';
import { infoPopoverStyles } from './info-popover.styles';

let infoPopoverSequence = 0;

/** How long the bubble stays after the pointer leaves: enough to cross the gap to it. */
const CLOSE_GRACE_MS = 140;

/**
 * Small reusable "ⓘ" information control that opens a bubble with an annotation description, an
 * optional second paragraph and an optional "Learn more" link.
 *
 * Interaction model:
 * - Opens on **hover** (pointer over the icon) and on **keyboard focus**, so the brief summary is
 *   one hover away while scanning the annotation dropdown.
 * - The bubble is **hoverable**: it stays open while the pointer is over the icon *or* the bubble
 *   (a short grace period bridges the gap between them), so you can move into it to click
 *   "Learn more" without it disappearing.
 * - **Click** toggles a pinned state.
 *
 * The bubble is a `ps-popover` (design decisions 8 and 11): it renders in the top layer, so no
 * panel's `translate`, `overflow` or stacking context clips it, and it is a layer of the kit's
 * layer stack, so Escape and a press outside close it before anything beneath it.
 *
 * The button carries no `title`. A native tooltip would repeat the `aria-label` it was set from,
 * and the browser renders it on its own schedule and in its own place, on top of this bubble.
 *
 * Placement:
 * - `"bottom"` (default) drops the bubble below the icon, used by the legend header; `align="right"`
 *   aligns its right edge to the icon.
 * - `"side"` puts it beside the icon (right, flipping left near the viewport edge), used by the
 *   rows of a list. The whole row (this element's parent) keeps it open, so the pointer can cross
 *   the row towards the bubble.
 *
 * Renders nothing when there is neither a description, a detail nor a docs URL.
 */
@customElement('protspace-info-popover')
class ProtspaceInfoPopover extends LitElement {
  static styles = infoPopoverStyles;

  /** Short description text shown in the bubble. */
  @property({ type: String }) description = '';
  /**
   * Optional second paragraph, below the description: the Import menu puts an example's
   * one-line insight here.
   */
  @property({ type: String }) detail = '';
  /** Optional site-relative or absolute documentation URL. */
  @property({ type: String, attribute: 'docs-url' }) docsUrl = '';
  /** Human-readable annotation label, used for accessible button labelling. */
  @property({ type: String }) label = '';
  /** For `placement="bottom"`: `'left'` opens rightward from the icon, `'right'` leftward. */
  @property({ type: String }) align: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  /** `'bottom'` drops the bubble below the icon; `'side'` puts it beside the icon. */
  @property({ type: String }) placement: 'bottom' | 'side' = 'bottom';

  /** Pointer is over the icon or the bubble. */
  @state() private hovering = false;
  /** Click-pinned open (survives pointer leave; primary path on touch). */
  @state() private pinned = false;
  /** Opened via keyboard focus (not a pointer click). */
  @state() private kbFocused = false;

  @query('.info-button') private infoButton!: HTMLButtonElement | null;

  private readonly popoverId = `protspace-info-popover-${++infoPopoverSequence}`;

  /**
   * `aria-describedby` targets. They are the description and detail paragraphs, never the dialog
   * itself: the dialog carries an `aria-label`, and accname step 2C returns that label rather
   * than descending into the contents, which would silently empty the description.
   */
  private readonly descriptionId = `${this.popoverId}-description`;
  private readonly detailId = `${this.popoverId}-detail`;

  /** Whether the bubble is open (any of the three triggers). */
  private get isOpen(): boolean {
    return this.hovering || this.pinned || this.kbFocused;
  }

  private closeTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  /** True briefly around a pointerdown so the ensuing focus is not treated as keyboard focus. */
  private pointerInitiatedFocus = false;
  /** Parent row used as the keep-open region for side placement (see `firstUpdated`). */
  private _row: HTMLElement | null = null;

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.addEventListener('pointerenter', this._onPointerEnter);
    this.addEventListener('pointerleave', this._onPointerLeave);
    this.addEventListener('focusout', this._onFocusOut);
  }

  firstUpdated() {
    // In side placement the path from the icon to the bubble crosses the row. The whole row (this
    // element's parent) is the keep-open region: the bubble is a DOM descendant of it, so gliding
    // from the ⓘ into the bubble never leaves it.
    if (this.placement === 'side' && this.parentElement) {
      this._row = this.parentElement;
      this._row.addEventListener('pointerleave', this._onRowPointerLeave);
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    super.disconnectedCallback();
    this.removeEventListener('pointerenter', this._onPointerEnter);
    this.removeEventListener('pointerleave', this._onPointerLeave);
    this.removeEventListener('focusout', this._onFocusOut);
    this._row?.removeEventListener('pointerleave', this._onRowPointerLeave);
    this._row = null;
    this._clearCloseTimer();
  }

  private _onPointerEnter = () => {
    // Fires for the icon and, since the bubble is a descendant of the host, when the pointer
    // re-enters the bubble after crossing the gap.
    this._clearCloseTimer();
    this.hovering = true;
  };

  /** Start the close grace period: long enough to bridge the gap between the icon and the bubble. */
  private _scheduleClose() {
    this._clearCloseTimer();
    this.closeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.hovering = false;
      this.closeTimer = null;
    }, CLOSE_GRACE_MS);
  }

  private _onPointerLeave = () => {
    // For side placement leaving the row closes it (`_onRowPointerLeave`); leaving just the icon
    // must not, or crossing the row towards the bubble would dismiss it.
    if (this.placement === 'side') return;
    this._scheduleClose();
  };

  /** Side placement only: the pointer left the row (and the bubble), so begin closing. */
  private _onRowPointerLeave = () => {
    this._scheduleClose();
  };

  private _onFocusOut = (event: FocusEvent) => {
    const next = event.relatedTarget as Node | null;
    // Only drop keyboard-open state when focus leaves the whole component (icon + bubble link).
    if (!next || !this.contains(next)) {
      this.kbFocused = false;
    }
  };

  private _clearCloseTimer() {
    if (this.closeTimer !== null) {
      clearTimeout(this.closeTimer);
      this.closeTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private _closeAll() {
    this._clearCloseTimer();
    this.hovering = false;
    this.pinned = false;
    this.kbFocused = false;
  }

  /**
   * The layer closed the bubble (Escape or a press outside). The event stops here: a host that
   * listens for its own overlays' `ps-close` must not take this one for theirs.
   */
  private _onLayerClose = (event: Event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this._closeAll();
  };

  private _onPointerDown = () => {
    // A focus that immediately follows a pointerdown is a mouse/touch focus, not keyboard tabbing,
    // so don't open via `kbFocused` in that case (click handles the pinned state instead).
    this.pointerInitiatedFocus = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.pointerInitiatedFocus = false;
    }, 0);
  };

  private _onFocus = () => {
    if (!this.pointerInitiatedFocus) {
      this.kbFocused = true;
    }
  };

  private _onClick = (event: Event) => {
    // A row around the icon (an annotation or an example) must not act on this click.
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.preventDefault();
    this.pinned = !this.pinned;
    if (!this.pinned) {
      // Explicit dismiss: also drop hover so it hides even while the pointer is still over the icon.
      this.hovering = false;
      this._clearCloseTimer();
    }
  };

  private get bubblePlacement(): Placement {
    if (this.placement === 'side') return 'right-start';
    return this.align === 'right' ? 'bottom-end' : 'bottom-start';
  }

  render() {
    const hasContent =
      this.description.length > 0 || this.detail.length > 0 || this.docsUrl.length > 0;
    if (!hasContent) return nothing;
    const describedBy = [
      ...(this.description ? [this.descriptionId] : []),
      ...(this.detail ? [this.detailId] : []),
    ].join(' ');
    const ariaLabel = this.label ? `Information about ${this.label}` : 'Annotation information';
    const dialogLabel = this.label ? `${this.label} information` : 'Annotation information';
    const open = this.isOpen;

    return html`
      <button
        type="button"
        class="info-button ${open ? 'open' : ''}"
        aria-label=${ariaLabel}
        aria-expanded=${open}
        aria-controls=${open ? this.popoverId : nothing}
        aria-describedby=${open && describedBy ? describedBy : nothing}
        @pointerdown=${this._onPointerDown}
        @focus=${this._onFocus}
        @click=${this._onClick}
      >
        ${icon('info', 14)}
      </button>
      <ps-popover
        id=${this.popoverId}
        .anchor=${this.infoButton}
        .open=${open}
        placement=${this.bubblePlacement}
        panel-role="dialog"
        panel-label=${dialogLabel}
        @ps-close=${this._onLayerClose}
      >
        ${open
          ? html`<div class="popover">
              ${this.description
                ? html`<p id=${this.descriptionId} class="popover-description">
                    ${this.description}
                  </p>`
                : nothing}
              ${this.detail
                ? html`<p id=${this.detailId} class="popover-detail">${this.detail}</p>`
                : nothing}
              ${this.docsUrl
                ? html`<a
                    class="popover-link"
                    href=${this.docsUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    @click=${(e: Event) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    >Learn more${icon('external-link', 14)}<span class="popover-link-hint"
                      > (opens in a new tab)</span
                    ></a
                  >`
                : nothing}
            </div>`
          : nothing}
      </ps-popover>
    `;
  }
}

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    'protspace-info-popover': ProtspaceInfoPopover;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The ⓘ trigger and the bubble's contents. The bubble's surface, border, radius and shadow are
 * ps-popover's panel; this sheet styles only what is slotted into it.
 */
export const infoPopoverStyles = [
  focusRing,
  css`
    :host {
      display: inline-flex;
    }

    .info-button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      padding: 0;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-full);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .info-button:hover,
    .info-button.open {
      color: var(--ps-text);
      background: var(--ps-surface-hover);
    }

    .popover {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      width: max-content;
      max-width: min(260px, calc(100vw - 24px));
      padding: var(--ps-space-2) var(--ps-space-3);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      /* Font weight inherits across the shadow boundary: a bold ancestor (a selected dropdown row)
         would otherwise render the bubble bold. */
      font-weight: normal;
      line-height: var(--ps-leading-normal);
      text-align: left;
      white-space: normal;
    }

    .popover-description,
    .popover-detail {
      margin: 0;

      margin-top: var(--ps-space-1-5);
    }

    .popover-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-0-5);
      margin-top: var(--ps-space-1-5);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-sm);
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-medium);
      text-decoration: none;
    }

      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);

];
```

```ts
/**
 * @vitest-environment jsdom
 */
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import './info-popover';

// jsdom has no showPopover, so every case that opens the bubble lives in
// info-popover.browser.test.ts. These cover the closed trigger.

type PopoverEl = HTMLElement & {
  description: string;
  detail: string;
  docsUrl: string;
  label: string;
  updateComplete: Promise<unknown>;
};

async function setup(props: Partial<PopoverEl> = {}): Promise<PopoverEl> {
  const el = document.createElement('protspace-info-popover') as PopoverEl;
  el.description = props.description ?? 'A brief summary.';
  if (props.detail !== undefined) el.detail = props.detail;
  if (props.docsUrl !== undefined) el.docsUrl = props.docsUrl;
  el.label = props.label ?? 'Test annotation';
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  await el.updateComplete;
  return el;
}

const button = (el: PopoverEl) =>
  el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.info-button') as HTMLButtonElement | null;

describe('protspace-info-popover (closed)', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
  });

  it('renders nothing without a description or docs URL', async () => {
    const el = await setup({ description: '', docsUrl: '' });
    expect(button(el)).toBeNull();
    expect(el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-popover')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('has no native title tooltip to collide with its own popover', async () => {
    // A `title` repeating the aria-label rendered a second, browser-styled tooltip on top of
    // the bubble that already explains the icon.
    const el = await setup({ label: 'kNN Overlap' });
    expect(button(el)!.hasAttribute('title')).toBe(false);
    expect(button(el)!.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Information about kNN Overlap');
  });

  it('a closed trigger is collapsed and points at nothing', async () => {
    const el = await setup({ detail: 'A second paragraph.' });
    expect(button(el)!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
    expect(button(el)!.hasAttribute('aria-controls')).toBe(false);
    expect(button(el)!.hasAttribute('aria-describedby')).toBe(false);
    // The bubble's contents render only while it is open.
    expect(el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.popover')).toBeNull();
    const host = el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-popover')!;
    expect(host.getAttribute('panel-role')).toBe('dialog');
    expect(host.getAttribute('panel-label')).toBe('Test annotation information');
  });

  it('renders a trigger for a detail-only popover', async () => {
    const el = await setup({ description: '', detail: 'Only a detail.' });
    expect(button(el)).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { adoptTheme } from '../kit/adopt-theme';
import type { PsPopover } from '../kit/popover';

import type { ExampleDatasetSummary } from './types';

const EXAMPLE_DATASETS: ExampleDatasetSummary[] = [
  {
    id: 'demo',
    label: 'Demo',
    description: 'The startup demo dataset.',
    insight: 'Toxin families form their own clusters.',
    docsUrl: '/docs/explore/example-datasets#demo',
  },
  { id: '5K', label: 'Swiss-Prot 5K', description: 'A small Swiss-Prot subset.' },
  {
    id: 'swissprot',
    label: 'Swiss-Prot',
    description: 'All of Swiss-Prot. Large: a 45 MB download.',
    docsUrl: '/docs/explore/example-datasets#swissprot',
    large: true,
  },
];

type InfoPopoverElement = HTMLElement & { updateComplete: Promise<boolean> };

let menu: ProtspaceImportMenu;

  adoptTheme();
  await page.viewport(1280, 720);
});
beforeEach(async () => {

    <button id="dataset" style="margin: 8px 0 0 40px">Demo · 7,831 proteins</button>
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 8px 24px">
      <protspace-import-menu></protspace-import-menu>
    </div>
    <button id="outside" style="margin: 400px 0 0 40px">Outside</button>`;
  menu = document.querySelector('protspace-import-menu')!;
  menu.exampleDatasets = EXAMPLE_DATASETS;
  menu.examplesDocsUrl = '/docs/explore/example-datasets';
  await menu.updateComplete;
});
afterEach(() => {
  // Removing an open menu releases its layer, so the next test starts with none.
  document.body.replaceChildren();
});

const frame = () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
const root = () => menu.shadowRoot!;
const trigger = () => root().querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.trigger')!;
const popover = () => root().querySelector('ps-popover') as PsPopover;
const panel = () => popover().shadowRoot!.querySelector('.panel') as HTMLElement;
const isOpen = () => panel().matches(':popover-open');
const ownFile = () => root().querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-driver-id="import-own-dataset"]');
const example = (id: string) =>
  root().querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-example-id="${id}"]`)!;
const exampleInfo = (id: string) =>
  root().querySelector(`.import-examples [data-example-info="${id}"]`) as InfoPopoverElement | null;
const datasetButton = () => document.getElementById('dataset') as HTMLButtonElement;
const outside = () => document.getElementById('outside') as HTMLButtonElement;

async function settle(): Promise<void> {
  await menu.updateComplete;
  await popover().updateComplete;
  await frame();
  await frame();
}

async function open(): Promise<void> {
  if (!isOpen()) trigger().click();
  await settle();
}

function escape(): void {
  (document.activeElement ?? document.body).dispatchEvent(
    new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, composed: true, cancelable: true }),
  );
}

function press(target: Element): void {
  target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, composed: true }));
  target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { bubbles: true, composed: true }));
}

/** The deepest element at a point, looking through every shadow root on the way. */
function deepestAt(x: number, y: number): Element | null {
  let hit: Element | null = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
  while (hit?.shadowRoot) {
    const inner = hit.shadowRoot.elementFromPoint(x, y);
    if (!inner || inner === hit) break;
    hit = inner;
  }
  return hit;
}

async function openInfo(id: string): Promise<{ info: InfoPopoverElement; bubble: HTMLElement }> {
  const info = exampleInfo(id)!;
  (info.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.info-button') as HTMLButtonElement).click();
  await info.updateComplete;
  await (info.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-popover') as PsPopover).updateComplete;
  await frame();
  await frame();
  return { info, bubble: info.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.popover') as HTMLElement };
}
```

Replace the whole of `packages/core/src/components/import-menu/import-menu.ts` with:

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing } from 'lit';
import { property, query, state } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import '../common/info-popover';
import '../kit/button';
import { deepActiveElement, flatContains } from '../kit/focus';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';
import '../kit/popover';
import type { PsPopover } from '../kit/popover';
import type { Placement } from '../kit/position';
import { importMenuStyles } from './import-menu.styles';
import type { ExampleDatasetSummary } from './types';

/** Where each kind of file goes (design decision 15): said before anything is uploaded. */
const FORMAT_NOTE =
  '.parquetbundle files are read in your browser. FASTA files (.fasta, .fa, .fna) are sent to the server for embedding.';

/**
 * The Import panel: "Open a file…", the last imported file and the host's example catalog
 * (design decisions 1 and 15). Its own Import button opens it, and so does any control the host
 * passes to `openFrom`/`toggleFrom` (the app bar's dataset name, the empty plot's "Pick an
 * example"). The panel is a `ps-popover` with role dialog, a layer of the kit's layer stack:
 * Escape and a press outside close it, and focus returns to the control that opened it. It only
 * asks: `open-file-dialog`, `open-last-file` and `load-example-dataset` are the host's to act on.
 */
@customElement('protspace-import-menu')
export class ProtspaceImportMenu extends LitElement {
  static styles = importMenuStyles;

  /** The host's example catalog, listed under "Examples". */
  @property({ attribute: false }) exampleDatasets: readonly ExampleDatasetSummary[] = [];
  /** The host's page about its examples, linked from the "Examples" heading; no link when empty. */
  @property({ attribute: 'examples-docs-url' }) examplesDocsUrl = '';
  /** The example on screen, or null for a user import; its item is disabled with a check. */
  @property({ attribute: 'current-example-id' }) currentExampleId: string | null = null;
  /** The stored import the panel offers to reopen, or null for none (or while it is on screen). */
  @property({ attribute: false }) lastFile: { name: string; sizeLabel: string } | null = null;

  @state() private open = false;
  /** The control the panel opened from; null until the first opening (the trigger by default). */
  @state() private anchorEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
  @query('.trigger') private trigger!: HTMLButtonElement;
  @query('ps-popover') private popover!: PsPopover;

  connectedCallback(): void {
    super.connectedCallback();
    this.addEventListener('focusout', this.onFocusOut);
  }

  disconnectedCallback(): void {
    super.disconnectedCallback();
    this.removeEventListener('focusout', this.onFocusOut);
    this.open = false;
    // The popover releases its layer on disconnect; the anchor must not stay "expanded".
    this.anchorEl?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  }

  /** Opens the panel under `anchor`, which then reads as this panel's disclosure button. */
  openFrom(anchor: HTMLElement): void {
    if (this.open) {
      if (this.anchorEl === anchor) return;
      // Close first, so the popover returns focus to the old anchor and takes the new one's.
      this.close();
      void this.updateComplete
        .then(() => this.popover.updateComplete)
        .then(() => this.openFrom(anchor));
      return;
    }
    this.anchorEl = anchor;
    this.open = true;
    void this.focusFirstAction();
  }

  /** Closes the panel when it is open from `anchor`, otherwise opens it there. */
  toggleFrom(anchor: HTMLElement): void {
    if (this.open && this.anchorEl === anchor) this.close();
    else this.openFrom(anchor);
  }

  // A plain Map: `anchorEl` is private, so it is not a key PropertyValues<this> accepts.
  protected updated(changed: Map<PropertyKey, unknown>): void {
    if (!changed.has('open') && !changed.has('anchorEl')) return;
    const previous = changed.get('anchorEl') as HTMLElement | null | undefined;
    if (previous && previous !== this.anchorEl) previous.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    const anchor = this.anchorEl ?? this.trigger;
    anchor.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'dialog');
    anchor.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(this.open));
  }

  render() {
    const anchor = this.anchorEl ?? this.trigger ?? null;
    // Under its own trigger, at the app bar's right, the panel opens leftward.
    const placement: Placement = anchor === this.trigger ? 'bottom-end' : 'bottom-start';
    return html`<button
        class="trigger"
        type="button"
        aria-label="Import"
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded="false"
        @click=${this.onTriggerClick}
      >
        ${icon('upload', 16)}<span part="trigger-label">Import</span>
      </button>
      <ps-popover
        .anchor=${anchor}
        .open=${this.open}
        placement=${placement}
        panel-role="dialog"
        panel-label="Import"
        @ps-close=${this.onPopoverClose}
      >
        ${this.open ? this.renderPanel() : nothing}
      </ps-popover>`;
  }

  private renderPanel() {
    return html`<div class="import-menu" @keydown=${this.onPanelKeydown}>
      <section class="import-section">
        <ps-button
          class="import-open-file"
          variant="primary"
          data-driver-id="import-own-dataset"
          data-import-action
          @click=${this.openFileDialog}
          ><span slot="start">${icon('upload', 16)}</span>Open a file…</ps-button
        >
        <p class="import-note">${FORMAT_NOTE}</p>
      </section>
      ${this.lastFile ? this.renderLastFile(this.lastFile) : nothing}
      ${this.exampleDatasets.length > 0 ? this.renderExamples() : nothing}
    </div>`;
  }

  private renderLastFile(file: { name: string; sizeLabel: string }) {
    return html`<section class="import-section import-last-file">
      <h3 class="import-section-label">Last file</h3>
      <button
        type="button"
        class="import-row"
        data-import-action
        aria-label=${`Reopen ${file.name}`}
        @click=${this.openLastFile}
      >
        <span class="import-row-label">${file.name}</span>
        <span class="import-row-meta">${file.sizeLabel}</span>
      </button>
    </section>`;
  }

  private renderExamples() {
    return html`<section class="import-section import-examples">
      <div class="import-examples-header">
        <h3 class="import-section-label import-examples-label">Examples</h3>
        ${this.examplesDocsUrl
          ? html`<a
              class="import-examples-docs"
              href=${this.examplesDocsUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              >About these examples${icon('external-link', 14)}<span class="import-examples-docs-hint"
                > (opens in a new tab)</span
              ></a
            >`
          : nothing}
      </div>
      <p class="import-examples-hint">Examples open in a curated view; your changes aren't kept.</p>
      <div class="import-example-list">
        ${this.exampleDatasets.map((example) => {
          const current = example.id === this.currentExampleId;
          return html`<div class="import-example-row">
            <button
              type="button"
              class="import-row import-example-button"
              data-driver-id="import-example-dataset"
              data-example-id=${example.id}
              data-import-action
              ?disabled=${current}
              aria-current=${current ? 'true' : nothing}
              @click=${() => this.loadExample(example.id)}
            >
              <span class="import-row-check">${current ? icon('check', 14) : nothing}</span>
              <span class="import-example-label">${example.label}</span>
              ${example.large ? html`<span class="import-example-badge">Large</span>` : nothing}
            </button>
            ${this.renderExampleInfo(example)}
          </div>`;
        })}
      </div>
    </section>`;
  }

  /**
   * An example's "ⓘ": its description, insight and docs link. A sibling of the item's button,
   * never inside it: interactive content inside a `<button>` is invalid, and a click on it would
   * load the example. The current example keeps its ⓘ (the app bar's name has none).
   */
  private renderExampleInfo(example: ExampleDatasetSummary) {
    return html`<protspace-info-popover
      class="import-example-info"
      placement="side"
      data-example-info=${example.id}
      .description=${example.description}
      .detail=${example.insight ?? ''}
      docs-url=${example.docsUrl ?? ''}
      label=${example.label}
    ></protspace-info-popover>`;
  }

  /** The panel's actions in order, without the disabled current example. */
  private actions(): HTMLElement[] {
    return [...this.renderRoot.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-import-action]')].filter(
      (action) => !(action as HTMLButtonElement).disabled,
    );
  }

  private async focusFirstAction(): Promise<void> {
    await this.updateComplete;
    await this.popover.updateComplete;
    // Keyboard users land on the panel's first action, as in the other menus.
    if (this.open) this.actions()[0]?.focus();
  }

  private onPanelKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (event.key !== 'ArrowDown' && event.key !== 'ArrowUp') return;
    const actions = this.actions();
    if (actions.length === 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const current = actions.indexOf((this.renderRoot as ShadowRoot).activeElement as HTMLElement);
    const last = actions.length - 1;
    const next =
      event.key === 'ArrowDown'
        ? current < 0 || current === last
          ? 0
          : current + 1
        : current <= 0
          ? last
          : current - 1;
    actions[next].focus();
  };

  /**
   * Tab out of the panel closes it. Focus moving inside the shadow root reaches this host listener
   * retargeted to the host itself; a null target (a press on the panel's background, or the
   * window losing focus) leaves it open.
   */
  private onFocusOut = (event: FocusEvent) => {
    const next = event.relatedTarget as Node | null;
    if (this.open && next && !flatContains(this, next)) this.close();
  };

  private onTriggerClick = () => {
    this.toggleFrom(this.trigger);
  };

  /** The popover closed itself (Escape or a press outside) and has already returned focus. */
  private onPopoverClose = (event: Event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.open = false;
  };

  /**
   * Closes the panel; focus that was inside it goes back to the anchor. Moved here, not left to
   * the popover: the render that closes the panel also removes its contents, so by the popover's
   * own `hide()` the focused item is gone and focus has fallen to `<body>`. `open` is cleared
   * first, so the focusout this focus move causes finds the panel already closed.
   */
  private close(): void {
    if (!this.open) return;
    const focusWasInside = flatContains(this, deepActiveElement());
    this.open = false;
    if (focusWasInside) (this.anchorEl ?? this.trigger).focus();
  }

  private openFileDialog = () => {
    this.close();
    // Still inside the click, so the host's file picker keeps the user's activation.
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('open-file-dialog', { detail: {}, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
    );
  };

  private openLastFile = () => {
    this.close();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('open-last-file', { detail: {}, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
    );
  };

  private loadExample(id: string): void {
    this.close();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('load-example-dataset', { detail: { id }, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
    );
  }
}

  }
}
```

```ts
  });

  it('dispose stops the refreshes', async () => {
    const { binding, emitChange, readSummary } = bind();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(readSummary).toHaveBeenCalledOnce());
    binding.dispose();
    emitChange('demo', 'menu');
    await Promise.resolve();
    expect(readSummary).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The stored import's name, size and save time, for the Import menu's "Last file" row. Reads the
 * metadata only, never the bytes: it runs on every dataset change. Null when nothing is stored,
 * OPFS is missing, or the metadata is corrupt (which `readMetadata` also clears).
 */
export async function readStoredImportSummary(): Promise<{
  name: string;
  size: number;
  storedAt: string;
} | null> {
  try {
    const metadata = await readMetadata();
    return metadata
      ? { name: metadata.name, size: metadata.size, storedAt: metadata.storedAt }
      : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

Replace the whole of `apps/web/src/explore/import-controller.ts` with:

```ts
import type { DataLoader as ProtspaceDataLoader, ProtspaceImportMenu } from '@protspace/core';
import type { DatasetController } from './dataset-controller';
import { findExampleDataset, formatMegabytes } from './example-datasets';
import type { DatasetChangeSource } from './types';

const STORED_FILE_UNREADABLE = 'The stored file could not be read';

interface StoredImportSummary {
  name: string;
  size: number;
  storedAt: string;
}

interface ImportMenuOptions {
  /** Adds a listener on the Import menu for as long as the runtime lives. */
  listen(type: string, listener: EventListener): void;
  importMenu: Pick<ProtspaceImportMenu, 'lastFile'>;
  dataLoader: Pick<ProtspaceDataLoader, 'openFilePicker'>;
  datasetController: Pick<DatasetController, 'loadChosenExample' | 'tryLoadPersistedAgain'>;
  /** The stored import's metadata (`readStoredImportSummary`), never its bytes. */
  readSummary(): Promise<StoredImportSummary | null>;
  /** The stored import itself (`loadLastImportedFile`). */
  loadLastFile(): Promise<File | null>;
  subscribeToDatasetChanges(
    callback: (exampleId: string | null, source: DatasetChangeSource) => void,
  ): () => void;
  /** The example on screen, or null for a file. */
  getCurrentExampleId(): string | null;
  /** The name the app bar shows for the dataset on screen. */
  getShownName(): string;
  /** Shows a warning notification titled `title`. */
  warn(title: string): void;
}

/**
 * The Import menu's choices: an example loads as a menu choice (the stored import stays), "Open a
 * file…" opens the data loader's file picker, and "Last file" reopens the stored import. The
 * menu's `lastFile` follows every dataset change and is null while that file is on screen.
 */
export function bindImportMenu({
  listen,
  importMenu,
  dataLoader,
  datasetController,
  readSummary,
  loadLastFile,
  subscribeToDatasetChanges,
  getCurrentExampleId,
  getShownName,
  warn,
}: ImportMenuOptions): { refreshLastFile(): Promise<void>; dispose(): void } {
  // A slower, older read must not overwrite a newer one.
  let refreshes = 0;
  const refreshLastFile = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const ticket = ++refreshes;
    let summary: StoredImportSummary | null;
    try {
      summary = await readSummary();
    } catch {
      summary = null;
    }
    if (ticket !== refreshes) return;
    const onScreen =
      summary !== null && getCurrentExampleId() === null && summary.name === getShownName();
    importMenu.lastFile =
      summary && !onScreen ? { name: summary.name, sizeLabel: formatMegabytes(summary.size) } : null;
  };

  const reopenLastFile = async (): Promise<void> => {
    let file: File | null;
    try {
      file = await loadLastFile();
    } catch {
      file = null;
    }
    if (!file) {
      warn(STORED_FILE_UNREADABLE);
      await refreshLastFile();
      return;
    }
    // Through the recovery path: an OPFS load, which keeps the user's stored legend settings.
    await datasetController.tryLoadPersistedAgain(file);
  };

  // This event name is part of the import menu's contract in @protspace/core.
  listen('load-example-dataset', (event) => {
    // A dispatch without a detail names no example: warn rather than throw.
    const id = (event as CustomEvent<{ id?: string } | null>).detail?.id;
    const entry = id === undefined ? undefined : findExampleDataset(id);
    if (!entry) {
      console.warn(`Unknown example dataset id: ${id}`);
      return;
    }
    void datasetController.loadChosenExample(entry, 'menu');
  });
  // Runs inside the menu's click, so the browser lets the picker open.
  listen('open-file-dialog', () => dataLoader.openFilePicker());
  listen('open-last-file', () => {
    void reopenLastFile();
  });
  // The stored import can change after the dataset change that announced it (the save step runs
  // after the render, so a second import is announced while the first is still stored): read it
  // again whenever the panel opens. `ps-open` from the inner `ps-popover` bubbles and is composed.
  listen('ps-open', () => {
    void refreshLastFile();
  });

  const unsubscribe = subscribeToDatasetChanges(() => {
    void refreshLastFile();
  });
  void refreshLastFile();

  return { refreshLastFile, dispose: unsubscribe };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Opens the Import panel unless it is open, and resolves once it shows. A custom import set
 * through the data loader's input leaves the panel open (nothing closes it), so the trigger is
 * clicked only while the panel is closed: re-clicking toggles it.

export async function openImportMenu(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await waitForExploreInteractionReady(page);
  const panel = importPanel(page);
  if (!(await panel.isVisible().catch(() => false))) {
    await importTrigger(page).click();
  }
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible();
}
```

````md
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `exampleDatasets`  | `readonly ExampleDatasetSummary[]`            | Example catalog, listed in the "Examples" section; JavaScript-only                   |
| `examplesDocsUrl`  | `string`                                      | Page linked as "About these examples"; `examples-docs-url`                         |
| `currentExampleId` | `string \| null`                              | Example on screen, `null` for a user import; its item is disabled with a check; `current-example-id` |
| `lastFile`         | `{ name: string; sizeLabel: string } \| null` | The stored import, offered as "Last file"; `null` hides the row; JavaScript-only      |

::: warning BREAKING
`currentDatasetName` (`current-dataset-name`) and the panel's "Current dataset" block are removed.
Name the dataset in your own control and open this panel from it with `toggleFrom`, as the app
bar's dataset name does.
:::

`ExampleDatasetSummary` is exported from `@protspace/core`:

| Field         | Type      | Shown as                                                    |
| ------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`          | `string`  | The `load-example-dataset` event's `detail.id`              |
| `label`       | `string`  | The item's text                                             |
| `description` | `string`  | The first paragraph of the item's info popover              |
| `insight?`    | `string`  | The popover's second paragraph: what the curated view shows |
| `docsUrl?`    | `string`  | The popover's "Learn more" link                           |
| `large?`      | `boolean` | A "Large" badge on the item                                 |

Methods: `openFrom(anchor: HTMLElement)` opens the panel under `anchor` and sets
`aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded` on it; focus returns to it when the panel closes.
`toggleFrom(anchor)` closes the panel when it is open from that anchor and opens it there
otherwise.

| Event                  | Detail           | Description                   |
| ---------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `load-example-dataset` | `{ id: string }` | An example dataset was chosen |
| `open-file-dialog`     | `{}`             | "Open a file…" was chosen     |
| `open-last-file`       | `{}`             | "Last file" was chosen        |

Each fires inside the user's click, after the panel has closed: call the data loader's
`openFilePicker()` from the `open-file-dialog` listener and the browser lets the file chooser open.
````

```ts
/**
 * Helper to call exportProteinIds via the real exporter and capture the downloaded IDs: the
 * export writes a Blob through an object URL, so the Blob is read back here.
 */
async function callExportProteinIds(
  data: ExportableData,
  annotation: string,
  hiddenAnnotationValues: string[] = [],
): Promise<string[]> {
  const el = createMockElement({
    getCurrentData: () => data,
    selectedAnnotation: annotation,
    hiddenAnnotationValues,
  });
  const exporter = createExporter(el);

  const captured: { blob?: Blob } = {};
  vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL').mockImplementation((blob) => {
    captured.blob = blob as Blob;
    return 'blob:protein-ids';
  });
  vi.spyOn(URL, 'revokeObjectURL').mockImplementation(() => {});
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  vi.spyOn(exporter as any, 'downloadFile').mockImplementation(() => {});

  exporter.exportProteinIds();

  if (!captured.blob) return [];
  const text = await captured.blob.text();
  return text ? text.split('\n') : [];
}
```

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing } from 'lit';
import { property, query, state } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import '../kit/button';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';
import '../kit/menu';
import type { PsMenu } from '../kit/menu';
import '../kit/tooltip';
import { EXPORT_DEFAULTS } from './export-defaults';
import { exportMenuStyles } from './export-menu.styles';

/** What an `export` event asks the host to produce. */
export interface ExportEventDetail {
  type: 'png' | 'pdf' | 'ids' | 'parquet';
  imageWidth: number;
  imageHeight: number;
  legendWidthPercent: number;
  legendFontSizePx: number;
  includeLegend: boolean;
  includeLegendSettings: boolean;
}

/** The exports that run at once, with fixed sizes, in menu order. */
const QUICK_EXPORTS: ReadonlyArray<{ value: ExportEventDetail['type']; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'png', label: 'Quick PNG' },
  { value: 'pdf', label: 'Quick PDF' },
  { value: 'ids', label: 'Protein IDs (.txt)' },
  { value: 'parquet', label: 'Data bundle (.parquetbundle)' },
];

const FIGURE_EDITOR = 'figure';
const INCLUDE_SETTINGS = 'include-settings';

/**
 * The Export menu (design decisions 1 and 15): the figure editor, the four quick exports and
 * whether a data bundle carries the legend settings, as one ps-menu. It only asks: `export` and
 * `open-publish-editor` are the host's to act on, and the host confirms every export.
 */
@customElement('protspace-export-menu')
export class ProtspaceExportMenu extends LitElement {
  static styles = exportMenuStyles;

  /** The loaded file carries saved settings, which a data bundle export can carry on. */
  @property({ type: Boolean, attribute: 'has-file-settings' }) hasFileSettings = false;

  @state() private open = false;
  @state() private includeLegendSettings = true;
  @query('.trigger') private trigger!: HTMLElement;
  @query('ps-menu') private menu!: PsMenu;

  /** Checks "Include legend settings" again, as for a new dataset. */
  reset(): void {
    this.includeLegendSettings = true;
  }

  protected firstUpdated(): void {
    // Set once the trigger exists, so the menu marks it as its menu button before any opening.
    this.menu.anchor = this.trigger;
  }

  render() {
    return html`<ps-button class="trigger" variant="secondary" @click=${this.toggle}>
        <span slot="start" class="trigger-icon">${icon('download', 16)}</span>
        <span part="trigger-label">Export</span>
        <span slot="end" class="trigger-icon">${icon('chevron-down', 14)}</span>
      </ps-button>
      ${this.hasFileSettings
        ? html`<ps-tooltip text="File contains custom settings"></ps-tooltip>`
        : nothing}
      <ps-menu
        label="Export"
        placement="bottom-end"
        .open=${this.open}
        @ps-close=${this.onClose}
        @ps-select=${this.onSelect}
      >
        <ps-menu-item value=${FIGURE_EDITOR}>Figure editor…</ps-menu-item>
        ${QUICK_EXPORTS.map(
          ({ value, label }) => html`<ps-menu-item value=${value}>${label}</ps-menu-item>`,
        )}
        <ps-menu-item
          type="checkbox"
          value=${INCLUDE_SETTINGS}
          .checked=${this.includeLegendSettings}
          >Include legend settings</ps-menu-item
        >
        <ps-menu-label class="export-note">Quick exports leave out contours.</ps-menu-label>
      </ps-menu>`;
  }

  private toggle = () => {
    this.open = !this.open;
  };

  /** The menu closed itself (Escape, a press outside, Tab, or a chosen item) and refocused. */
  private onClose = (event: Event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.open = false;
  };

  private onSelect = (event: Event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const { value, checked } = (event as CustomEvent<{ value: string; checked: boolean }>).detail;
    if (value === INCLUDE_SETTINGS) {
      // A checkbox item keeps the menu open.
      this.includeLegendSettings = checked;
      return;
    }
    if (value === FIGURE_EDITOR) {
      this.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('open-publish-editor', { detail: {}, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
      );
      return;
    }
    const quick = QUICK_EXPORTS.find((entry) => entry.value === value);
    if (!quick) return;
    const detail: ExportEventDetail = {
      type: quick.value,
      imageWidth: EXPORT_DEFAULTS.IMAGE_WIDTH,
      imageHeight: EXPORT_DEFAULTS.IMAGE_HEIGHT,
      legendWidthPercent: EXPORT_DEFAULTS.LEGEND_WIDTH_PERCENT,
      legendFontSizePx: EXPORT_DEFAULTS.LEGEND_FONT_SIZE_PX,
      includeLegend: EXPORT_DEFAULTS.INCLUDE_LEGEND,
      includeLegendSettings: this.includeLegendSettings,
    };
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent<ExportEventDetail>('export', { detail, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
    );
  };
}

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    'protspace-export-menu': ProtspaceExportMenu;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { PUBLISH_STATE_KEY, loadPublishState, savePublishState } from './publish-state-store';

function memoryStorage(): Storage {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  return {
    getItem: (key) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key, value) => void values.set(key, String(value)),
    removeItem: (key) => void values.delete(key),
    clear: () => values.clear(),
    key: (index) => [...values.keys()][index] ?? null,
    get length() {
      return values.size;
    },
  };
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe('publish state store', () => {
  it('round-trips a state under protspace_publishState', () => {
    const storage = memoryStorage();
    vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', storage);
    savePublishState({ preset: 'nature', widthPx: 1051, overlays: [] });

    expect(PUBLISH_STATE_KEY).toBe('protspace_publishState');
    expect(JSON.parse(storage.getItem('protspace_publishState')!)).toEqual({
      preset: 'nature',
      widthPx: 1051,
      overlays: [],
    });
    expect(loadPublishState()).toEqual({ preset: 'nature', widthPx: 1051, overlays: [] });
  });

  it('returns null when nothing is stored', () => {
    vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', memoryStorage());
    expect(loadPublishState()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null for corrupt JSON', () => {
    const storage = memoryStorage();
    storage.setItem(PUBLISH_STATE_KEY, '{not-json');
    vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', storage);
    expect(loadPublishState()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null for an array or a non-object', () => {
    const storage = memoryStorage();
    vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', storage);
    storage.setItem(PUBLISH_STATE_KEY, '[1,2]');
    expect(loadPublishState()).toBeNull();
    storage.setItem(PUBLISH_STATE_KEY, '42');
    expect(loadPublishState()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('swallows a throwing storage', () => {
    vi.stubGlobal('localStorage', {
      getItem: () => {
        throw new Error('denied');
      },
      setItem: () => {
        throw new Error('quota');
      },
    });
    expect(loadPublishState()).toBeNull();
    expect(() => savePublishState({ preset: 'nature' })).not.toThrow();
  });
});
```

Create `apps/web/src/explore/publish-state-store.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The figure editor's last state, kept in localStorage so the editor reopens where it was left
 * and a data bundle exported with its legend settings carries it. The JSON is not validated
 * here: the editor sanitises whatever it is given (`savedPublishState`).
 */
export const PUBLISH_STATE_KEY = 'protspace_publishState';

export function loadPublishState(): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PUBLISH_STATE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    /* corrupt or unavailable */
  }
  return null;
}

export function savePublishState(state: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PUBLISH_STATE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch {
    /* localStorage full or unavailable */
  }
}
```

Replace the whole of `apps/web/src/explore/export-handler.ts` with:

```ts
import type {
  ExportEventDetail,
  ProtspaceExportMenu,
  ProtspaceLegend,
  ProtspaceScatterplot,
} from '@protspace/core';
import { EXPORT_DEFAULTS, pxToMm } from '@protspace/core';
import type { BundleSettings } from '@protspace/utils';
import {
  createExporter,
  exportCanvasAsPdf,
  exportParquetBundle,
  generateBundleFilename,
  pngWithDpi,
} from '@protspace/utils';
import type { notify as appNotify } from '../lib/notify';
import { getExportFailureNotification, getExportSuccessNotification } from './notifications';
import { loadPublishState, savePublishState } from './publish-state-store';

/** The menu sends every field; other dispatchers may send only the type, so the rest default. */
type ExportRequest = Pick<ExportEventDetail, 'type'> & Partial<Omit<ExportEventDetail, 'type'>>;

interface ExportHandlerOptions {
  /** The Export menu. Its events arrive through `listen`; the figure editor's host code reads it. */
  exportMenu: ProtspaceExportMenu;
  /** Adds a listener on the Export menu for as long as the runtime lives. */
  listen(type: string, listener: EventListener): void;
  getSelectedProteins(): string[];
  /** Proteins the loaded file holds that the dataset, and so a bundle export, leaves out. */
  getUnplacedProteinCount(): number;
  legendElement: ProtspaceLegend;
  plotElement: ProtspaceScatterplot;
  notify: Pick<typeof appNotify, 'success' | 'error'>;
}

function generateFilename(ext: string): string {
  const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  return `protspace_figure_${date}.${ext}`;
}

function downloadFile(url: string, filename: string): void {
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.click();
}

/**
 * The Export menu's two requests: the figure editor (lazy-loaded) and the quick exports. Every
 * export confirms with a toast naming its file (design decision 15), or says why it failed.
 */
export function createExportHandler(options: ExportHandlerOptions): void {
  const { listen, getSelectedProteins, getUnplacedProteinCount, legendElement, plotElement, notify } =
    options;

  async function openPublishEditor(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Lazy-import the publish modal component (side-effect registers the custom element on
      // first open).
      const { ProtspacePublishModal } = await import('@protspace/core/publish');

      // Remove any existing modal
      document.querySelector('protspace-publish-modal')?.remove();

      // Construct via the registry, not `new ProtspacePublishModal()`. After Vite HMR
      // re-evaluates publish-modal.ts the class object on the import diverges from the one
      // registered for the tag, and `new` on the unregistered class throws "Illegal
      // constructor". createElement always uses the registered class.
      const modal = document.createElement('protspace-publish-modal') as InstanceType<
        typeof ProtspacePublishModal
      >;
      modal.plotElement = plotElement;
      modal.legendElement = legendElement;
      // Restore the last saved publish state (localStorage), else the modal's defaults.
      modal.savedPublishState = loadPublishState();

      // Handle export from the figure editor
      modal.addEventListener('publish-export', (async (e: CustomEvent) => {
        const { canvas, state } = e.detail as {
          canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
          state: Record<string, unknown> & { format: string; dpi: number };
        };

        savePublishState(state);

        try {
          const fname = generateFilename(state.format);
          if (state.format === 'pdf') {
            const widthMm = pxToMm(canvas.width, state.dpi);
            const heightMm = pxToMm(canvas.height, state.dpi);
            await exportCanvasAsPdf(canvas, { widthMm, heightMm, filename: fname });
          } else {
            const blob: Blob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              canvas.toBlob(
                (b) => (b ? resolve(b) : reject(new Error('canvas.toBlob produced no blob'))),
                'image/png',
              );
            });
            const withDpi = await pngWithDpi(blob, state.dpi);
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(withDpi);
            try {
              downloadFile(url, fname);
            } finally {
              URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            }
          }
          notify.success(getExportSuccessNotification(fname));
          modal.remove();
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Publish export failed:', err);
          notify.error(getExportFailureNotification(err));
          // Leave the modal open so the user can retry without losing context.
        }
      }) as EventListener);

      // Handle close — persist state to localStorage
      modal.addEventListener('close', ((e: CustomEvent) => {
        if (e.detail?.state) {
          savePublishState(e.detail.state as Record<string, unknown>);
        }
        modal.remove();
      }) as EventListener);

      document.body.appendChild(modal);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to open figure editor:', err);
      notify.error(getExportFailureNotification(err));
    }
  }

  async function quickExport(request: ExportRequest): Promise<void> {
    const {
      type,
      imageWidth,
      imageHeight,
      legendWidthPercent,
      legendFontSizePx,
      includeLegend,
      includeLegendSettings,
    } = request;

    try {
      if (type === 'parquet') {
        const currentData = plotElement.getCurrentData();
        if (!currentData) {
          throw new Error('No data available for export');
        }

        const includeSettings = !!includeLegendSettings;
        let settings: BundleSettings | undefined;
        if (includeSettings) {
          settings = {
            legendSettings: legendElement.getAllPersistedSettings(),
            exportOptions: {},
            publishState: loadPublishState() ?? undefined,
            eatOverlayEnabled: plotElement.eatOverlayEnabled,
            // The reliability slider position lives on the legend now (it drives the query
            // filter, not scatter-plot dimming), so persist it from there.
            eatConfidenceThreshold: legendElement.reliabilityThreshold,
            // Only a picked size: the live one may be seeded from the current annotation, and as
            // a top-level size it would override every other one.
            shapeSize: legendElement.pickedShapeSize,
          };
        }

        const filename = generateBundleFilename(includeSettings);
        // Subset exports carry no statistics by construction: sliceVisualizationDataByIndices
        // strips them, so whole-dataset scores can never describe an isolated/filtered slice.
        exportParquetBundle(currentData, filename, { includeSettings, settings });
        notify.success(getExportSuccessNotification(filename, getUnplacedProteinCount()));
        return;
      }

      const exporter = createExporter(plotElement);
      const shouldIncludeLegend = includeLegend ?? true;
      const totalWidth = imageWidth ?? EXPORT_DEFAULTS.IMAGE_WIDTH;
      const legendPercent = (legendWidthPercent ?? EXPORT_DEFAULTS.LEGEND_WIDTH_PERCENT) / 100;
      const targetWidth = shouldIncludeLegend
        ? Math.round(totalWidth * (1 - legendPercent))
        : totalWidth;
      const targetHeight = imageHeight ?? EXPORT_DEFAULTS.IMAGE_HEIGHT;

      const exportOptions = {
        targetWidth,
        targetHeight,
        legendWidthPercent: legendWidthPercent ?? EXPORT_DEFAULTS.LEGEND_WIDTH_PERCENT,
        legendScaleFactor:
          (legendFontSizePx ?? EXPORT_DEFAULTS.LEGEND_FONT_SIZE_PX) /
          EXPORT_DEFAULTS.BASE_FONT_SIZE,
        includeLegend: shouldIncludeLegend,
        includeSelection: getSelectedProteins().length > 0,
        backgroundColor: 'white' as const,
      };

      // PNG and PDF at 573K points take seconds: the toast waits for the file.
      const fileName =
        type === 'ids'
          ? exporter.exportProteinIds(exportOptions)
          : type === 'png'
            ? await exporter.exportPNG(exportOptions)
            : await exporter.exportPDF(exportOptions);
      if (fileName === null) {
        throw new Error('No data available for export');
      }
      notify.success(getExportSuccessNotification(fileName));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Export failed:', error);
      notify.error(getExportFailureNotification(error));
    }
  }

  listen('open-publish-editor', () => {
    void openPublishEditor();
  });
  listen('export', (event) => quickExport((event as CustomEvent<ExportRequest>).detail));
}
```

```ts
/** The Export menu: a menu named "Export" in the Export button's popover. */
const exportMenuList = (page: Page): Locator =>
  exportMenu(page).getByRole('menu', { name: 'Export', exact: true });

/** Opens the Export menu unless it is open; resolves once it shows. */
export async function openExportMenu(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await waitForExploreInteractionReady(page);
  const menu = exportMenuList(page);
  if (!(await menu.isVisible().catch(() => false))) {
    await exportMenu(page).getByRole('button', { name: 'Export', exact: true }).click();
  }
  await expect(menu).toBeVisible();
}

/** Opens the Export menu and chooses one of its exports. */
export async function exportAction(
  page: Page,
  name:
    | 'Figure editor…'
    | 'Quick PNG'
    | 'Quick PDF'
    | 'Protein IDs (.txt)'
    | 'Data bundle (.parquetbundle)',
): Promise<void> {
  await openExportMenu(page);
  await exportMenu(page).getByRole('menuitem', { name, exact: true }).click();
}
```

### Task 4.12: Honest loading overlay, empty state and drop target

The loading overlay takes the kit's look and tells the truth: local files are read in the browser, and only FASTA goes to the server (decision 15). It keeps `#progressive-loading`, its blocking, the example download's progress and Cancel. When nothing is loaded the plot says "Drop a file or pick an example", and a file dragged anywhere over the workbench shows a drop area; drop handling moves from the scatterplot to the shell.

- Modify: `apps/web/src/explore/loading-overlay.ts`, `loading-overlay.test.ts` (the DOM fake gains `className` and counts `innerHTML` writes)
- Modify: `apps/web/src/explore/dataset-controller.ts` (copy by load kind; the save step), `data-renderer.ts` (render copy), `load-queue.ts` and `types.ts` (`LoadMeta.fileName`, so the overlay can name the file), `runtime.ts` (FASTA copy, `datasetPhase`, the `file-dropped` listener on the data loader), with `dataset-controller.dataset-changes.test.ts` (`:343` and a new copy case), `data-renderer.test.ts`, `load-queue.test.ts`. `persisted-dataset.ts` keeps its download copy ("Downloading {label}…" over "12.3 / 44.9 MB", which `example-datasets.spec.ts:512` pins); the example's "Opening {label}" comes from `handleLoadingStart`. `startup.ts` is not changed: the runtime derives "empty" from the startup request settling with nothing on screen (`datasetPhaseFor`), so Task 4.8's edits to `startup.ts` stand alone.

- Produces:

The DOM is built with `createElement`/`textContent` only (no `innerHTML`): `div#progressive-loading.ps-loading[role=status][aria-live=polite][aria-atomic=true][aria-busy=true]` > `.ps-loading__card` > `p#processing-text.ps-loading__title`, `.ps-loading__bar` > `#progress-bar.ps-loading__fill`, `p#progress-text.ps-loading__detail`, `#loading-note.ps-loading__note`, `button#progressive-loading-cancel.ps-loading__cancel`; styled by `workbench.css` from tokens; removal stays synchronous; z-index 9999.
  - `LoadMeta.fileName?: string`, set by `registerFileLoad` from the file.
  - Copy: `handleLoadingStart`/`handleLoadingProgress` take `loadingCopyFor(loadQueue.getRunningLoadMeta())`; the save step reads "Saving a copy in this browser"; the renderer's steps read "Drawing {countNoun(n,'protein','proteins')}" with no detail; FASTA's title stays "Preparing FASTA…" with "Uploading to the embedding server…" as its first detail (later details — queue position, the embedding label, "Projecting…" — keep their text).
  - `workbench-status.ts`: `datasetPhase: 'starting' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty'` (default `'starting'`); `export function datasetPhaseFor(facts: { overlayShown: boolean; displayed: boolean; startupSettled: boolean })` (`loading` while the overlay shows, else `ready` with a dataset on screen, else `empty` once startup has settled, else `starting`). The runtime recomputes it when the overlay shows or hides, after `data-loaded` and `data-error` are handled, when a dataset request (the startup load included) settles, and after a cancelled example's fallback; it resets to `'starting'` on dispose. So `'empty'` covers `default-failed`, `recovery-required` (the banner shows over the empty state), an initial cancel with no dataset, and a load error with nothing shown.
  - `file-drop.ts`: `export function isFileDrag(types: readonly string[] | DOMStringList): boolean` (true only with `'Files'`); `export function createDragDepth(): { enter(): boolean; leave(): boolean; reset(): void; readonly active: boolean }` (`enter` returns true when it became active, `leave` true when it became inactive; a `leave` at 0 stays at 0).
  - `use-file-drop.ts`: `export function useFileDrop(root: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>): boolean` — listens on the workbench root in the capture phase for `dragenter`/`dragover`/`dragleave`/`drop` and on window `blur`/`dragend`; acts only for file drags (`preventDefault` on `dragover` only then, so a text drop into the search box still works); on drop stops the event (Mol* or a panel underneath must not open it too) and dispatches `new CustomEvent('file-dropped', { detail: { file }, bubbles: true })` on `#myDataLoader`; returns whether a file drag is over the workbench.
  - `Workbench.tsx`: `data-dragging` on `.workbench` while dragging; `div.wb-drop-area[aria-hidden=true]` ("Drop to open this file") as the last child of `.wb-body`, shown by CSS; `inert` on `.workbench` while `datasetPhase === 'loading'`.
  - `EmptyState.tsx` (memoised child of `PlotArea`, reads `useWorkbenchStatus().datasetPhase`): `<div className="wb-empty" data-workbench="empty" hidden={phase !== 'empty'}>` with "Drop a file or pick an example", the format note, `ps-button variant="primary"` "Open a file…" (dispatches `open-file-dialog` on `#myImportMenu`) and `ps-button variant="secondary"` "Pick an example" (`openFrom(button)` on `#myImportMenu`). Never a conditional around `#myPlot`.
  - Runtime: `file-dropped` is heard on `dataLoader` (not the plot). The undo controller's `isModalOpen` (Task 4.6) also returns true while `getWorkbenchStatus().datasetPhase === 'loading'`, so a Ctrl+Z during a load cannot restore the outgoing dataset's ids into a plot that is about to be replaced (history is cleared only when the new dataset renders).
  - Helpers (`helpers/workbench.ts`): `dropFileOnWorkbench(page, target: Locator, file: { name: string; mimeType: string; buffer: Buffer }): Promise<void>` (synthetic `DataTransfer` drag events; it checks the drop area shows during the drag and hides after the drop), `emptyState(page): Locator`.
