```ts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Minimal fake DOM — avoids needing jsdom/happy-dom as a dependency.
// The controller accepts a `doc` parameter so we pass this in instead of
// the global `document`.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface FakeEl {
  _tag: string;
  id: string;
  className: string;
  textContent: string;
  href: string;
  target: string;
  rel: string;
  type: string;
  style: { cssText: string; width?: string };
  children: FakeEl[];
  _attrs: Record<string, string>;
  setAttribute(k: string, v: string): void;
  getAttribute(k: string): string | null;
  appendChild(child: FakeEl): FakeEl;
  querySelector(sel: string): FakeEl | null;
  querySelectorAll(sel: string): FakeEl[];
  insertAdjacentElement(pos: string, el: FakeEl): void;
  remove(): void;
  addEventListener(type: string, handler: () => void): void;
  readonly firstElementChild: FakeEl | null;
  innerHTML: string;
}

function makeDoc() {
  let innerHtmlWrites = 0;

  function findById(root: FakeEl, id: string): FakeEl | null {
    if (root.id === id) return root;
    for (const child of root.children) {
      const found = findById(child, id);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function findParent(root: FakeEl, target: FakeEl): FakeEl | null {
    if (root.children.includes(target)) return root;
    for (const child of root.children) {
      const found = findParent(child, target);
      if (found) return found;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function createElement(tag: string): FakeEl {
    const el: FakeEl = {
      _tag: tag,
      id: '',
      className: '',
      textContent: '',
      href: '',
      target: '',
      rel: '',
      type: '',
      style: { cssText: '' },
      children: [],
      _attrs: {},
      setAttribute(k, v) {
        this._attrs[k] = v;
      },
      getAttribute(k) {
        return this._attrs[k] ?? null;
      },
      appendChild(child) {
        this.children.push(child);
        return child;
      },
      querySelector(sel) {
        const id = sel.startsWith('#') ? sel.slice(1) : null;
        if (!id) return null;
        // Search within this element's subtree (excluding self)
        for (const child of this.children) {
          const found = findById(child, id);
          if (found) return found;
        }
        return null;
      },
      querySelectorAll(_sel) {
        return [];
      },
      insertAdjacentElement(pos, inserted) {
        const parent = findParent(body, this);
        if (!parent) return;
        const idx = parent.children.indexOf(this);
        if (pos === 'afterend' && idx >= 0) {
          parent.children.splice(idx + 1, 0, inserted);
        }
      },
      remove() {
        const parent = findParent(body, this);
        if (parent) {
          const idx = parent.children.indexOf(this);
          if (idx >= 0) parent.children.splice(idx, 1);
        }
      },
      addEventListener(_type, _handler) {},
      get firstElementChild() {
        return this.children[0] ?? null;
      },
      get innerHTML() {
        return '';
      },
      set innerHTML(_html: string) {
        // The overlay must never parse a string as markup: count every attempt.
        innerHtmlWrites++;
      },
    };
    return el;
  }

  const body = createElement('body');

  return {
    body: body as unknown as HTMLElement,
    createElement: (tag: string) => createElement(tag) as unknown as HTMLElement,
    getElementById(id: string): HTMLElement | null {
      return findById(body, id) as unknown as HTMLElement | null;
    },
    // expose body as FakeEl for test introspection
    _body: body,
    _byId: (id: string) => findById(body, id),
    innerHtmlWrites: () => innerHtmlWrites,
  };
}

type FakeDoc = ReturnType<typeof makeDoc>;

let doc: FakeDoc;

beforeEach(() => {
  doc = makeDoc();
});

const getNoteEl = () => doc._byId('loading-note');

function hasTag(root: FakeEl, tag: string): boolean {
  return root._tag === tag || root.children.some((child) => hasTag(child, tag));
}

describe('loading-overlay rendering', () => {
  it('builds the card from classes, with the ids the e2e reads', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 30, 'Reading mine.parquetbundle…', 'Reading your file in the browser');

    const overlay = doc._byId('progressive-loading')!;
    expect(overlay.className).toBe('ps-loading');
    expect(overlay.getAttribute('role')).toBe('status');
    expect(overlay.getAttribute('aria-live')).toBe('polite');
    expect(overlay.getAttribute('aria-busy')).toBe('true');
    expect(overlay.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe(
      'Reading your file in the browser. Reading mine.parquetbundle…',
    );
    // No inline styling: workbench.css styles the classes from tokens.
    expect(overlay.style.cssText).toBe('');
    const card = overlay.firstElementChild!;
    expect(card.className).toBe('ps-loading__card');
    expect(doc._byId('processing-text')!.className).toBe('ps-loading__title');
    expect(doc._byId('processing-text')!.textContent).toBe('Reading your file in the browser');
    expect(doc._byId('progress-text')!.className).toBe('ps-loading__detail');
    expect(doc._byId('progress-text')!.textContent).toBe('Reading mine.parquetbundle…');
    expect(doc._byId('progress-bar')!.className).toBe('ps-loading__fill');
    expect(doc._byId('progress-bar')!.style.width).toBe('30%');
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('never sets innerHTML', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub', { text: 'A note', href: 'https://example.com' });
    ctrl.setCancelHandler(() => {}, 'Cancel download');
    ctrl.update(true, 20, 'msg2', 'sub2');
    expect(doc.innerHtmlWrites()).toBe(0);
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('a message with <img> stays text', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>', '<b>sub</b>');
    expect(doc._byId('progress-text')!.textContent).toBe('<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>');
    expect(doc._byId('processing-text')!.textContent).toBe('<b>sub</b>');
    expect(hasTag(doc._body, 'img')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasTag(doc._body, 'b')).toBe(false);
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('Cancel keeps its id and label', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub');
    ctrl.setCancelHandler(() => {}, 'Cancel download');
    const button = doc._byId('progressive-loading-cancel')!;
    expect(button._tag).toBe('button');
    expect(button.type).toBe('button');
    expect(button.className).toBe('ps-loading__cancel');
    expect(button.textContent).toBe('Cancel download');
    expect(button.style.cssText).toBe('');
    ctrl.setCancelHandler(null);
    expect(doc._byId('progressive-loading-cancel')).toBeNull();
    ctrl.dispose();
  });
});

describe('loading-overlay note rendering', () => {
  it('renders no #loading-note when update is called without a note arg', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub');
    expect(getNoteEl()).toBeNull();
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('renders #loading-note with text and link when note is provided', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    const note: OverlayNote = {
      text: 'Got a larger dataset?',
      href: 'https://colab.example.com',
      linkText: 'Open in Colab',
    };
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub', note);
    const noteEl = getNoteEl();
    expect(noteEl).not.toBeNull();
    expect(noteEl!.className).toBe('ps-loading__note');
    const span = noteEl!.children.find((c) => c._tag === 'span');
    expect(span?.textContent).toBe('Got a larger dataset?');
    const anchor = noteEl!.children.find((c) => c._tag === 'a');
    expect(anchor?.textContent).toBe('Open in Colab');
    expect(anchor?.target).toBe('_blank');
    expect(anchor?.rel).toBe('noopener noreferrer');
    expect(anchor?.style.cssText).toBe('');
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('leaves the note in the DOM when update is called again with undefined note', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub', { text: 'Persistent note' });
    ctrl.update(true, 20, 'msg2', 'sub2');
    expect(getNoteEl()).not.toBeNull();
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('removes #loading-note when note is passed as null', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub', { text: 'Some note' });
    expect(getNoteEl()).not.toBeNull();
    ctrl.update(true, 20, 'msg2', 'sub2', null);
    expect(getNoteEl()).toBeNull();
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('renders note text as text content — HTML is not interpreted', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub', { text: '<script>alert(1)</script>' });
    const noteEl = getNoteEl();
    expect(noteEl).not.toBeNull();
    const span = noteEl!.children.find((c) => c._tag === 'span');
    // textContent assignment — no script element is created
    expect(span?.textContent).toBe('<script>alert(1)</script>');
    expect(hasTag(doc._body, 'script')).toBe(false);
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it.skip('javascript: href — URL validation out of scope; current behavior is unvalidated', () => {
    // Intentionally skipped per spec §2.5: URL sanitization is out of scope.
  });

  it('does not render a note after hide+show when no note arg is passed on re-show', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 10, 'msg', 'sub', { text: 'Ephemeral note' });
    expect(getNoteEl()).not.toBeNull();
    // hide resets currentNote and removes the overlay
    ctrl.update(false);
    // Re-show without a note arg — overlay is recreated fresh, no note
    ctrl.update(true, 5, 'new msg', 'new sub');
    expect(getNoteEl()).toBeNull();
    ctrl.dispose();
  });
});

describe('loading-overlay dismissal', () => {
  it('removes the overlay synchronously, with no fade and no timer', () => {
    // No `window` stub: a removal timer would throw here, and a fade would leave
    // the element in the document after update(false) returns.
    const setTimeoutSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout');
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    ctrl.update(true, 50, 'msg', 'sub');
    expect(doc.getElementById('progressive-loading')).not.toBeNull();

    ctrl.update(false);

    expect(doc.getElementById('progressive-loading')).toBeNull();
    expect(setTimeoutSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    setTimeoutSpy.mockRestore();
    ctrl.dispose();
  });

  it('is a no-op when no overlay is shown', () => {
    const ctrl = createLoadingOverlayController(doc as unknown as Document);
    expect(() => ctrl.update(false)).not.toThrow();
    expect(doc.getElementById('progressive-loading')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
    expect(depth.active).toBe(false);
    expect(depth.enter()).toBe(true);

    depth.enter();
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Rebuild the overlay and its copy**

Replace the whole of `apps/web/src/explore/loading-overlay.ts` with:

```ts
import { countNoun } from '@protspace/utils';
import type { DatasetLoadKind } from './types';

export interface OverlayNote {
  text: string;
  href?: string;
  linkText?: string;
}

export interface LoadingOverlayController {
  update(
    show: boolean,
    progress?: number,
    message?: string,
    subMessage?: string,
    note?: OverlayNote | null,
  ): void;
  setCancelHandler(handler: (() => void) | null, label?: string): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

/**
 * The share of the loading bar, in percent, that an example's download fills
 * (persisted-dataset.ts). Decoding and rendering report progress on a 0–100
 * scale of their own, which `progressAfterExampleDownload` maps onto the rest,
 * so the bar never runs backwards.
 */
export const EXAMPLE_DOWNLOAD_SHARE = 40;

/** Maps a decode or render phase's 0–100 progress onto the bar left after an example's download. */
export function progressAfterExampleDownload(progress: number): number {
  const clamped = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, progress));
  return EXAMPLE_DOWNLOAD_SHARE + (clamped * (100 - EXAMPLE_DOWNLOAD_SHARE)) / 100;
}

/**
 * What the overlay says (design decision 15). It tells the truth about the data: a local file is
 * read in the browser, and only a FASTA file is sent to the server, for embedding.
 */
export const LOADING_COPY = {
  readingTitle: 'Reading your file in the browser',
  readingFile: (name: string) => `Reading ${name}…`,
  openingExample: (label: string) => `Opening ${label}`,
  reopeningStored: (name: string) => `Reopening ${name} from this browser`,
  saving: 'Saving a copy in this browser',
  drawing: (count: number) => `Drawing ${countNoun(count, 'protein', 'proteins')}`,
  fastaTitle: 'Preparing FASTA…',
  fastaUploading: 'Uploading to the embedding server…',
} as const;

/** The overlay's title and detail line while the data loader decodes, by where the data came from. */
export function loadingCopyFor(
  meta: { kind: DatasetLoadKind; example?: { entry: { label: string } }; fileName?: string } | null,
): { title: string; detail: string } {
  if (meta?.example) {
    // An example's label reads "name · proteins · size"; the name is enough, as in the app bar.
    return { title: LOADING_COPY.openingExample(meta.example.entry.label.split(' · ')[0]), detail: '' };
  }
  if (meta?.kind === 'opfs' && meta.fileName) {
    return { title: LOADING_COPY.reopeningStored(meta.fileName), detail: '' };
  }
  return {
    title: LOADING_COPY.readingTitle,
    detail: meta?.fileName ? LOADING_COPY.readingFile(meta.fileName) : '',
  };
}

const OVERLAY_ID = 'progressive-loading';
const CANCEL_BUTTON_ID = 'progressive-loading-cancel';
const CANCEL_DEFAULT_LABEL = 'Cancel';

/**
 * The full-page loading overlay. It blocks the page while a load runs; the runtime also makes the
 * workbench inert meanwhile, so the keyboard cannot reach what the overlay covers. Built with
 * `createElement` and `textContent` only: a file name or a server message is never parsed as
 * markup. `workbench.css` styles its classes from the tokens. `subMessage` is the title,
 * `message` the line under the bar.
 */
export function createLoadingOverlayController(doc: Document = document): LoadingOverlayController {
  let cancelHandler: (() => void) | null = null;
  let cancelLabel = CANCEL_DEFAULT_LABEL;
  let currentNote: OverlayNote | null = null;

  const element = <K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(
    tag: K,
    className: string,
    id?: string,
  ): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K] => {
    const el = doc.createElement(tag);
    el.className = className;
    if (id) el.id = id;
    return el;
  };

  const build = (): HTMLElement => {
    const overlay = element('div', 'ps-loading', OVERLAY_ID);
    overlay.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-atomic', 'true');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    const card = element('div', 'ps-loading__card');
    const bar = element('div', 'ps-loading__bar');
    bar.appendChild(element('div', 'ps-loading__fill', 'progress-bar'));
    card.appendChild(element('p', 'ps-loading__title', 'processing-text'));
    card.appendChild(bar);
    card.appendChild(element('p', 'ps-loading__detail', 'progress-text'));
    overlay.appendChild(card);
    return overlay;
  };

  const renderCancelButton = (overlay: HTMLElement) => {
    let button = overlay.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`#${CANCEL_BUTTON_ID}`);

    if (!cancelHandler) {
      button?.remove();
      return;
    }

    if (!button) {
      button = element('button', 'ps-loading__cancel', CANCEL_BUTTON_ID);
      button.type = 'button';
      button.addEventListener('click', () => cancelHandler?.());
      (overlay.firstElementChild ?? overlay).appendChild(button);
    }

    button.textContent = cancelLabel;
  };

  const renderNote = (overlay: HTMLElement) => {
    overlay.querySelector('#loading-note')?.remove();
    if (!currentNote) return;
    const noteEl = element('div', 'ps-loading__note', 'loading-note');
    const textSpan = doc.createElement('span');
    textSpan.textContent = currentNote.text;
    noteEl.appendChild(textSpan);
    if (currentNote.href) {
      const anchor = doc.createElement('a');
      anchor.href = currentNote.href;
      anchor.target = '_blank';
      anchor.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
      anchor.textContent = currentNote.linkText || currentNote.href;
      noteEl.appendChild(anchor);
    }
    const progressText = overlay.querySelector('#progress-text');
    if (progressText) {
      progressText.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', noteEl);
    } else {
      (overlay.firstElementChild ?? overlay).appendChild(noteEl);
    }
  };

  const update = (
    show: boolean,
    progress: number = 0,
    message: string = '',
    subMessage: string = '',
    note?: OverlayNote | null,
  ) => {
    let overlay = doc.getElementById(OVERLAY_ID);

    if (!show) {
      currentNote = null;
      // Removed at once, with no fade: callers dismiss only when the load has settled,
      // and a fading overlay still covers (and blocks clicks on) the page meanwhile.
      overlay?.remove();
      return;
    }

    if (!overlay) {
      overlay = build();
      doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
    }

    overlay.setAttribute('aria-label', [subMessage, message].filter(Boolean).join('. '));

    const progressBar = overlay.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#progress-bar');
    const progressText = overlay.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#progress-text');
    const processingText = overlay.querySelector<HTMLElement>('#processing-text');

    if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;
    if (progressText) progressText.textContent = message;
    if (processingText) processingText.textContent = subMessage;

    if (note !== undefined) {
      currentNote = note;
    }
    renderNote(overlay);
    renderCancelButton(overlay);
  };

  const setCancelHandler = (handler: (() => void) | null, label?: string) => {
    cancelHandler = handler;
    cancelLabel = label ?? CANCEL_DEFAULT_LABEL;
    const overlay = doc.getElementById(OVERLAY_ID);
    if (overlay) renderCancelButton(overlay);
  };

  return {
    update,
    setCancelHandler,
    dispose() {
      cancelHandler = null;
      currentNote = null;
      doc.getElementById(OVERLAY_ID)?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The plot area's phase from three runtime facts. Startup must have ended before the empty state
 * shows, so "Drop a file…" never flashes before the startup load has even begun.
 */
export function datasetPhaseFor({
  overlayShown,
  displayed,
  startupSettled,
}: {
  overlayShown: boolean;
  displayed: boolean;
  startupSettled: boolean;
}): DatasetPhase {
  if (overlayShown) return 'loading';
  if (displayed) return 'ready';
  return startupSettled ? 'empty' : 'starting';
}
```

Create `apps/web/src/explore/file-drop.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Whether a drag carries files: the operating system's file drag. Text drags and the legend's row
 * reordering (native drag and drop) carry none, so they never light the drop area.
 */
export function isFileDrag(types: readonly string[] | DOMStringList): boolean {
  return Array.from(types as ArrayLike<string>).includes('Files');
}

/**
 * Counts nested `dragenter`/`dragleave` pairs: a drag fires both on every child it crosses, so
 * only the depth says when it has really left. `enter` and `leave` report the moments the drag
 * arrives and goes.
 */
export function createDragDepth(): {
  enter(): boolean;
  leave(): boolean;
  reset(): void;
  readonly active: boolean;
} {
  let depth = 0;
  return {
    enter() {
      depth += 1;
      return depth === 1;
    },
    leave() {
      if (depth === 0) return false;
      depth -= 1;
      return depth === 0;
    },
    reset() {
      depth = 0;
    },
    get active() {
      return depth > 0;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  lifecycle.addCleanup(() =>

  );

  let overlayShown = false;

      loadingOverlay.update(show, progress, message, subMessage, note);
      if (show !== overlayShown) {
        overlayShown = show;
        syncDatasetPhase();

    setCancelHandler: (handler, label) => loadingOverlay.setCancelHandler(handler, label),
    dispose() {
```

```ts
          // Startup has ended: with nothing on screen now, the plot invites a drop.
          startupSettled = true;
          syncDatasetPhase();
        });
```

Create `apps/web/src/workbench/use-file-drop.ts`:

```ts
import { useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { createDragDepth, isFileDrag } from '../explore/file-drop';

/**
 * Drops anywhere on the workbench load the file (design decision 15): the shell owns drops, not
 * the plot. Only drags that carry files count, so text drags and the legend's row reordering
 * neither light the drop area nor lose their own drop. Listens in the capture phase, so a panel
 * underneath (Mol* in the structure viewer) never opens the file too. Returns whether a file drag
 * is over the workbench.
 */
export function useFileDrop(root: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>): boolean {
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const element = root.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const depth = createDragDepth();
    const carriesFiles = (event: DragEvent) =>
      !!event.dataTransfer && isFileDrag(event.dataTransfer.types);
    const end = () => {
      depth.reset();
      setDragging(false);
    };

    const onEnter = (event: DragEvent) => {
      if (!carriesFiles(event)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (depth.enter()) setDragging(true);
    };
    const onOver = (event: DragEvent) => {
      if (!carriesFiles(event)) return;
      // Allows the drop; a text drag keeps the browser's default (a drop into the search box).
      event.preventDefault();
      event.dataTransfer!.dropEffect = 'copy';
    };
    const onLeave = (event: DragEvent) => {
      if (!carriesFiles(event)) return;
      if (depth.leave()) setDragging(false);
    };
    const onDrop = (event: DragEvent) => {
      if (!carriesFiles(event)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      end();
      const file = event.dataTransfer!.files[0];
      if (!file) return;
      // The runtime listens on the data loader (runtime.ts) and loads it as a user import.
      document
        .getElementById('myDataLoader')
        ?.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('file-dropped', { detail: { file }, bubbles: true }));
    };

    element.addEventListener('dragenter', onEnter, true);
    element.addEventListener('dragover', onOver, true);
    element.addEventListener('dragleave', onLeave, true);
    element.addEventListener('drop', onDrop, true);
    window.addEventListener('blur', end);
    window.addEventListener('dragend', end);
    return () => {
      element.removeEventListener('dragenter', onEnter, true);
      element.removeEventListener('dragover', onOver, true);
      element.removeEventListener('dragleave', onLeave, true);
      element.removeEventListener('drop', onDrop, true);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', end);
      window.removeEventListener('dragend', end);
    };
  }, [root]);

  return dragging;
}
```

```tsx
import { memo, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import type { ProtspaceImportMenu } from '@protspace/core';
import { useWorkbenchStatus } from './use-workbench-status';

const FORMAT_NOTE =
  '.parquetbundle files are read in your browser. FASTA files (.fasta, .fa, .fna) are sent to the server for embedding.';

const importMenu = () => document.getElementById('myImportMenu') as ProtspaceImportMenu | null;

/** Asks the Import menu's host for the file chooser, still inside the click (import-controller.ts). */
function openFile(): void {
  importMenu()?.dispatchEvent(
    new CustomEvent('open-file-dialog', { detail: {}, bubbles: true, composed: true }),
  );
}

/** Opens the Import panel, with its examples, under the pressed button. */
function pickExample(event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>): void {
  importMenu()?.openFrom(event.currentTarget);
}

/**
 * What the plot shows when nothing is loaded (design decision 15). A sibling over the plot, never
 * a conditional around `#myPlot`; hidden until startup has ended with nothing on screen.
 */
export const EmptyState = memo(function EmptyState() {

      <p className="wb-empty-title">Drop a file or pick an example</p>
      <p className="wb-empty-note">{FORMAT_NOTE}</p>

          Open a file…
        </ps-button>
        <ps-button variant="secondary" onClick={pickExample}>
          Pick an example
        </ps-button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
```

In `apps/web/tests/helpers/workbench.ts`, append:

```ts
/** The empty plot's invitation: "Drop a file or pick an example". */
export function emptyState(page: Page): Locator {
  return page.locator('[data-workbench="empty"]');
}

/**
 * Drags `file` over `target` and drops it, as the operating system would: synthetic drag events
 * carrying a DataTransfer with the file. The drop area must show while the file is over the
 * workbench and go after the drop.
 */
export async function dropFileOnWorkbench(
  page: Page,
  target: Locator,
  file: { name: string; mimeType: string; buffer: Buffer },
): Promise<void> {
  const dataTransfer = await page.evaluateHandle(
    ({ bytes, name, mimeType }) => {
      const transfer = new DataTransfer();
      transfer.items.add(new File([new Uint8Array(bytes)], name, { type: mimeType }));
      return transfer;
    },
    { bytes: Array.from(file.buffer), name: file.name, mimeType: file.mimeType },
  );
  await target.dispatchEvent('dragenter', { dataTransfer });
  await target.dispatchEvent('dragover', { dataTransfer });
  await expect(page.locator('.wb-drop-area')).toBeVisible();
  await target.dispatchEvent('drop', { dataTransfer });
  await expect(page.locator('.wb-drop-area')).toBeHidden();
  await dataTransfer.dispose();
}
```

````md
const carriesFiles = (event) => [...event.dataTransfer.types].includes('Files');

});
````

```ts
import { InsetRenderCache, type CaptureablePlotElement } from './inset-render-cache';

const RECT = { w: 1000, h: 800 };

/** One inset over the same source region; `size` is its target's share of the plot. */
function inset(size = 0.2) {
  return {
    sourceRect: { x: 0.1, y: 0.1, w: 0.1, h: 0.1 },
    targetRect: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, w: size, h: size },
    border: 2,
    connector: 'lines' as const,

  };

/** A plot that "renders" a sized stand-in canvas and counts its renders. */
function stubPlot() {

  const plot = {
    captureAtResolution: (w: number, h: number) => {
      calls++;
      return { width: w, height: h } as HTMLCanvasElement;
    },
    getDataExtent: () => ({ xMin: 0, xMax: 10, yMin: 0, yMax: 10 }),
    getRenderInfo: () => ({ marginLeft: 20, marginRight: 20, marginTop: 20, marginBottom: 20 }),

  return { plot, calls: () => calls };
}

    const { plot, calls } = stubPlot();

    const [first] = cache.capture(plot, { insets: [inset()] }, RECT, '#ffffff');
    const [second] = cache.capture(plot, { insets: [inset()] }, RECT, '#ffffff');

    expect(calls()).toBe(1);
    expect(second).toBe(first);

    vi.useFakeTimers();

    const { plot, calls } = stubPlot();

    const [stretched] = cache.capture(plot, { insets: [inset(0.25)] }, RECT, '#ffffff');

    const { plot, calls } = stubPlot();

    cache.capture(plot, { insets: [inset(0.25)] }, RECT, '#ffffff', { forExport: true });

    expect(calls()).toBe(2);

    const onSettle = vi.fn();

    const { plot, calls } = stubPlot();

    cache.capture(plot, { insets: [inset(0.2)] }, RECT, '#ffffff');
    expect(calls()).toBe(2);
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the cache**

Create `packages/core/src/components/publish/inset-render-cache.ts` (the body of `capture` is `_captureInsetRenders` moved verbatim, with `this._insetRenderCache` → `this.renders`, `this._lastInsetCanvases` → `this.lastCanvases`, `this._lastInsetRenderAt` → `this.lastRenderAt`, `this._settleTimer` → `this.settleTimer`, `this._scheduleRedraw()` → `this.onSettle()`):

```ts
import type { PublishState } from './publish-state';

/** The plot surface the figure editor renders from: the scatterplot's export hooks. */
export interface CaptureablePlotElement extends HTMLElement {
  captureAtResolution?: (
    w: number,
    h: number,
    opts: {
      dpr?: number;
      backgroundColor?: string;
      dataDomain?: { xMin: number; xMax: number; yMin: number; yMax: number };
      pointSizeReference?: { width: number; height: number };
      resetView?: boolean;
    },
  ) => HTMLCanvasElement;
  getDataExtent?: (options?: {
    padded?: boolean;
  }) => { xMin: number; xMax: number; yMin: number; yMax: number } | null;
  getRenderInfo?: (
    exportWidth: number,
    exportHeight: number,
  ) => {
    marginLeft: number;
    marginRight: number;
    marginTop: number;
    marginBottom: number;
  } | null;
}

/** Updates closer together than this reuse the last render instead of a fresh WebGL pass. */
const FAST_PATH_MS = 80;
/** After a reused render, one fresh render follows once updates stop for this long. */
const SETTLE_MS = 120;

/**
 * The figure editor's zoom-inset renders. Each inset is its own scoped WebGL pass, so points stay
 * native pixel size in the inset (instead of the giant blobs raster crop+upscale produces).
 *
 * Renders are cached by sourceRect + plot dims, so resizing the target rect (drag-to-grow the
 * inset) doesn't trigger a re-render — the compositor scales the cached canvas to the new
 * target. The WebGL pass only fires when the user actually changes the source region or the plot
 * resizes.
 */
export class InsetRenderCache {
  /** Renders by source rect, render size, plot size, dot scale and background. */
  readonly renders = new Map<string, HTMLCanvasElement>();
  /** The last canvas per inset: the compositor stretches it while a drag outruns fresh renders. */
  lastCanvases: Array<HTMLCanvasElement | null> = [];
  lastRenderAt = 0;
  settleTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private readonly onSettle: () => void;

  /** `onSettle` asks the editor for one more redraw once a burst of updates has stopped. */
  constructor(onSettle: () => void) {
    this.onSettle = onSettle;
  }

  /**
   * One entry per `state.insets`; null when the plot element doesn't expose `getDataExtent`
   * (older builds) or has no points yet — the compositor falls back to the legacy raster path in
   * that case.
   */
  capture(
    plotEl: CaptureablePlotElement,
    state: Pick<PublishState, 'insets'>,
    plotRect: { w: number; h: number },
    bgColor: string,
    opts: { forExport?: boolean } = {},
  ): Array<HTMLCanvasElement | null> {
    if (state.insets.length === 0) {
      this.renders.clear();
      return [];
    }
    if (!plotEl.captureAtResolution || !plotEl.getDataExtent) {
      return state.insets.map(() => null);
    }
    const fullExtent = plotEl.getDataExtent({ padded: true });
    if (!fullExtent) return state.insets.map(() => null);
    const xRange = fullExtent.xMax - fullExtent.xMin;
    const yRange = fullExtent.yMax - fullExtent.yMin;
    // Margin-aware inversion so the inset's data domain matches what the user
    // sees inside the source rect outline pixel-for-pixel. Without this, the
    // raw `sr.x → xMin + sr.x*xRange` mapping would be off by ~margin/canvas
    // (a couple of percent) — visible when the user compares the source rect
    // outline against the inset content.
    const margin = plotEl.getRenderInfo?.(plotRect.w, plotRect.h) ?? {
      marginLeft: 0,
      marginRight: 0,
      marginTop: 0,
      marginBottom: 0,
    };
    const dataAreaW = Math.max(1, plotRect.w - margin.marginLeft - margin.marginRight);
    const dataAreaH = Math.max(1, plotRect.h - margin.marginTop - margin.marginBottom);
    const canvasToDataX = (canvasX: number) =>
      fullExtent.xMin + ((canvasX - margin.marginLeft) / dataAreaW) * xRange;
    const canvasToDataY = (canvasY: number) =>
      fullExtent.yMax - ((canvasY - margin.marginTop) / dataAreaH) * yRange;
    // High-frequency state churn (active drag/resize) → skip the WebGL
    // pass and reuse whichever canvas we last rendered for this inset. The
    // compositor stretches it to the live target rect via drawImage. Once
    // updates settle for ~80 ms, the next redraw renders fresh.
    const now =
      typeof performance !== 'undefined' && typeof performance.now === 'function'
        ? performance.now()
        : Date.now();
    const fastPath = !opts.forExport && now - this.lastRenderAt < FAST_PATH_MS;
    const livingKeys = new Set<string>();
    if (this.lastCanvases.length !== state.insets.length) {
      this.lastCanvases.length = state.insets.length;
    }
    let didFreshRender = false;
    const renders = state.insets.map((inset, i) => {
      const sr = inset.sourceRect;
      const tr = inset.targetRect;
      // Render the inset at the target rect's exact pixel dims so a fresh
      // pass produces dots at the correct main-plot scale (1:1 pixel mapping
      // between rendered and displayed). Caching at plot dims would shrink
      // dots by `target/plot` after drawImage downscale.
      const renderW = Math.max(1, Math.round(tr.w * plotRect.w));
      const renderH = Math.max(1, Math.round(tr.h * plotRect.h));
      const pointScale = inset.pointSizeScale ?? 1;
      const key = `${sr.x.toFixed(5)}:${sr.y.toFixed(5)}:${sr.w.toFixed(5)}:${sr.h.toFixed(5)}|${renderW}x${renderH}|${plotRect.w}x${plotRect.h}|${pointScale.toFixed(3)}|${bgColor}`;
      livingKeys.add(key);
      const cached = this.renders.get(key);
      if (cached) {
        this.lastCanvases[i] = cached;
        return cached;
      }
      // No exact match. During high-frequency updates, return the previous
      // render (any size) and let the compositor stretch it — saves the
      // ~15–30 ms WebGL setup cost per frame.
      if (fastPath && this.lastCanvases[i]) {
        return this.lastCanvases[i];
      }
      const cx0 = sr.x * plotRect.w;
      const cx1 = (sr.x + sr.w) * plotRect.w;
      const cy0 = sr.y * plotRect.h;
      const cy1 = (sr.y + sr.h) * plotRect.h;
      const dataDomain = {
        xMin: canvasToDataX(cx0),
        xMax: canvasToDataX(cx1),
        yMax: canvasToDataY(cy0),
        yMin: canvasToDataY(cy1),
      };
      // sizeScaleFactor = sqrt(refW × refH / displayArea), so scaling the
      // reference dims by `pointScale` linearly multiplies the rendered dot
      // size by exactly `pointScale`. With render dims = target dims and
      // pointScale = 1, the inset matches the main plot's pixel dot size.
      try {
        const canvas = plotEl.captureAtResolution!(renderW, renderH, {
          dpr: 1,
          backgroundColor: bgColor,
          dataDomain,
          pointSizeReference: {
            width: plotRect.w * pointScale,
            height: plotRect.h * pointScale,
          },
          // dataDomain is derived from the full (default-view) extent, so the
          // live zoom must not be re-applied on top of it (#294).
          resetView: true,
        });
        this.renders.set(key, canvas);
        this.lastCanvases[i] = canvas;
        didFreshRender = true;
        return canvas;
      } catch {
        return this.lastCanvases[i] ?? null;
      }
    });
    if (didFreshRender) {
      this.lastRenderAt = now;
      // Activity settled enough to render fresh — drop any pending follow-up.
      if (this.settleTimer !== null) {
        clearTimeout(this.settleTimer);
        this.settleTimer = null;
      }
    } else if (fastPath) {
      // fastPath was taken: queue one more redraw so the cached canvas gets
      // replaced with a crisp render once the user stops dragging.
      if (this.settleTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.settleTimer);
      this.settleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.settleTimer = null;
        this.onSettle();
      }, SETTLE_MS);
    }
    // Evict cache entries no longer referenced (inset removed, sourceRect changed).
    for (const k of this.renders.keys()) {
      if (!livingKeys.has(k)) this.renders.delete(k);
    }
    return renders;
  }

  /** Drops every render and cancels a pending settle redraw. */
  clear(): void {
    if (this.settleTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.settleTimer);
    this.settleTimer = null;
    this.renders.clear();
    this.lastCanvases = [];
    this.lastRenderAt = 0;
  }
}
```

```ts
/** What the legend hands the figure editor (mirrors the export-utils reader). */
export interface LegendExportState {
  annotation: string;
  otherItemsCount: number;
  items: Array<{
    value: string;
    displayValue?: string;
    color: string;
    shape: string;
    count: number;
    isVisible: boolean;
    zOrder: number;
  }>;
}

/** The legend's export data, or null when the element has none, it has no items, or it throws. */
export function readLegendExportState(
  el: (Element & { getLegendExportData?: () => LegendExportState }) | null,
): LegendExportState | null {
  if (!el || typeof el.getLegendExportData !== 'function') return null;
  try {
    const s = el.getLegendExportData();
    if (s && Array.isArray(s.items)) return s;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to read legend export state:', e);
  }
  return null;
}
```

```ts
import { JOURNAL_PRESETS, type PresetId } from '../journal-presets';
```

Create `packages/core/src/components/publish/sections/dimensions-section.ts`:

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { cmToMm, inToMm, mmToCm, mmToIn, pxToMm } from '../dimension-utils';
import { getActivePresetMaxHeightPx, getActivePresetWidthPx } from '../publish-modal-helpers';
import type { PublishState } from '../publish-state';

type Unit = PublishState['unit'];

const RESAMPLE_TOOLTIP =
  'When on, changing the resolution re-renders the figure at a new pixel count. ' +
  'When off, only print-size metadata changes — pixels stay the same.';

interface DimensionsModel {
  state: PublishState;
  showResampleNote: boolean;
}

interface DimensionsHandlers {
  widthPx(px: number): void;
  widthMm(mm: number): void;
  heightPx(px: number): void;
  heightMm(mm: number): void;
  dpi(dpi: number): void;
  unit(unit: Unit): void;
  toggleResample(): void;
  toggleAspectLock(): void;
}

function unitToMm(value: number, unit: Exclude<Unit, 'px'>): number {
  if (unit === 'in') return inToMm(value);
  if (unit === 'cm') return cmToMm(value);
  return value; // 'mm' — no conversion
}

function formatDimensionForUnit(px: number, mm: number, unit: Unit): string {
  if (unit === 'px') return String(px);
  if (unit === 'mm') return mm.toFixed(1);
  if (unit === 'in') return mmToIn(mm).toFixed(2);
  return mmToCm(mm).toFixed(2);
}

/** A typed width or height: whole pixels in px, else converted to mm. A non-positive entry is ignored. */
function readSize(
  event: Event,
  unit: Unit,
  setPx: (px: number) => void,
  setMm: (mm: number) => void,
): void {
  const value = parseFloat((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  if (unit === 'px') setPx(Math.round(value));
  else setMm(unitToMm(value, unit));
}

function renderAspectLink(locked: boolean, disabled: boolean, onToggle: () => void) {
  // Bracket arms (always visible) flow from Width row → chain → Height row,
  // matching Photoshop's Image Size dialog. Chain glyph uses the Lucide
  // link / unlink paths translated to occupy the lower-right of the SVG so
  // the brackets have a clear vertical column on the left to live in.
  // While a journal preset pins width, the chain is meaningless — render it
  // as visibly broken and disabled so the UI matches the actual constraint.
  const effectiveLocked = locked && !disabled;
  return html`
    <button
      class="publish-aspect-lock ${effectiveLocked ? 'locked' : ''}"
      data-publish-input="aspect-lock"
      ?disabled=${disabled}
      @click=${() => {
        if (!disabled) onToggle();
      }}
      title=${disabled
        ? 'Width is fixed by the journal preset; only height is adjustable.'
        : effectiveLocked
          ? 'Linked: editing one rescales the other. Click to unlink.'
          : 'Unlinked: width and height are independent. Click to link.'}
      aria-pressed=${effectiveLocked}
    >
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 32 60"
        width="30"
        height="56"
        aria-hidden="true"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      >
        <!-- Bracket arms link Width row (top) and Height row (bottom) to the chain. -->
        <path class="aspect-lock-bracket" d="M 0 8 L 8 8 L 8 17" />
        <path class="aspect-lock-bracket" d="M 8 43 L 8 52 L 0 52" />

        <!-- LOCKED: Lucide 'link' icon rotated -45° so the chain axis -->
        <!-- runs straight top-to-bottom (vertical chain). -->
        <g class="aspect-lock-state-locked" transform="translate(8 18) rotate(-45 12 12)">
          <path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71" />
          <path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.72-1.71" />
        </g>

        <!-- UNLOCKED: Lucide 'unlink' rotated -45° — same vertical chain -->
        <!-- pulled apart with four small spark lines indicating a break. -->
        <g class="aspect-lock-state-unlocked" transform="translate(8 18) rotate(-45 12 12)">
          <path d="m18.84 12.25 1.72-1.71a5 5 0 0 0-.12-7.07 5 5 0 0 0-6.95 0l-1.72 1.71" />
          <path d="m5.17 11.75-1.71 1.71a5 5 0 0 0 .12 7.07 5 5 0 0 0 6.95 0l1.71-1.71" />
          <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="5" />
          <line x1="2" y1="8" x2="5" y2="8" />
          <line x1="16" y1="19" x2="16" y2="22" />
          <line x1="19" y1="16" x2="22" y2="16" />
        </g>
      </svg>
    </button>
  `;
}

/** Width, height, unit, resolution and Resample, in the Photoshop Image Size layout. */
export function renderDimensions(
  model: DimensionsModel,
  handlers: DimensionsHandlers,
): TemplateResult {
  const s = model.state;
  const widthMm = pxToMm(s.widthPx, s.dpi);
  const heightMm = pxToMm(s.heightPx, s.dpi);

  const widthDisplay = formatDimensionForUnit(s.widthPx, widthMm, s.unit);
  const heightDisplay = formatDimensionForUnit(s.heightPx, heightMm, s.unit);

  const dimsReadOnly = s.unit === 'px' && !s.resample;
  // Journal presets pin width and (optionally) cap height. While such a
  // preset is active, lock the width inputs and clamp the height slider.
  const widthLocked = getActivePresetWidthPx(s) !== null;
  const heightMaxPx = getActivePresetMaxHeightPx(s);

  return html`
    <div class="publish-section">
      <div class="publish-section-title">Dimensions</div>

      <div class="publish-dim-readout">
        ${dimsReadOnly ? 'Pixel Dims (locked)' : 'Pixel Dims'}:
        <strong>${s.widthPx} × ${s.heightPx} px</strong>
      </div>

      <div class="publish-dim-pair">
        <label class="publish-dim-label">Width</label>
        <div class="publish-dim-control">
          <input
            type="range"
            class="publish-slider"
            data-publish-input="width-slider"
            min="200"
            max="8000"
            step="1"
            ?disabled=${dimsReadOnly || widthLocked}
            .value=${String(s.widthPx)}
            @input=${(e: Event) => {
              const px = parseInt((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
              if (Number.isFinite(px) && px > 0) handlers.widthPx(px);
            }}
          />
          <input
            type="number"
            class="publish-row-input publish-dim-value"
            data-publish-input="width"
            ?disabled=${dimsReadOnly || widthLocked}
            title=${widthLocked ? 'Width is fixed by the active journal preset.' : ''}
            .value=${String(widthDisplay)}
            step=${s.unit === 'px' ? '1' : '0.1'}
            @change=${(e: Event) => readSize(e, s.unit, handlers.widthPx, handlers.widthMm)}
          />
        </div>
        ${renderAspectLink(s.aspectLocked, widthLocked, handlers.toggleAspectLock)}
        <select
          class="publish-select publish-unit-select"
          data-publish-input="unit"
          .value=${s.unit}
          @change=${(e: Event) => {
            handlers.unit((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as Unit);
          }}
        >
          <option value="px">px</option>
          <option value="mm">mm</option>
          <option value="in">in</option>
          <option value="cm">cm</option>
        </select>

        <label class="publish-dim-label">Height</label>
        <div class="publish-dim-control">
          <input
            type="range"
            class="publish-slider"
            data-publish-input="height-slider"
            min="200"
            max=${heightMaxPx !== null ? String(Math.max(200, heightMaxPx)) : '8000'}
            step="1"
            ?disabled=${dimsReadOnly}
            .value=${String(s.heightPx)}
            @input=${(e: Event) => {
              const px = parseInt((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
              if (Number.isFinite(px) && px > 0) handlers.heightPx(px);
            }}
          />
          <input
            type="number"
            class="publish-row-input publish-dim-value"
            data-publish-input="height"
            ?disabled=${dimsReadOnly}
            .value=${String(heightDisplay)}
            step=${s.unit === 'px' ? '1' : '0.1'}
            @change=${(e: Event) => readSize(e, s.unit, handlers.heightPx, handlers.heightMm)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="publish-dim-row">
        <label>Resolution</label>
        <div class="publish-input-group">
          <input
            type="number"
            class="publish-row-input"
            data-publish-input="dpi"
            min="1"
            max="2400"
            .value=${String(s.dpi)}
            @change=${(e: Event) => {
              handlers.dpi(parseInt((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || s.dpi);
            }}
          />
          <span class="publish-unit">Pixels/Inch</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label class="publish-checkbox-label">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="publish-checkbox"
          data-publish-input="resample"
          .checked=${s.resample}
          @change=${() => handlers.toggleResample()}
        />
        Resample
        <span class="publish-info" title=${RESAMPLE_TOOLTIP}>ⓘ</span>
      </label>
      ${model.showResampleNote
        ? html`<div class="publish-resample-note">Resample turned on to apply preset.</div>`
        : nothing}
    </div>
  `;
}
```

Create `packages/core/src/components/publish/sections/legend-section.ts`:

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import type { LegendLayout, LegendPosition } from '../publish-state';

interface LegendModel {
  legend: LegendLayout;
  dpi: number;
}

interface LegendHandlers {
  updateLegend(partial: Partial<LegendLayout>): void;
}

/** A range slider with its number box (and unit); both report through `onChange`. */
export function renderSliderInput(opts: {
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  value: number;
  unit?: string;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
}): TemplateResult {
  const { min, max, step, value, unit, onChange } = opts;
  const stepAttr = step ?? 1;
  const parse = step && step < 1 ? parseFloat : parseInt;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-input-group">
      <input
        type="range"
        class="publish-slider"
        min=${min}
        max=${max}
        step=${stepAttr}
        .value=${String(value)}
        @input=${(e: Event) => onChange(parse((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || value)}
      />
      <input
        type="number"
        class="publish-row-input"
        min=${min}
        max=${max}
        step=${stepAttr}
        .value=${String(value)}
        @change=${(e: Event) => onChange(parse((e.target as HTMLInputElement).value) || value)}
      />
      ${unit ? html`<span class="publish-unit">${unit}</span>` : nothing}
    </div>
  `;
}

/**
 * The legend font size in the unit the user edits. pt input keeps the float value so 8pt
 * round-trips as 8pt (rounding to integer px would clip 33.33 → 33 → 7.9pt); px input is
 * integer-only since that's what the user typed.
 */
function onFontChange(event: Event, model: LegendModel, handlers: LegendHandlers): void {
  const v = parseFloat((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(v) || v <= 0) return;
  const fontSizePx =
    model.legend.fontSizeUnit === 'pt'
      ? Math.max(0.1, (v / 72) * model.dpi)
      : Math.max(1, Math.round(v));
  handlers.updateLegend({ fontSizePx });
}

function renderFontInput(model: LegendModel, handlers: LegendHandlers) {
  const { fontSizePx, fontSizeUnit: unit } = model.legend;
  const isPt = unit === 'pt';
  const value = isPt ? ((fontSizePx / model.dpi) * 72).toFixed(1) : String(Math.round(fontSizePx));
  const min = isPt ? 1 : 8;
  const max = isPt ? 50 : 120;
  const step = isPt ? 0.5 : 1;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-input-group">
      <input
        type="range"
        class="publish-slider"
        min=${min}
        max=${max}
        step=${step}
        .value=${value}
        @input=${(e: Event) => onFontChange(e, model, handlers)}
      />
      <input
        type="number"
        class="publish-row-input"
        data-publish-input="legend-font"
        min=${min}
        max=${max}
        step=${step}
        .value=${value}
        @change=${(e: Event) => onFontChange(e, model, handlers)}
      />
      <select
        class="publish-select publish-unit-select"
        data-publish-input="legend-font-unit"
        .value=${unit}
        @change=${(e: Event) => {
          handlers.updateLegend({
            fontSizeUnit: (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as 'pt' | 'px',
          });
        }}
      >
        <option value="pt">pt</option>
        <option value="px">px</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  `;
}

/** Show legend, then (when shown) its position, size, font size and columns. */
export function renderLegendSection(model: LegendModel, handlers: LegendHandlers): TemplateResult {
  const leg = model.legend;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-section">
      <div class="publish-section-title">Legend</div>

      <label class="publish-checkbox-label">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          class="publish-checkbox"
          .checked=${leg.visible}
          @change=${(e: Event) => {
            handlers.updateLegend({ visible: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked });
          }}
        />
        Show legend
      </label>

      ${leg.visible
        ? html`
            <div class="publish-row">
              <label>Position</label>
              <select
                class="publish-select"
                .value=${leg.position}
                @change=${(e: Event) => {
                  handlers.updateLegend({
                    position: (e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value as LegendPosition,
                  });
                }}
              >
                <option value="right">Right</option>
                <option value="left">Left</option>
                <option value="top">Top</option>
                <option value="bottom">Bottom</option>
                <option value="free">Free (drag to move)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="publish-row">
              <label>Size %</label>
              ${renderSliderInput({
                min: 10,
                max: 100,
                value: leg.widthPercent,
                unit: '%',
                onChange: (v) => handlers.updateLegend({ widthPercent: v }),
              })}
            </div>

            <div class="publish-row">
              <label>Font size</label>
              ${renderFontInput(model, handlers)}
            </div>

            <div class="publish-row">
              <label>Columns</label>
              ${renderSliderInput({
                min: 1,
                max: 6,
                value: leg.columns,
                onChange: (v) => handlers.updateLegend({ columns: v }),
              })}
            </div>
          `
        : nothing}
    </div>
```

Create `packages/core/src/components/publish/sections/annotations-section.ts`:

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import type { Inset, Overlay } from '../publish-state';
import { renderSliderInput } from './legend-section';

type Selected = { kind: 'overlay' | 'inset'; index: number };

interface AnnotationsModel {
  overlays: readonly Overlay[];
  insets: readonly Inset[];
  selected: Selected | null;
}

interface AnnotationsHandlers {
  select(selected: Selected): void;
  removeOverlay(index: number): void;
  updateOverlay(index: number, partial: Partial<Overlay>): void;
  removeInset(index: number): void;
  updateInset(index: number, partial: Partial<Inset>): void;
}

function renderOverlayProps(a: Overlay, i: number, handlers: AnnotationsHandlers) {
  switch (a.type) {
    case 'circle':
      return html`
        <div class="publish-row" style="margin-bottom: 0;">
          <label>Stroke</label>
          ${renderSliderInput({
            min: 0.5,
            max: 10,
            step: 0.5,
            value: a.strokeWidth,
            unit: 'px',
            onChange: (v) => handlers.updateOverlay(i, { strokeWidth: v }),
          })}
        </div>
      `;
    case 'arrow':
      return html`
        <div class="publish-row" style="margin-bottom: 0;">
          <label>Stroke</label>
          ${renderSliderInput({
            min: 0.5,
            max: 10,
            step: 0.5,
            value: a.width,
            unit: 'px',
            onChange: (v) => handlers.updateOverlay(i, { width: v }),
          })}
        </div>
      `;
    case 'label':
      return html`
        <div class="publish-row" style="margin-bottom: 2px;">
          <label>Text</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            class="publish-row-input"
            style="width: 8rem; text-align: left;"
            .value=${a.text}
            @change=${(e: Event) => {
              handlers.updateOverlay(i, {
                text: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value || 'Label',
              });
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <div class="publish-row" style="margin-bottom: 0;">
          <label>Size</label>
          ${renderSliderInput({
            min: 8,
            max: 72,
            value: a.fontSize,
            unit: 'px',
            onChange: (v) => handlers.updateOverlay(i, { fontSize: v }),
          })}
        </div>
      `;
  }
}

function renderOverlays(model: AnnotationsModel, handlers: AnnotationsHandlers) {
  const anns = model.overlays;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-section">
      <div class="publish-section-title">Overlays (${anns.length})</div>
      ${anns.map((a, i) => {
        const isSel = model.selected?.kind === 'overlay' && model.selected.index === i;
        return html`
          <div
            class="publish-overlay-item ${isSel ? 'selected' : ''}"
            style="flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px;"
            data-publish-item="overlay-${i}"
            @click=${() => handlers.select({ kind: 'overlay', index: i })}
          >
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
              <span>${a.type}${a.type === 'label' ? `: ${a.text}` : ''}</span>
              <button
                class="delete-btn"
                @click=${(e: Event) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlers.removeOverlay(i);
                }}
                title="Remove"
              >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
              </button>
            </div>
            ${renderOverlayProps(a, i, handlers)}
          </div>
        `;
      })}
      ${anns.length === 0
        ? html`<span style="font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--muted)"
            >Use toolbar to add</span
          >`
        : nothing}
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderInsets(model: AnnotationsModel, handlers: AnnotationsHandlers) {
  const ins = model.insets;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-section">
      <div class="publish-section-title">Zoom Insets (${ins.length})</div>
      ${ins.map(
        (inset, i) => html`
          <div
            class="publish-overlay-item ${model.selected?.kind === 'inset' &&
            model.selected.index === i
              ? 'selected'
              : ''}"
            style="flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px;"
            data-publish-item="inset-${i}"
            @click=${() => handlers.select({ kind: 'inset', index: i })}
          >
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
              <span>Inset ${i + 1}</span>
              <button
                class="delete-btn"
                @click=${(e: Event) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlers.removeInset(i);
                }}
                title="Remove"
              >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="publish-row" style="margin-bottom: 0;">
              <label title="Dot size in the zoomed view, relative to the main plot. 1× matches.">
                Dot size
              </label>
              ${renderSliderInput({
                min: 0.5,
                max: 20,
                step: 0.1,
                value: Number((inset.pointSizeScale ?? 1).toFixed(1)),
                unit: '×',
                onChange: (v) => handlers.updateInset(i, { pointSizeScale: v }),
              })}
            </div>
            <div class="publish-row" style="margin-bottom: 0;">
              <label>Border</label>
              ${renderSliderInput({
                min: 0.5,
                max: 10,
                step: 0.5,
                value: inset.border,
                unit: 'px',
                onChange: (v) => handlers.updateInset(i, { border: v }),
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
      )}
      ${ins.length === 0
        ? html`<span style="font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--muted)"
            >Use toolbar to add</span
          >`
        : nothing}
    </div>
  `;
}

/** The overlays, then the zoom insets: each listed with its own controls and a delete button. */
export function renderAnnotations(
  model: AnnotationsModel,
  handlers: AnnotationsHandlers,
): TemplateResult {
  return html`${renderOverlays(model, handlers)} ${renderInsets(model, handlers)}`;
}
```

### Task 4.14: Figure editor as a full-screen dialog

The figure editor opens in a full-screen `ps-dialog` named "Figure editor": Escape closes it through the layer stack (after first deselecting a selected overlay or inset), focus stays inside, and its Cancel is renamed Close, which keeps the editor state as before (decisions 11, 15). New figure and Reset offer Undo inside the dialog, and an export failure shows there too, because a toast would sit under the modal. The figure's default legend title becomes the annotation's display name, the host passes the current projection, and the editor's styles move to tokens.

**Files:**

- Create: `packages/core/src/components/publish/sections/footer.ts`, `packages/core/src/components/publish/publish-modal.browser.test.ts`
- Modify: `publish-modal.ts`, `publish-modal.styles.ts` (tokens; `.publish-overlay` and the fixed overlay rules go; LEGACY line removed), `publish-modal.test.ts` (the Escape case moves to the browser test; jsdom stubs `HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal`/`close` for the cases that remain), `packages/core/src/components/kit/icon.ts` (`undo-2`), `packages/core/src/styles/style-lint.test.ts`
- Modify (native `title` attributes become `ps-tooltip`s, inline legacy `style` attributes become classes): `publish/sections/toolbar.ts`, `presets-options-section.ts`, `dimensions-section.ts`, `annotations-section.ts`
- Modify: `apps/web/src/explore/export-handler.ts` (`showExportError`, `currentProjection`); create `apps/web/src/explore/export-handler.publish.test.ts` (its own module mocks, so it does not depend on how Task 4.11's `export-handler.test.ts` mocks `@protspace/core`)
- Modify: `apps/web/src/workbench/shortcuts.ts` (Figure editor rows), `shortcuts.test.ts`

- Modify: `docs/developers/api/index.md` (a Figure Editor section: dialog, `showExportError`, `currentProjection`), `docs/explore/figure-editor.md` (three rows that would become false: Cancel, the backdrop click and the sidebar ×)

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: 4.13's section modules (`renderToolbar`, `renderPresets`, `renderOptions`, `renderDimensions`, `renderLegendSection`, `renderAnnotations`) and `InsetRenderCache`; 4.11's `createExportHandler({ exportMenu, listen, getSelectedProteins, getUnplacedProteinCount, legendElement, plotElement, notify })`, its `publish-state-store.ts` and its `publish-export` failure path; 4.11's e2e helper `exportAction(page, name)` (opens the Export menu and picks the item); 4.1's `_releaseEscapeLayer`/`_onEscapeLayer` (removed here); `ps-dialog` (`size="full"`, `heading`, `dismissible`, `ps-close`, `dismiss()`, footer slot), `ps-button`, `ps-tooltip`, `pushLayer` (`kit/layers.ts`), `icon` (`kit/icon.ts`); `annotationLabel`, `isEditableEventPath` (`@protspace/utils`); `_handleNewFigure`, `_handleReset`, `_handleClose`, `_handleExport`, `_applyStateAndRebuild`, `_updateState`, `_selectedItem`, `_setSelection`; `getExportFailureNotification` (`notifications.ts`).
- Produces:
  - Render: `<ps-dialog size="full" heading="Figure editor" open dismissible="false" @ps-close=${this._handleClose}>` holding the preview, toolbar and sections in the default slot and `renderFooter(model, handlers)` (`sections/footer.ts`, root `div.publish-footer[slot=footer]`): `ps-button variant="ghost"` "New figure", `ps-button variant="ghost"` "Reset", the status area, `ps-button variant="secondary"` "Close" (→ the dialog's `dismiss()`, whose `ps-close` runs `_handleClose`, which still dispatches `close` with `{ state }`), `ps-button variant="primary"` "Export". `.publish-overlay`, `_onOverlayClick`, the preview header's "Figure Editor" h2 and the sidebar header with its × go (the dialog has its heading and its own Close). The native `title` attributes become `ps-tooltip`s.
  - Escape: while `_selectedItem` is set the element holds a layer `{ close: () => <release, then _setSelection(null)>, elements: [this], dismissOnOutsidePress: false }`, released when the selection clears or the element disconnects; the 4.1 minimal layer and `_onEscapeLayer` go. With no selection, Escape closes the dialog (state kept).
  - Undo strip: `@state() _undo: { message: UndoMessage; state: PublishState } | null`, `export type UndoMessage = 'Overlays and insets cleared' | 'Settings reset'` (`footer.ts`); New figure and Reset record the state they replace; the footer's `div.publish-undo[role=status]` shows the message and `ps-button size="sm" variant="ghost"` "Undo" (`icon('undo-2', 14)`) → `_applyStateAndRebuild(state)`; cleared by any other state change (the next `_updateState` or any edit) or after 8 s.
  - `showExportError(message: string): void` — a `p.publish-export-error[role=alert]` in the footer, cleared on the next export attempt.
  - Default legend title: `annotationLabel(legendState.annotation, <the legend's data.annotations[that key]>)`. The publish state stores no title, so there is nothing a saved state could override.
  - `export-handler.ts`: on `publish-export` failure calls `modal.showExportError(<title and description of getExportFailureNotification(err)>)` instead of a toast; sets `modal.currentProjection = { projection: <plot's projection name>, dimensionality: <its dimension> }` (null with no data) when it creates the modal.
  - `shortcuts.ts`: Figure editor rows "Delete — Remove the selected overlay or inset" and "Escape — Deselect the overlay or inset, then close the editor".

**Tests:**

- `publish-modal.browser.test.ts`: "the dialog has role dialog named Figure editor and is modal"; "hovering the locked width field shows its reason" (a `ps-tooltip` replaced its native `title`); "Escape with an item selected deselects it and keeps the dialog open; a second Escape closes it and fires close with the state" (Review Focus 1); "a press on the backdrop does not close it"; "focus returns to the control that opened it"; "New figure, then Undo, restores overlays and insets"; "Reset, then Undo, restores the state"; "an edit after New figure removes the Undo strip"; "showExportError renders an alert, and the next export clears it"; "Delete still removes a selected overlay; Backspace in a number field edits the field".
- `publish-modal.test.ts`: remaining jsdom cases pass with the dialog stubs; "the default legend title is the display name".
- `export-handler.publish.test.ts`: "a publish-export failure calls showExportError and does not toast"; "the modal receives currentProjection".
- `shortcuts.test.ts`: "the Figure editor group lists Delete, then Escape that deselects before it closes".
- `style-lint.test.ts`: LEGACY one shorter (9 → 8).
- `wc -l publish-modal.ts` ≤ 800.
- E2E `figure-editor.spec.ts` passes (Export found by role and name; `openFigureEditor` unchanged); `workbench-import-export.spec.ts` "Escape closes the figure editor and the selection stays"; `workbench-escape.spec.ts` passes.

**Notes:**

- Keep `protspace-publish-modal` in the runtime's `isModalOpen` selector (`runtime.ts`, Task 4.6): after this task the editor's `ps-dialog` is in the element's shadow root, which `document.querySelector('ps-dialog[open]')` does not reach. Without it, a Ctrl+Z with focus on `<body>` would undo a plot step under the open editor.

```ts
  connector: 'lines',
  pointSizeScale: 1,
};

beforeAll(() => adoptTheme());
const cleanups: Array<() => void> = [];
afterEach(() => {
  while (cleanups.length) cleanups.pop()!();
  document.body.replaceChildren();
});

/** Opens the editor the way the app does: a control has focus, then the element is appended. */
async function mount() {
  const opener = document.createElement('button');
  opener.textContent = 'Open the editor';
  document.body.append(opener);
  opener.focus();
  const modal = document.createElement('protspace-publish-modal');
  document.body.append(modal);
  await modal.updateComplete;
  const dialog = modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-dialog') as PsDialog;
  await dialog.updateComplete;
  const native = dialog.shadowRoot!.querySelector('dialog')!;
  return { opener, modal, internals: modal as unknown as ModalInternals, native };
}

/** Escape where a user presses it: on the focused element, inside any shadow roots. */
function escape(): void {
  let active: Element | null = document.activeElement;
  while (active?.shadowRoot?.activeElement) active = active.shadowRoot.activeElement;
  (active ?? document.body).dispatchEvent(
    new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, composed: true, cancelable: true }),
  );
}

function button(modal: HTMLElement, name: string): HTMLElement {
  const found = [...modal.shadowRoot!.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('ps-button')].find(
    (each) => each.textContent?.trim() === name,
  );
  if (!found) throw new Error(`No "${name}" button in the editor`);
  return found;
}

const undoText = (modal: HTMLElement) =>
  modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.publish-undo')!.textContent!.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

describe('protspace-publish-modal dialog', () => {
  it('the dialog has role dialog named Figure editor and is modal', async () => {
    const { native } = await mount();
    expect(native.open).toBe(true);
    expect(native.matches(':modal')).toBe(true);
    const heading = native.getRootNode() as ShadowRoot;
    expect(heading.getElementById(native.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')!)!.textContent).toBe(
      'Figure editor',
    );
  });

  it('Escape with an item selected deselects it and keeps the dialog open; a second Escape closes it and fires close with the state', async () => {
    const fallback = vi.fn(() => true);
    cleanups.push(onEscapeFallback(ESCAPE_ORDER.selection, fallback));
    const { modal, internals, native } = await mount();
    internals._state = { ...internals._state, overlays: [circle] };
    internals._setSelection({ kind: 'overlay', index: 0 });
    await modal.updateComplete;
    const closed = vi.fn();
    modal.addEventListener('close', closed);

    escape();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._selectedItem).toBeNull();
    expect(internals._state.overlays).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(native.open).toBe(true);
    expect(closed).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    escape();
    expect(closed).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    const detail = (closed.mock.calls[0][0] as CustomEvent<{ state: { overlays: unknown[] } }>)
      .detail;
    expect(detail.state.overlays).toHaveLength(1);
    // Both presses were the editor's: the plot's selection fallback never ran.
    expect(fallback).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('a press on the backdrop does not close it', async () => {
    const { native } = await mount();
    native.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, composed: true }));
    native.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { bubbles: true, composed: true }));
    expect(native.open).toBe(true);
  });

  it('focus returns to the control that opened it', async () => {
    const { opener, modal } = await mount();
    escape();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(opener);
  });
});

describe('protspace-publish-modal undo', () => {
  it('New figure, then Undo, restores overlays and insets', async () => {
    const { modal, internals } = await mount();
    internals._state = { ...internals._state, overlays: [circle], insets: [inset] };
    await modal.updateComplete;

    button(modal, 'New figure').click();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._state.overlays).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(internals._state.insets).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.publish-undo')!.getAttribute('role')).toBe('status');
    expect(undoText(modal)).toBe('Overlays and insets cleared Undo');

    button(modal, 'Undo').click();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._state.overlays).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(internals._state.insets).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(undoText(modal)).toBe('');
  });

  it('Reset, then Undo, restores the state', async () => {
    const { modal, internals } = await mount();
    internals._state = { ...internals._state, dpi: 600 };
    await modal.updateComplete;

    button(modal, 'Reset').click();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._state.dpi).toBe(300);
    expect(undoText(modal)).toBe('Settings reset Undo');

    button(modal, 'Undo').click();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._state.dpi).toBe(600);
  });

  it('an edit after New figure removes the Undo strip', async () => {
    const { modal, internals } = await mount();
    internals._state = { ...internals._state, overlays: [circle] };
    await modal.updateComplete;
    button(modal, 'New figure').click();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(undoText(modal)).not.toBe('');

    internals._updateState({ background: 'transparent' });
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(undoText(modal)).toBe('');
  });
});

describe('protspace-publish-modal export and keys', () => {
  it('showExportError renders an alert, and the next export clears it', async () => {
    const { modal } = await mount();
    modal.showExportError('Export failed. The disk is full.');
    await modal.updateComplete;
    const alert = modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.publish-export-error')!;
    expect(alert.getAttribute('role')).toBe('alert');
    expect(alert.textContent!.trim()).toBe('Export failed. The disk is full.');

    button(modal, 'Export').click();
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.publish-export-error')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Delete still removes a selected overlay; Backspace in a number field edits the field', async () => {
    const { modal, internals } = await mount();
    internals._state = { ...internals._state, overlays: [circle] };
    internals._setSelection({ kind: 'overlay', index: 0 });
    await modal.updateComplete;

    const field = modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(
      '[data-publish-item="overlay-0"] input[type="number"]',
    )!;
    field.dispatchEvent(
      new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Backspace', bubbles: true, composed: true }),
    );
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._state.overlays).toHaveLength(1);

    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Delete' }));
    await modal.updateComplete;
    expect(internals._state.overlays).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(internals._selectedItem).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import '../../kit/button';
import { icon } from '../../kit/icon';
import '../../kit/tooltip';

/** What New figure and Reset say they did, beside their Undo. */
export type UndoMessage = 'Overlays and insets cleared' | 'Settings reset';

interface FooterModel {
  undo: UndoMessage | null;
  exportError: string | null;
  format: 'png' | 'pdf';
}

interface FooterHandlers {
  newFigure(): void;
  reset(): void;
  undo(): void;
  close(): void;
  exportFigure(): void;
}

/**
 * The dialog's footer: New figure and Reset, then what one of them just did (with Undo) or why an
 * export failed, then Close and Export. Feedback lives here, not in a toast: a toast would sit
 * under the modal dialog.
 */
export function renderFooter(model: FooterModel, handlers: FooterHandlers): TemplateResult {
  return html`
    <div class="publish-footer" slot="footer">
      <ps-button variant="ghost" @click=${handlers.newFigure}>New figure</ps-button>
      <ps-tooltip text="Clear overlays and insets, keep the layout"></ps-tooltip>
      <ps-button variant="ghost" @click=${handlers.reset}>Reset</ps-button>
      <ps-tooltip text="Reset every setting to its default"></ps-tooltip>
      <div class="publish-footer-status">
        ${model.exportError
          ? html`<p class="publish-export-error" role="alert">${model.exportError}</p>`
          : nothing}
        <div class="publish-undo" role="status">
          ${model.undo
            ? html`<span>${model.undo}</span>
                <ps-button size="sm" variant="ghost" @click=${handlers.undo}
                  ><span slot="start" class="publish-undo-icon">${icon('undo-2', 14)}</span
                  >Undo</ps-button
                >`
            : nothing}
        </div>
      </div>
      <ps-button variant="secondary" @click=${handlers.close}>Close</ps-button>
      <ps-button variant="primary" @click=${handlers.exportFigure}>Export</ps-button>
      <ps-tooltip text=${`Export ${model.format.toUpperCase()}`}></ps-tooltip>
    </div>
  `;
}
```

```ts
  override willUpdate(changed: Map<string, unknown>) {
    if (changed.has('legendElement')) {
      this._readLegend();
    }
    // Any state but the one New figure or Reset produced is an edit after it: Undo would lose it.
    if (changed.has('_state') && this._undo && this._state !== this._undoAfter) {
      this._dropUndo();
    }
  }

  override updated(changed: Map<string, unknown>) {
    if (changed.has('_state') || changed.has('_tool') || changed.has('_selectedItem')) {
      this._scheduleRedraw();
    }
    if (changed.has('_selectedItem')) this._syncSelectionLayer();
  }

  /** While an overlay or inset is selected, Escape deselects it; the next Escape closes. */
  private _syncSelectionLayer() {
    if (this._selectedItem && !this._releaseSelectionLayer && this.isConnected) {
      this._releaseSelectionLayer = pushLayer({
        close: () => {
          this._releaseSelectionLayer?.();
          this._releaseSelectionLayer = null;
          this._setSelection(null);
        },
        elements: [this],
        dismissOnOutsidePress: false,
      });
    } else if (!this._selectedItem && this._releaseSelectionLayer) {
      this._releaseSelectionLayer();
      this._releaseSelectionLayer = null;
    }
  }
```

```ts
  private _handleReset() {
    const before = this._state;
    const state = createDefaultPublishState();
    this._applyStateAndRebuild({
      ...state,
      viewFingerprint: this.currentProjection ?? undefined,
    });
    this._offerUndo('Settings reset', before);
  }

  private _handleNewFigure() {
    const before = this._state;
    this._applyStateAndRebuild({
      ...this._state,
      overlays: [],
      insets: [],
      viewFingerprint: this.currentProjection ?? undefined,
    });
    this._offerUndo('Overlays and insets cleared', before);
  }

  /** Shows what New figure or Reset did, with Undo, until the next edit or for 8 s. */
  private _offerUndo(message: UndoMessage, before: PublishState) {
    if (this._undoTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this._undoTimer);
    this._undo = { message, state: before };
    this._undoAfter = this._state;
    this._undoTimer = setTimeout(() => this._dropUndo(), 8_000);
  }

  private _dropUndo() {
    if (this._undoTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this._undoTimer);
    this._undoTimer = null;
    this._undo = null;
    this._undoAfter = null;
  }

  private _undoLast() {
    const undo = this._undo;
    if (!undo) return;
    this._dropUndo();
    this._applyStateAndRebuild(undo.state);
  }

  /** Says inside the dialog why an export failed; the next export attempt clears it. */
  showExportError(message: string): void {
    this._exportError = message;
  }
```
