```ts
    .publish-select {
      padding: var(--ps-space-0-5) var(--ps-space-1-5);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border-control);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: var(--ps-surface);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .publish-checkbox-label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-1);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .publish-checkbox {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      accent-color: var(--ps-accent);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .publish-format-toggle {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
    }

    .publish-format-toggle .publish-toggle-btn {
      flex: 1;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .publish-slider {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 60px;
      height: 4px;
      accent-color: var(--ps-accent);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* ─── Overlay and inset rows ─────────────────────────────── */
    .publish-overlay-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-1);
      padding: var(--ps-space-1) var(--ps-space-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ps-border);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      color: var(--ps-text);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .publish-overlay-item:hover {
      background: var(--ps-surface-hover);
      border-color: var(--ps-border-strong);
    }

    .publish-overlay-item.selected {
      background: var(--ps-accent-tint);
      border-color: var(--ps-accent);
    }

    .publish-item-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .publish-overlay-item .delete-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      padding: 0;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius-sm);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .publish-overlay-item .delete-btn:hover {
      background: var(--ps-surface-hover);
      color: var(--ps-danger);
    }

    .publish-empty-hint {
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
    }

    .publish-warning {
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-2);
      padding: var(--ps-space-1) var(--ps-space-2);
      border-radius: var(--ps-radius);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ps-danger) 8%, transparent);
      color: var(--ps-danger);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
    }

    .publish-warning a {
      color: var(--ps-danger);
      font-weight: var(--ps-weight-semibold);
      text-decoration: underline;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* ─── Dimensions (Photoshop-style) ───────────────────────── */
    .publish-dim-readout {
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-2);
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
    }

    .publish-dim-readout strong {
      margin: 0 var(--ps-space-1);
      color: var(--ps-text);
    }

    .publish-dim-pair {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1-5) var(--ps-space-2);
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-2);
    }

    .publish-dim-pair > .publish-dim-label {
      grid-column: 1;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .publish-dim-pair > .publish-dim-control {
      grid-column: 2;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1-5);
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .publish-dim-control > .publish-slider {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 50px;
    }

    .publish-dim-value {
      width: 3.5rem;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .publish-dim-pair > .publish-aspect-lock {
      grid-column: 3;
      grid-row: 1 / span 2;
      align-self: stretch;
    }

    .publish-dim-pair > .publish-unit-select {
      grid-column: 4;
      grid-row: 1 / span 2;
      align-self: center;
    }

    .publish-unit-select {
      width: 64px;
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock svg {
      display: block;
      overflow: visible;
      fill: none;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }

    /* Brackets: thin muted lines anchoring the chain to the Width and Height rows. */
    .publish-aspect-lock .aspect-lock-bracket {
      stroke: var(--ps-text-muted);
      stroke-width: 1.25;
    }

    /* The chain: a heavier stroke than the brackets, so the link reads as the focal point. */
    .publish-aspect-lock .aspect-lock-state-locked,
    .publish-aspect-lock .aspect-lock-state-unlocked {
      display: none;
      stroke: var(--ps-text-muted);
      stroke-width: 1.75;
      transition: stroke var(--ps-duration-fast) var(--ps-ease);
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock.locked .aspect-lock-state-locked {
      display: inline;
      stroke: var(--ps-accent);
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock:not(.locked) .aspect-lock-state-unlocked {
      display: inline;
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock:hover:not([disabled]) .aspect-lock-state-locked,
    .publish-aspect-lock:hover:not([disabled]) .aspect-lock-state-unlocked {
      stroke: var(--ps-accent);
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock[disabled] {
      cursor: not-allowed;
      opacity: 0.4;
    }

    .publish-aspect-lock[disabled] .aspect-lock-state-locked,
    .publish-aspect-lock[disabled] .aspect-lock-state-unlocked,
    .publish-aspect-lock[disabled] .aspect-lock-bracket {
      stroke: var(--ps-text-muted);
    }

    .publish-dim-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: var(--ps-space-1);
    }

    .publish-dim-row label {
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
    }

    .publish-info {
      display: inline-flex;
      margin-left: var(--ps-space-1);
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      cursor: help;
    }

    .publish-resample-note {
      margin-top: var(--ps-space-1);
      color: var(--ps-accent-text);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-xs);
    }

    /* ─── Footer (slotted into the dialog's footer) ──────────── */
    .publish-footer {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-2);
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .publish-footer-status {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: var(--ps-space-3);
      min-width: 0;
      color: var(--ps-text-muted);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
    }

    .publish-undo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--ps-space-1);
    }

    .publish-undo-icon {
      display: inline-flex;
    }

    .publish-export-error {
      margin: 0;
      min-width: 0;
      color: var(--ps-danger);
      font-size: var(--ps-text-sm);
    }

    @media (max-width: 800px) {
      .publish-container {
        flex-direction: column;
      }
      .publish-sidebar {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        max-width: none;
        max-height: 45vh;
      }
    }
  `,
];
```

The input is disabled while locked: current Chromium and Firefox still dispatch pointer events (not clicks) to a disabled form control, so hover shows the tooltip, and `ps-tooltip` puts its text in the input's `aria-describedby`, so assistive technology reads the reason although the field cannot take focus.     internals._updateState({ preset: 'nature-1col' });
```ts
    await modal.updateComplete;
    const input = modal.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-publish-input="width"]')!;
    expect(input.disabled).toBe(true);
    const tooltip = input.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement;
    expect(tooltip.localName).toBe('ps-tooltip');

    await userEvent.hover(input);
    await expect
      .poll(() => tooltip.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.tip')?.matches(':popover-open'))
      .toBe(true);
  });
```

Replace the whole of `packages/core/src/components/publish/sections/annotations-section.ts` with:

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { icon } from '../../kit/icon';
import '../../kit/tooltip';
import type { Inset, Overlay } from '../publish-state';
import { renderSliderInput } from './legend-section';

type Selected = { kind: 'overlay' | 'inset'; index: number };

interface AnnotationsModel {
  overlays: readonly Overlay[];
  insets: readonly Inset[];
  selected: Selected | null;
}

interface AnnotationsHandlers {
  select(selected: Selected): void;
  removeOverlay(index: number): void;
  updateOverlay(index: number, partial: Partial<Overlay>): void;
  removeInset(index: number): void;
  updateInset(index: number, partial: Partial<Inset>): void;
}

/** A row's ✕: removes that item whether or not it is selected, and does not select it. */
function removeButton(onRemove: () => void) {
  return html`
    <button
      type="button"
      class="delete-btn"
      aria-label="Remove"
      @click=${(e: Event) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onRemove();
      }}
    >
      ${icon('x', 14)}
    </button>
    <ps-tooltip text="Remove" names-target></ps-tooltip>
  `;
}

function renderOverlayProps(a: Overlay, i: number, handlers: AnnotationsHandlers) {
  switch (a.type) {
    case 'circle':
      return html`
        <div class="publish-row publish-row-tight">
          <label>Stroke</label>
          ${renderSliderInput({
            min: 0.5,
            max: 10,
            step: 0.5,
            value: a.strokeWidth,
            unit: 'px',
            onChange: (v) => handlers.updateOverlay(i, { strokeWidth: v }),
          })}
        </div>
      `;
    case 'arrow':
      return html`
        <div class="publish-row publish-row-tight">
          <label>Stroke</label>
          ${renderSliderInput({
            min: 0.5,
            max: 10,
            step: 0.5,
            value: a.width,
            unit: 'px',
            onChange: (v) => handlers.updateOverlay(i, { width: v }),
          })}
        </div>
      `;
    case 'label':
      return html`
        <div class="publish-row publish-row-text">
          <label>Text</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            class="publish-row-input publish-label-input"
            .value=${a.text}
            @change=${(e: Event) => {
              handlers.updateOverlay(i, {
                text: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value || 'Label',
              });
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <div class="publish-row publish-row-tight">
          <label>Size</label>
          ${renderSliderInput({
            min: 8,
            max: 72,
            value: a.fontSize,
            unit: 'px',
            onChange: (v) => handlers.updateOverlay(i, { fontSize: v }),
          })}
        </div>
      `;
  }
}

function renderOverlays(model: AnnotationsModel, handlers: AnnotationsHandlers) {
  const anns = model.overlays;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-section">
      <div class="publish-section-title">Overlays (${anns.length})</div>
      ${anns.map((a, i) => {
        const isSel = model.selected?.kind === 'overlay' && model.selected.index === i;
        return html`
          <div
            class="publish-overlay-item ${isSel ? 'selected' : ''}"
            data-publish-item="overlay-${i}"
            @click=${() => handlers.select({ kind: 'overlay', index: i })}
          >
            <div class="publish-item-head">
              <span>${a.type}${a.type === 'label' ? `: ${a.text}` : ''}</span>
              ${removeButton(() => handlers.removeOverlay(i))}
            </div>
            ${renderOverlayProps(a, i, handlers)}
          </div>
        `;
      })}
      ${anns.length === 0
        ? html`<span class="publish-empty-hint">Use toolbar to add</span>`
        : nothing}
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderInsets(model: AnnotationsModel, handlers: AnnotationsHandlers) {
  const ins = model.insets;
  return html`
    <div class="publish-section">
      <div class="publish-section-title">Zoom Insets (${ins.length})</div>
      ${ins.map(
        (inset, i) => html`
          <div
            class="publish-overlay-item ${model.selected?.kind === 'inset' &&
            model.selected.index === i
              ? 'selected'
              : ''}"
            data-publish-item="inset-${i}"
            @click=${() => handlers.select({ kind: 'inset', index: i })}
          >
            <div class="publish-item-head">
              <span>Inset ${i + 1}</span>
              ${removeButton(() => handlers.removeInset(i))}
            </div>
            <div class="publish-row publish-row-tight">
              <label>Dot size</label>
              <ps-tooltip
                text="Dot size in the zoomed view, relative to the main plot. 1× matches."
              ></ps-tooltip>
              ${renderSliderInput({
                min: 0.5,
                max: 20,
                step: 0.1,
                value: Number((inset.pointSizeScale ?? 1).toFixed(1)),
                unit: '×',
                onChange: (v) => handlers.updateInset(i, { pointSizeScale: v }),
              })}
            </div>
            <div class="publish-row publish-row-tight">
              <label>Border</label>
              ${renderSliderInput({
                min: 0.5,
                max: 10,
                step: 0.5,
                value: inset.border,
                unit: 'px',
                onChange: (v) => handlers.updateInset(i, { border: v }),
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
      )}
      ${ins.length === 0
        ? html`<span class="publish-empty-hint">Use toolbar to add</span>`
        : nothing}
    </div>
  `;
}

/** The overlays, then the zoom insets: each listed with its own controls and a remove button. */
export function renderAnnotations(
  model: AnnotationsModel,
  handlers: AnnotationsHandlers,
): TemplateResult {
  return html`${renderOverlays(model, handlers)} ${renderInsets(model, handlers)}`;
}
```

```ts
// jsdom 27 has no HTMLDialogElement.showModal or close. The editor's ps-dialog only needs the
// calls to exist here; what the dialog does is pinned in publish-modal.browser.test.ts.
beforeAll(() => {
  const proto = HTMLDialogElement.prototype as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  proto.showModal ??= function (this: HTMLDialogElement) {
    this.setAttribute('open', '');
  };
  proto.close ??= function (this: HTMLDialogElement) {
    this.removeAttribute('open');
  };
});
```

```ts
  });
  await listeners.get('open-publish-editor')!(new Event('open-publish-editor'));
  return { modal, notify };
}

const plot = {
  data: { projections: [{ name: 'PCA 2' }, { name: 'UMAP 3', dimension: 3 }] },
  selectedProjectionIndex: 1,
};

describe('figure editor host', () => {
  it('the modal receives currentProjection', async () => {
    const { modal } = await openEditor(plot);
    expect(modal.currentProjection).toEqual({ projection: 'UMAP 3', dimensionality: 3 });

    const empty = await openEditor({ data: null, selectedProjectionIndex: 0 });
    expect(empty.modal.currentProjection).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a publish-export failure calls showExportError and does not toast', async () => {
    const { modal, notify } = await openEditor(plot);
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    // A canvas that cannot produce a PNG blob: the export throws before anything downloads.
    const canvas = { width: 10, height: 10, toBlob: (done: (b: Blob | null) => void) => done(null) };

    modal.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('publish-export', {
        detail: { canvas, state: { format: 'png', dpi: 300 } },
      }),
    );

    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(modal.showExportError).toHaveBeenCalledOnce());
    expect(modal.showExportError.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatch(
      /^Export failed\. canvas\.toBlob produced no blob/,
    );
    expect(notify.error).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(modal.remove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

(If Task 4.11's `export-handler.ts` imports another value from `@protspace/core`, add it to the factory above. `getErrorMessage` in `notifications.ts` returns an `Error`'s message, which is what the description holds.)

```md
### Figure Editor

`<protspace-publish-modal>`, loaded on demand from `@protspace/core/publish`, is the figure editor.
It opens as a full-screen modal dialog named "Figure editor" as soon as it is connected, so the host
appends it to open it and removes it on `close`. Escape first deselects a selected overlay or inset,
then closes the dialog; a press on the backdrop never closes it. Close, the dialog's ✕ and Escape keep
the editor's state. New figure and Reset offer Undo in the footer until the next edit.

| Property            | Type                                                    | Description                                                          |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `plotElement`       | `HTMLElement \| null`                                   | The plot it renders from                                             |
| `legendElement`     | `HTMLElement \| null`                                   | The legend it reads; its annotation's display name titles the legend |
| `savedPublishState` | `Record<string, unknown> \| null`                       | A stored state to start from                                         |
| `currentProjection` | `{ projection: string; dimensionality: number } \| null` | Set before connecting; warns when overlays were placed on another    |

Method: `showExportError(message)` shows why an export failed inside the dialog (a toast would sit
under it); the next export attempt clears it.

| Event            | Detail              | Description                                  |
| ---------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `publish-export` | `{ canvas, state }` | Export pressed; the host writes the file     |
| `close`          | `{ state }`         | Closed by Close, ✕ or Escape; save the state |
```

### Task 4.15: Structure: pick which selected protein to show; links reachable everywhere

With several proteins selected, the structure header lists them and the user picks which one to show, instead of always the last (decision 15); a selection change keeps the shown protein while it stays selected. The resource links (AlphaFold, UniProt, InterPro, TED) get their own wrapping row under the header, reachable by mouse in the 240 px sidebar and the 280 px floating card, and the pinned tooltip lists them too, since it is the only surface while the structure waits behind a collapsed sidebar.

```ts
    // The menu marks its anchor once it has updated with it.
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(pick.getAttribute('aria-haspopup')).toBe('menu'));
    // Items render only while the menu is open.
    expect(items(viewer)).toHaveLength(0);
    const changed = vi.fn();
    viewer.addEventListener('structure-protein-change', changed);

    await open(viewer);
    expect(items(viewer).map((item) => item.textContent!.trim())).toEqual([
      'P11111',
      'P12345',
      'P22222',
    ]);
    expect(items(viewer).map((item) => item.checked)).toEqual([false, true, false]);

    items(viewer)[2].click();
    await viewer.updateComplete;
    expect(viewer.proteinId).toBe('P22222');
    expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect((changed.mock.calls[0][0] as CustomEvent).detail).toEqual({ proteinId: 'P22222' });
    await vi.waitFor(() =>
      expect(pickButton(viewer).getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false'),
    );
    expect(items(viewer)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('the menu renders at most 50 items and says how many were left out', async () => {
    const viewer = await mount();
    const choices = ids(120);
    viewer.proteinChoices = choices;
    viewer.proteinId = choices[100];
    await viewer.updateComplete;
    expect(pickButton(viewer).getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe(
      `Structure protein: ${choices[100]}, choose from 120 selected`,
    );

    await open(viewer);
    const shown = items(viewer);
    expect(shown).toHaveLength(MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES + 1);
    expect(shown.slice(0, MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES).map((item) => item.textContent!.trim())).toEqual(
      choices.slice(0, MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES),
    );
    // The shown protein is always offered, checked, after the first 50.
    expect(shown[MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES].textContent!.trim()).toBe(choices[100]);
    expect(shown[MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES].checked).toBe(true);
    expect(viewer.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-menu-label')!.textContent!.trim()).toBe(
      'First 50 of 120 selected',
    );
  });

  it('the menu is searchable above 8 choices', async () => {
    const viewer = await mount();
    viewer.proteinChoices = ids(8);
    viewer.proteinId = ids(8)[0];
    await viewer.updateComplete;
    const menu = viewer.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-menu')!;
    expect(menu.searchable).toBe(false);

    viewer.proteinChoices = ids(9);
    await viewer.updateComplete;
    expect(menu.searchable).toBe(true);
    await open(viewer);
    expect(menu.shadowRoot!.querySelector('input[type="search"]')).not.toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { TooltipView } from '@protspace/utils';
import { adoptTheme } from '../../kit/adopt-theme';
import './protein-tooltip';

const VIEW: TooltipView = {
  proteinId: 'P12345',
  geneName: [],
  proteinName: [],
  uniprotKbId: [],
  blocks: [],
};

beforeAll(() => adoptTheme());
afterEach(() => document.body.replaceChildren());

/** A tooltip as the plot renders it: hover-visible, or pinned with its links. */
async function mount(pinned: boolean) {
  const tooltip = document.createElement('protspace-protein-tooltip');
  tooltip.view = VIEW;
  tooltip.links = pinned;
  tooltip.className = pinned ? 'visible pinned' : 'visible';
  document.body.append(tooltip);
  await tooltip.updateComplete;
  return tooltip;
}

describe('protspace-protein-tooltip links', () => {
  it('a pinned tooltip lists the resource links; a hover tooltip does not', async () => {
    const pinned = await mount(true);
    const links = Array.from(
      pinned.shadowRoot!.querySelectorAll<HTMLAnchorElement>('.tooltip-links a.header-link'),
    );
    expect(links.map((link) => link.querySelector('.header-link-label')!.textContent)).toEqual([
      'AlphaFold',
      'UniProt',
      'InterPro',
      'TED',
    ]);
    // The pinned tooltip takes the pointer, so its last link can be pressed.
    const ted = links[3].getBoundingClientRect();
    const hit = pinned.shadowRoot!.elementFromPoint(
      ted.left + ted.width / 2,
      ted.top + ted.height / 2,
    );
    expect(hit?.closest('a')).toBe(links[3]);

    pinned.remove();
    const hover = await mount(false);
    expect(hover.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.resource-links')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * A protein's external resources as one row that wraps rather than clips in a narrow host: the
 * structure viewer draws it under its header, a pinned plot tooltip above its buttons. Hosts add
 * `resourceLinkStyles`. Each link opens in a new tab and says so to assistive technology.
 */
export function renderResourceLinks(proteinId: string): TemplateResult {
  return html`<ul class="resource-links" part="links" role="list" aria-label="External resources">
    ${RESOURCE_LINKS.map(
      (resource) =>
        html`<li class="resource-links-item">
          <a
            class="header-link"
            href=${resource.build(proteinId)}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            ><span class="header-link-label">${resource.label}</span>${icon('external-link', 14)}<span
              class="resource-links-hint"
            > (opens in a new tab)</span
          ></a>
        </li>`,
    )}
  </ul>`;
}
```

6. Delete `_resetLinksScroll` with its comment ("Focus scrolls a clipped link into the one-line list; …"). After `_handleClose()`, add:

```ts
  private _togglePick = () => {
    this._pickOpen = !this._pickOpen;
  };

  private _onPickClose = (event: Event) => {
    // The menu's own events stay inside; the viewer's is structure-protein-change.
    event.stopPropagation();
    this._pickOpen = false;
  };

  private _onPick = (event: Event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const { value } = (event as CustomEvent<{ value: string }>).detail;
    this._pickOpen = false;
    if (!value || value === this.proteinId) return;
    this.proteinId = value;
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('structure-protein-change', {
        detail: createStructureProteinChangeDetail(value),
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  };

  /** The id, or with several selected proteins a button that opens the menu of them. */
  private _renderProteinId(proteinId: string) {
    const count = this.proteinChoices.length;
    if (count <= 1) return html`<span class="protein-id">${proteinId}</span>`;
    return html`<button
        type="button"
        class="protein-id protein-pick"
        aria-label=${`Structure protein: ${proteinId}, choose from ${formatCount(count)} selected`}
        @click=${this._togglePick}
      >
        <span>${proteinId}</span>${icon('chevron-down', 14)}
      </button>
      <ps-menu
        class="protein-menu"
        label="Selected proteins"
        search-placeholder="Search selected proteins"
        .open=${this._pickOpen}
        ?searchable=${count > SEARCHABLE_CHOICES}
        @ps-select=${this._onPick}
        @ps-close=${this._onPickClose}
        >${this._pickOpen ? this._renderChoices(proteinId) : nothing}</ps-menu
      >`;
  }

  /**
   * The first 50 selected proteins in selection order, plus the shown one. A selection can hold
   * hundreds of thousands, so only these render, and only while the menu is open.
   */
  private _renderChoices(shown: string) {
    const all = this.proteinChoices;
    const first = all.length > MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES ? all.slice(0, MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES) : all;
    const offered = first.includes(shown) ? first : [...first, shown];
    return html`${all.length > MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES
      ? html`<ps-menu-label
          >First ${MAX_STRUCTURE_CHOICES} of ${formatCount(all.length)} selected</ps-menu-label
        >`
      : nothing}${offered.map(
      (id) =>
        html`<ps-menu-item type="radio" value=${id} .checked=${id === shown}>${id}</ps-menu-item>`,
    )}`;
  }
```

```ts
  /**
   * The selection changed: offer its proteins in the header and choose which one shows. A single
   * protein added to the selection shows; else the shown (or waiting) one stays while it is still
   * selected; else the selection's last. An empty selection only clears the offer.
   */
  select(proteinIds: readonly string[]): void;
```

and change the `clear()` comment to "Forgets the protein and the choices (a new dataset). Closes the viewer only if it holds one."

3. Before `export function createStructureController`, add:

```ts
/**
 * The one protein `next` adds to `previous`, or null when it adds none or several, or drops one.
 * Lengths are compared first, and an appended protein (a ⌘-click) needs no set, so a large
 * selection change costs a length check.
 */
function singleAddition(previous: readonly string[], next: readonly string[]): string | null {
  if (next.length !== previous.length + 1) return null;
  if (previous.every((id, index) => next[index] === id)) return next[next.length - 1];
  const known = new Set(previous);
  let added: string | null = null;
  for (const id of next) {
    if (known.has(id)) continue;
    if (added !== null) return null;
    added = id;
  }
  return added;
}
```

4. After `let waiting: string | null = null;`, add:

```ts
  // The selection the header offers, as select() last received it.
  let choices: readonly string[] = [];
```

after the `request` function, add:

```ts
  const select = (proteinIds: readonly string[]) => {
    const previous = choices;
    choices = proteinIds;
    viewer.proteinChoices = proteinIds;
    if (proteinIds.length === 0) return;
    const added = singleAddition(previous, proteinIds);
    if (added !== null) {
      request(added);
      return;
    }
    const shown = waiting ?? viewer.proteinId;
    if (shown !== null && proteinIds.includes(shown)) return;
    request(proteinIds[proteinIds.length - 1]);
  };
  // The user picked another selected protein in the header; the viewer is loading it.
  const onProteinChange = (event: Event) => {
    waiting = null;
    publish((event as CustomEvent<StructureProteinChangeDetail>).detail.proteinId);
  };
```

```ts
  page,

});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { adoptTheme } from '../kit/adopt-theme';
import type { ProtspaceAnnotationSelect } from './annotation-select';
import './annotation-select';

beforeAll(() => adoptTheme());
afterEach(() => document.body.replaceChildren());

/** The picker inside a box that clips and transforms, as the view bar's narrow stages can. */
async function openInClippingBox(): Promise<ProtspaceAnnotationSelect> {
  document.body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="clip" style="overflow: hidden; transform: translateX(0); width: 220px; height: 40px">
      <protspace-annotation-select></protspace-annotation-select>
    </div>`;
  const el = document.querySelector('protspace-annotation-select')!;
  el.annotations = ['ec', 'pfam', 'gene_name'];
  el.selectedAnnotation = 'pfam';
  el.eatAnnotations = ['ec'];
  await el.updateComplete;
  el.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.dropdown-trigger')!.click();
  await el.updateComplete;
  const popover = el.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-popover')!;
  await vi.waitFor(() =>
    expect(popover.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.panel')!.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(true),
  );
  return el;
}

describe('protspace-annotation-select panel', () => {
  it('the panel is topmost and an ⓘ bubble inside it is not clipped', async () => {
    const el = await openInClippingBox();
    const row = el.shadowRoot!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.dropdown-item[data-annotation="ec"]')!;
    const box = row.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clip = document.querySelector('.clip')!.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Below the clipping box, and still the element a press there reaches.
    expect(box.top).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(clip.bottom);
    const hit = el.shadowRoot!.elementFromPoint(box.left + 12, box.top + box.height / 2);

    const bubble = info.shadowRoot!.querySelector('ps-popover')!;
    const panel = () => bubble.shadowRoot!.querySelector('.panel') as HTMLElement;
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(panel().matches(':popover-open')).toBe(true));
    const rect = panel().getBoundingClientRect();
    expect(rect.left).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(rect.top).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(rect.right).toBeLessThanOrEqual(window.innerWidth);
    expect(rect.bottom).toBeLessThanOrEqual(window.innerHeight);
```

```ts
import { html, nothing, type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { annotationLabel, isPredictedAnnotation, type Annotation } from '@protspace/utils';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';

/**
 * The predicted mark (Lucide sparkles, as the legend header draws it) for a predicted annotation,
 * or nothing. Two annotations can share a label ("Subcellular location" is both a UniProt and a
 * Biocentral column), so every place that names an annotation carries it, and its name,
 * "Predicted annotation", joins the name of whatever holds it.
 */
export function predictedMark(column: string): TemplateResult | typeof nothing {
  return isPredictedAnnotation(column)
    ? html`<span class="predicted-badge" role="img" aria-label="Predicted annotation"
        >${icon('sparkles', 14)}</span
      >`
    : nothing;
}

/**
 * An annotation as the reader sees it: its friendly label, then its predicted
 * mark. The column name stays the key; this only draws it.
 *
 * `labelClass` places the label in its host — `dropdown-item-label` in a list
 * row, `dropdown-trigger-text` on a trigger button — so the text truncates
 * without taking the mark with it.
 */
export function renderAnnotationName(
  column: string,
  definition: Pick<Annotation, 'runtime'> | undefined,
  labelClass: 'dropdown-item-label' | 'dropdown-trigger-text',
): TemplateResult {
  return html`<span class=${labelClass}>${annotationLabel(column, definition)}</span
    >${predictedMark(column)}`;
}
```

Replace the whole of `packages/core/src/components/annotation-select/annotation-select.ts` with:

```ts
import { LitElement, html, nothing, type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { property, query, state } from 'lit/decorators.js';
import {
  annotationStatSummary,
  clusterAgreement,
  getAnnotationMeta,
  hasAnnotationStats,
  type Annotation,
  type ProjectionStatisticRow,
} from '@protspace/utils';
import { AfterPaintCommit } from '../../utils/after-paint-commit';
import { handleListboxKeydown, scrollHighlightedIntoView } from '../../utils/dropdown-helpers';
import { customElement } from '../../utils/safe-custom-element';
import {
  filterGroupedAnnotations,
  flattenGroupedAnnotations,
  type GroupedAnnotation,
} from '../common/annotation-categories';
import { predictedMark, renderAnnotationName } from '../common/annotation-name';
import '../common/info-popover';
import { icon } from '../kit/icon';
import '../kit/popover';
import type { PsPopover } from '../kit/popover';
import '../kit/tooltip';
import { annotationSelectStyles } from './annotation-select.styles';

const LISTBOX_ID = 'annotation-listbox';
const HINT_ID = 'annotation-search-hint';
const TOGGLE_HINT = 'Shift+Enter shows or hides the highlighted annotation in the hover tooltip';
const EAT_NOTE = 'EAT predictions available.';
const STATS_NOTE =
  'Quality statistics available: select this annotation and open the projection details.';

const optionId = (index: number) => `annotation-option-${index}`;

/**
 * The view bar's Color by picker (design decision 9): a searchable, grouped listbox of
 * annotations, each row with its hover-tooltip toggle beside it. A pick shows at once and reaches
 * listeners as `annotation-change` after the next paint, because recolouring re-stages every
 * point; `applySelection` applies at once. The list opens in a ps-popover, so it sits in the top
 * layer and Escape and a press outside close it before anything else.
 *
 * The rows stay this element's own listbox rather than a ps-menu: each row carries an eye toggle
 * and an ⓘ, which cannot sit inside a menu item, and the search matches only the labels shown.
 *
 * @fires annotation-change - `{ annotation }`: the colouring annotation changed.
 * @fires tooltip-annotations-change - `{ tooltipAnnotations }`: the tooltip's extras changed.
 */
@customElement('protspace-annotation-select')
export class ProtspaceAnnotationSelect extends LitElement {
  static styles = annotationSelectStyles;

  @property({ type: Array }) annotations: string[] = [];
  @property({ type: Object }) annotationDefinitions: Record<string, Pick<Annotation, 'runtime'>> =
    {};
  @property({ type: Array }) eatAnnotations: string[] = [];
  @property({ type: String, attribute: 'selected-annotation' }) selectedAnnotation: string = '';
  @property({ type: Array }) tooltipAnnotations: string[] = [];
  @property({ type: String }) placeholder: string = 'Select annotation';
  /** The key shown before the value; part of the trigger's accessible name. */
  @property({ type: String }) label: string = 'Color by';
  /** Rows of the bundle's optional statistics part; empty when it was prepared without `--stats`. */
  @property({ type: Array }) statisticsRows: readonly ProjectionStatisticRow[] = [];
  /** Projection the statistics are reported for; statistics are scored per projection. */
  @property({ type: String, attribute: 'selected-projection' }) selectedProjection: string = '';

  @state() private open: boolean = false;
  @state() private query: string = '';
  @state() private highlightIndex: number = -1;
  /** A pick waiting for its commit after the next paint; the trigger shows it until then. */
  @state() private pending: string | null = null;

  @query('.dropdown-trigger') private trigger!: HTMLButtonElement;
  @query('ps-popover') private popoverEl!: PsPopover;
  private readonly commit = new AfterPaintCommit();

  /**
   * Makes `annotation` the colouring now, drops a pick still waiting, and tells listeners. The
   * new primary is implicitly in the tooltip, so it then leaves the extras.
   */
  applySelection(annotation: string): void {
    this.commit.cancel();
    this.pending = null;
    this.selectedAnnotation = annotation;
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('annotation-change', {
        detail: { annotation },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
    if (this.tooltipAnnotations.includes(annotation)) {
      this.applyTooltipSelection(this.tooltipAnnotations.filter((name) => name !== annotation));
    }
  }

  /** Sets the tooltip's extra annotations now, without the primary or repeats, and tells listeners. */
  applyTooltipSelection(names: readonly string[]): void {
    const next = Array.from(new Set(names.filter((name) => name !== this.selectedAnnotation)));
    this.tooltipAnnotations = next;
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('tooltip-annotations-change', {
        detail: { tooltipAnnotations: [...next] },
        bubbles: true,
        composed: true,
      }),
    );
  }

  /** Drops a pick still waiting, as a new dataset does. */
  cancelPending(): void {
    this.commit.cancel();
    this.pending = null;
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    super.disconnectedCallback();
    this.cancelPending();
  }

  protected firstUpdated(): void {
    // Set once: the list opens beside the trigger, and a press on the trigger is not outside.
    this.popoverEl.anchor = this.trigger;
  }

  /** The popover closed itself (Escape or a press outside); it gives focus back to the trigger. */
  private onPopoverClose = (event: Event) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.closeList();
  };

  private openList() {
    this.open = true;
    this.updateComplete.then(() => {
      const searchInput = this.shadowRoot?.querySelector(
        '#annotation-search-input',
      ) as HTMLInputElement | null;
      searchInput?.focus();
    });
  }

  private closeList() {
    this.open = false;
    this.query = '';
    this.highlightIndex = -1;
  }

  private toggleDropdown(event?: Event) {
    event?.stopPropagation();
    if (this.open) this.closeList();
    else this.openList();
  }

  private handleSearchInput(event: Event) {
    const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.query = target.value;
    this.highlightIndex = -1; // Reset highlight when query changes
  }

  private handleKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (!this.open) {
      if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
        event.preventDefault();
        this.toggleDropdown(event);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Shift+Enter shows or hides the highlighted annotation in the hover tooltip: the keyboard
    // way to the eye toggle, which is not a Tab stop.
    if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.shiftKey) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const annotation = this.highlightedAnnotation();
      if (annotation !== null) this.toggleTooltipAnnotation(annotation, event);
      return;
    }

    handleListboxKeydown(event, {
      // Lazy: only the arrow and Enter keys pay for re-filtering the list.
      getValues: () => flattenGroupedAnnotations(this.getFilteredGroupedAnnotations()),
      highlightIndex: this.highlightIndex,
      setHighlightIndex: (index) => {
        this.highlightIndex = index;
        this.scrollToHighlighted();
      },
      // The popover's layer normally takes Escape first; this covers an event that never reached
      // the window.
      onEscape: () => this.closeList(),
      onSelect: (annotation) => this.selectAnnotation(annotation, event),
      root: this.shadowRoot,
      itemSelector: '.dropdown-item',
      valueAttribute: 'data-annotation',
    });
  }

  /** The annotation the keyboard highlight is on, or null. */
  private highlightedAnnotation(): string | null {
    const values = flattenGroupedAnnotations(this.getFilteredGroupedAnnotations());
    return this.highlightIndex >= 0 && this.highlightIndex < values.length
      ? values[this.highlightIndex]
      : null;
  }

  private scrollToHighlighted() {
    this.updateComplete.then(() =>
      scrollHighlightedIntoView(this.shadowRoot, '.dropdown-item.highlighted'),
    );
  }

  /** A user's pick: shown at once, committed after the next paint (the newest pick wins). */
  private selectAnnotation(annotation: string, event?: Event) {
    event?.stopPropagation();
    // A keyboard pick removes the focused search input: give focus back to the trigger.
    const hadFocus = this.shadowRoot?.activeElement != null;
    this.closeList();
    if (hadFocus) {
      void this.updateComplete.then(() => this.trigger?.focus());
    }
    // Re-picking the committed annotation changes nothing, and drops a pick still waiting.
    if (annotation === this.selectedAnnotation) {
      this.cancelPending();
      return;
    }
    this.pending = annotation;
    this.commit.schedule(() => this.applySelection(annotation));
  }

  private toggleTooltipAnnotation(annotation: string, event: Event) {
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.preventDefault();
    if (annotation === (this.pending ?? this.selectedAnnotation)) {
      return;
    }
    const isActive = this.tooltipAnnotations.includes(annotation);
    this.applyTooltipSelection(
      isActive
        ? this.tooltipAnnotations.filter((name) => name !== annotation)
        : [...this.tooltipAnnotations, annotation],
    );
  }

  private getFilteredGroupedAnnotations(): GroupedAnnotation[] {
    return filterGroupedAnnotations(this.annotations, this.query, this.annotationDefinitions);
  }

  /**
   * Which annotations the panel would show at least one metric row for in this projection,
   * rebuilt only when those inputs change: render() re-runs on every search keystroke and arrow
   * press while the dropdown is open, and deriving each row's answer there re-scans the whole
   * statistics table per row. The scores themselves live in the projection-metadata panel; the
   * badge only says they exist.
   */
  private hasStats = new Map<string, boolean>();

  willUpdate(changed: PropertyValues<this>) {
    if (changed.has('statisticsRows') || changed.has('selectedProjection')) {
      this.hasStats.clear();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Shares `hasAnnotationStats` with the projection-metadata panel's render gate rather than
   * re-deriving "has stats" from `annotationStatSummary` alone: that would go stale for an
   * ordinary annotation with agreement rows but no validity rows (badges something the panel
   * renders empty) and for a `cluster_*` column, which never has a `summary` of its own but does
   * have agreement rows naming it (would badge nothing for something the panel does render).
   */
  private hasStatistics(annotation: string): boolean {
    let scored = this.hasStats.get(annotation);
    if (scored === undefined) {
      const summary = annotationStatSummary(
        this.statisticsRows,
        annotation,
        this.selectedProjection,
      );
      const agreement = clusterAgreement(this.statisticsRows, annotation);
      scored = hasAnnotationStats(summary, agreement);
      this.hasStats.set(annotation, scored);
    }
    return scored;
  }

  render() {
    const shown = this.pending ?? this.selectedAnnotation;

    return html`
      <div class="annotation-select-container">
        <button
          type="button"
          class="dropdown-trigger ${this.open ? 'open' : ''}"
          part="trigger"
          @click=${this.toggleDropdown}
          @keydown=${this.handleKeydown}
          aria-expanded=${this.open}
          aria-haspopup="listbox"
        >
          <span class="key" part="key">${this.label}</span>
          ${shown
            ? renderAnnotationName(
                shown,
                this.annotationDefinitions[shown],
                'dropdown-trigger-text',
              )
            : html`<span class="dropdown-trigger-text">${this.placeholder}</span>`}
          <span class="chevron-down" aria-hidden="true">${icon('chevron-down', 14)}</span>
        </button>
        <ps-popover
          placement="bottom-start"
          panel-role="none"
          .open=${this.open}
          @ps-close=${this.onPopoverClose}
          >${this.open ? this.renderPanel(shown) : nothing}</ps-popover
        >
      </div>
    `;
  }

  /** The search field and the grouped listbox, rendered only while the list is open. */
  private renderPanel(shown: string) {
    const groups = this.getFilteredGroupedAnnotations();
    const active = this.highlightIndex >= 0 ? optionId(this.highlightIndex) : nothing;
    let index = 0;
    return html`
      <div class="dropdown-menu" @click=${(e: Event) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div class="annotation-search-container">
          ${icon('search', 14)}
          <input
            id="annotation-search-input"
            class="annotation-search-input"
            type="text"
            role="combobox"
            aria-label="Search annotations"
            aria-expanded="true"
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-controls=${LISTBOX_ID}
            aria-activedescendant=${active}
            aria-describedby=${HINT_ID}
            autocomplete="off"
            .value=${this.query}
            placeholder="Search annotations"
            @input=${this.handleSearchInput}
            @keydown=${this.handleKeydown}
          />
          <span id=${HINT_ID} class="sr-only">${TOGGLE_HINT}</span>
        </div>
        <div
          class="annotation-list-container"
          id=${LISTBOX_ID}
          role="listbox"
          aria-label=${this.label}
        >
          ${groups.map(
            (group, g) => html`
              <div
                class="annotation-section"
                role="group"
                aria-labelledby=${`annotation-group-${g}`}
              >
                <div
                  class="annotation-section-header"
                  id=${`annotation-group-${g}`}
                  role="presentation"
                >
                  ${group.category}
                </div>
                <div class="annotation-section-items" role="none">
                  ${group.annotations.map((annotation) =>
                    this.renderRow(annotation, index++, shown),
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            `,
          )}
        </div>
        ${groups.length === 0
          ? html`<p class="no-results" role="status">No matching annotations</p>`
          : nothing}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  /**
   * One row: the option (check, label, predicted mark, badges) and, beside it, the ⓘ and the
   * eye toggle. Hover styling is CSS `:hover` only: mirroring it into `highlightIndex`
   * re-rendered every row the pointer crossed. The index is for keyboard navigation.
   */
  private renderRow(annotation: string, index: number, shown: string) {
    const definition = this.annotationDefinitions[annotation];
    const meta = getAnnotationMeta(annotation, definition);
    const isSelected = annotation === shown;
    const isInTooltip = this.tooltipAnnotations.includes(annotation);
    const eat = this.eatAnnotations.includes(annotation);
    const stats = this.hasStatistics(annotation);
    const hasDocs = meta.description.length > 0 || !!meta.docsUrl;
    const id = optionId(index);
    const notes = [eat ? EAT_NOTE : '', stats ? STATS_NOTE : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    return html`
      <div
        class="dropdown-item ${index === this.highlightIndex ? 'highlighted' : ''} ${isSelected
          ? 'selected'
          : ''}"
        role="none"
        data-annotation=${annotation}
        @click=${(e: Event) => this.selectAnnotation(annotation, e)}
      >
        <div
          class="dropdown-option"
          id=${id}
          role="option"
          aria-selected=${isSelected ? 'true' : 'false'}
          aria-describedby=${notes ? `${id}-notes` : nothing}
        >
          <span class="selected-check">${isSelected ? icon('check', 14) : nothing}</span>
          <span class="dropdown-item-label">${meta.label}</span>
          ${predictedMark(annotation)}
          ${eat ? html`<span class="menu-badge eat-badge" aria-hidden="true">EAT</span>` : nothing}
          ${stats
            ? html`<span class="menu-badge stats-badge" aria-hidden="true">STATS</span>`
            : nothing}
        </div>
        ${notes ? html`<span id=${`${id}-notes`} hidden>${notes}</span>` : nothing}
        ${hasDocs
          ? html`<protspace-info-popover
              class="annotation-info"
              placement="side"
              .description=${meta.description}
              docs-url=${meta.docsUrl ?? ''}
              label=${meta.label}
              @click=${(e: Event) => e.stopPropagation()}
            ></protspace-info-popover>`
          : nothing}
        <span class="tooltip-toggle-slot">
          ${isSelected
            ? nothing
            : html`<button
                  type="button"
                  tabindex="-1"
                  class="tooltip-toggle-btn ${isInTooltip ? 'is-active' : ''}"
                  aria-label=${isInTooltip
                    ? `Hide ${meta.label} from hover tooltip`
                    : `Show ${meta.label} in hover tooltip`}
                  aria-pressed=${isInTooltip ? 'true' : 'false'}
                  @click=${(e: Event) => this.toggleTooltipAnnotation(annotation, e)}
                  @mousedown=${(e: Event) => e.stopPropagation()}
                >
                  ${icon(isInTooltip ? 'eye' : 'eye-off', 14)}
                </button>
                <ps-tooltip
                  names-target
                  text=${isInTooltip ? 'Hide from hover tooltip' : 'Show in hover tooltip'}
                ></ps-tooltip>`}
        </span>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

    'protspace-annotation-select': ProtspaceAnnotationSelect;
  }
}
```

```md
Only `annotations` is required; the rest decide what each row says. `annotationDefinitions` (the
dataset's `annotations` record) names runtime columns, such as an EAT confidence column ("EC
number — EAT confidence"), and keeps a column of your own that merely ends like one from being
renamed. `eatAnnotations` adds the EAT badge to annotations that carry transferred predictions.
`statisticsRows` with `selectedProjection` adds the STATS badge to annotations the bundle scored in
that projection. A predicted annotation (the registry's flag, else a `predicted_` prefix) carries a
sparkles mark named "Predicted annotation". The rows are options of a listbox the search field
controls; Shift+Enter on the highlighted row shows or hides it in the hover tooltip.
```
